words.enDefinition: pressure measured from zero pressure in a perfect vacuum

examples.en: We used absolute pressure in the gas law so both sides used a vacuum reference.
examples.zh: 我们在气体定律中使用「绝对压力」，以真空为压力基准。

examples.en: The absolute pressure at the water surface matched the surrounding air pressure in our open tank.
examples.zh: 在敞口容器中，水面的「绝对压力」与周围空气压力相同。

words.enDefinition: temperature measured from absolute zero on a thermodynamic scale such as kelvins

examples.en: The pressure model requires absolute temperature, so we converted the Celsius reading before substituting it.
examples.zh: 压力模型要求「绝对温度」，所以代入之前先换算摄氏读数。

examples.en: Doubling the absolute temperature doubled the pressure in our fixed-volume ideal gas example.
examples.zh: 在定容理想气体的示例中，「绝对温度」翻倍使压力翻倍。

words.enDefinition: equipment that transfers a component from a gas stream into a liquid passing through it

examples.en: The absorber has a gas inlet near its base and a water inlet near its top.
examples.zh: 「吸收器」在靠近底部处有气体入口，在靠近顶部处有进水口。

examples.en: We tracked the component into the liquid outlet of the absorber using the classroom mass balance.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂的质量平衡追踪进入「吸收器」液体出口的组分。

words.enDefinition: An instrument input mode that blocks the steady component and attenuates low-frequency content.

examples.en: AC coupling removes the steady offset so the waveform is centred differently in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 「交流耦合」去除直流偏置，因此课堂图的波形中心位置改变。

examples.en: We compared the screenshot labelled AC coupling with the image that retains the steady offset.
examples.zh: 我们将标有「交流耦合」的截图与仍含直流偏置的图像比较。

words.enDefinition: A stated condition used to decide whether a result meets a requirement.

examples.en: We wrote an acceptance criterion before checking whether the model slid easily into the classroom drawer.
examples.zh: 我们先写明「验收判据」，再检查模型是否能轻松滑进教室的抽屉。

examples.en: The tutor linked each acceptance criterion on the page to a result our group could observe.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把页面上的各项「验收判据」与我们小组可观察到的结果一一对应。

words.enDefinition: an added atom that can accept a valence electron and leave a mobile hole in a semiconductor

examples.en: The drawing shows a neutral acceptor impurity becoming negatively charged after capturing a valence electron.
examples.zh: 图中显示，一个中性的「受主杂质」俘获价电子后带上负电。

examples.en: The tutor used an acceptor impurity to explain why the silicon model had additional mobile holes.
examples.zh: 老师用「受主杂质」解释为什么在硅模型中出现更多可移动的空穴。

words.enDefinition: A balance term giving the change or rate of change of a quantity stored within the system.

examples.en: The accumulation term is positive when the amount of water inside the container is increasing.
examples.zh: 容器内水量增加时，「积累项」为正。

examples.en: We retained the accumulation term because the amount in the classroom model changes with time.
examples.zh: 由于课堂模型中的物料量随时间变动，我们保留了「积累项」。

words.enDefinition: a layer or column of activated carbon particles through which fluid passes for adsorption

examples.en: The activated carbon bed appears as a dark granular layer in the classroom water treatment diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂水处理图中的「活性炭床」画成深色颗粒层。

examples.en: The simulated outlet from the activated carbon bed contained less coloring than the inlet at first.
examples.zh: 开始时，模拟「活性炭床」出口液的色素比入口液少。

collocations: adsorption on an activated carbon bed

words.enDefinition: The average rate at which electrical energy is transferred or converted over an AC cycle.

examples.en: The active power is positive because the resistor absorbs energy on average in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，电阻器平均吸收能量，因此「有功功率」为正。

examples.en: We calculated active power from the simulated voltage and current waveforms in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂问题中的模拟电压和电流波形计算「有功功率」。

collocations: active power absorbed by a load

words.enDefinition: a thermodynamic process without heat transfer across the system boundary

examples.en: We approximated the rapid expansion as an adiabatic process because little heat crossed the boundary.
examples.zh: 由于穿过边界的热量很少，我们把快速膨胀近似成「绝热过程」。

examples.en: The gas cooled during the adiabatic process even though it lost no energy as heat.
examples.zh: 虽然没有以热量形式损失能量，气体在「绝热过程」中仍然降温。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal of impedance, relating the current phasor to the voltage phasor.

examples.en: The admittance is easier to combine for the parallel branches in the example circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 示例电路图中，使用「导纳」更容易合并各条并联支路。

examples.en: We inverted the impedance to find the admittance of the idealized component in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们取阻抗的倒数，求得理想化元件的「导纳」。

words.enDefinition: the substance held at an interface by adsorption

examples.en: The adsorbate in the model was a colored molecule retained at the surface of the carbon.
examples.zh: 模型中的「吸附质」是被保留在碳表面的一种有色分子。

examples.en: We labeled the adsorbate beside the molecules drawn on the surface in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图绘出的表面分子旁标出「吸附质」。

collocations: release an adsorbate from a surface

words.enDefinition: a material whose surface retains molecules or ions from a contacting fluid by adsorption

examples.en: In the example, activated carbon is the adsorbent because its surface retains some dissolved coloring.
examples.zh: 示例中，活性炭的表面能截留部分溶解的色素，所以它是「吸附剂」。

examples.en: We compared each adsorbent by its equilibrium uptake per gram in the classroom data table.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂数据表中每克的平衡吸附量比较各「吸附剂」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of material retained by an adsorbent per unit mass under the stated conditions

examples.en: The exercise reports adsorption capacity as milligrams of retained dye per gram of the carbon sample.
examples.zh: 练习用每克炭样所吸附的染料毫克数表示「吸附容量」。

examples.en: We compared adsorption capacity using data from runs at the same temperature and equilibrium concentration.
examples.zh: 我们用温度和平衡浓度相同的多次试验数据比较「吸附容量」。

words.enDefinition: the accumulation of molecules or ions from a fluid at a solid or other interface

examples.en: The model uses adsorption to explain how dissolved color can collect on a porous carbon surface.
examples.zh: 模型用「吸附」解释溶解的有色物质如何聚集在多孔碳表面。

examples.en: We distinguished adsorption at the material surface from dissolution throughout a liquid in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们区分了材料表面的「吸附」和遍及液体内部的溶解。

words.enDefinition: a relation between the equilibrium amount adsorbed and the concentration or pressure of the adsorbing substance at fixed temperature

examples.en: The adsorption isotherm plots equilibrium uptake against dissolved concentration for samples held at the same temperature.
examples.zh: 「吸附等温线」以同一温度下的溶解浓度为横坐标，绘出样品的平衡吸附量。

examples.en: We compared the shapes of the adsorption isotherm curves fitted to the two simulated materials.
examples.zh: 我们对照了两种模拟材料拟合所得的「吸附等温线」形状。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of particle sizes within a sample of aggregate.

examples.en: The two aggregate gradation curves differed most in the range of smaller particles on our graph.
examples.zh: 图中的两条「集料级配」曲线在较小粒径范围内差别最大。

examples.en: Our tutor used a chart of aggregate gradation to discuss how the particle sizes were distributed.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「集料级配」图说明颗粒尺寸的分布。

words.enDefinition: The amount of water in and on aggregate relative to its dry mass.

examples.en: The report listed aggregate moisture content separately because rain had changed the condition of the sand.
examples.zh: 由于下雨改变了砂的含水状态，报告单独列出了「集料含水率」。

examples.en: We compared aggregate moisture content for the two stockpile samples described in the laboratory notes.
examples.zh: 我们比较实验记录里两个料堆样品的「集料含水率」。

words.enDefinition: Concrete containing intentionally introduced small, distributed air voids.

examples.en: The photograph of air-entrained concrete showed small voids scattered throughout the hardened paste in the sample.
examples.zh: 「引气混凝土」的照片显示，样品的硬化浆体中分布着小气孔。

examples.en: We read why air-entrained concrete appeared in a lesson about repeated freezing and thawing of wet samples.
examples.zh: 学习湿试样的反复冻融时，我们阅读了有关「引气混凝土」的说明。

collocations: compare air-entrained concrete with a reference mix

words.enDefinition: An admixture that intentionally creates small, stable air bubbles in fresh concrete.

examples.en: The instructor pointed to small bubbles in the sketch illustrating the purpose of an air-entraining admixture.
examples.zh: 老师指着示意图中的小气泡，说明「引气剂」的用途。

examples.en: The ingredient list showed an air-entraining admixture alongside the binder, water and aggregates in the example.
examples.zh: 示例组分清单列出的除了胶结料、水和集料，还有一种「引气剂」。

collocations: a mix with an air-entraining admixture
the effect of an air-entraining admixture

words.enDefinition: the loss of frequency distinguishability when different continuous signals give the same uniformly spaced samples

examples.en: The simulation showed aliasing when a high-frequency tone appeared at a lower frequency in the sampled data.
examples.zh: 高频音调以较低频率出现在采样数据中时，模拟展示了「混叠」。

examples.en: We increased the sampling frequency and watched the spurious component from aliasing disappear in the reconstructed waveform.
examples.zh: 我们提高采样频率，看到重构波形中因「混叠」产生的伪分量消失。

words.enDefinition: A reaction between alkalis and reactive silica in concrete aggregate that can cause expansion and cracking.

examples.en: The case study considered alkali-silica reaction after noting the pattern of cracks on several concrete samples.
examples.zh: 案例记录几件混凝土试样的裂缝形态后，考虑了「碱硅反应」的可能性。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted reactive silica in the material description while explaining the term alkali-silica reaction in class.
examples.zh: 课上，辅导老师解释「碱硅反应」时，在材料说明中特别标出了活性二氧化硅。

words.enDefinition: Electric current whose direction reverses repeatedly, often in a periodic pattern.

examples.en: The alternating current reverses direction when the plotted waveform changes sign in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的波形变号时，「交流」就反向。

examples.en: We drew the alternating current over two cycles using the supplied low-voltage model.
examples.zh: 我们根据给定的低压模型，画出两个周期内的「交流」。

words.enDefinition: An instrument for measuring electric current through a circuit path.

examples.en: The ammeter reading is the current through the marked branch in the ideal classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂理想模型里的「电流表」读数是标记支路的电流。

examples.en: We identified the ammeter symbol drawn in series with the resistor on the supplied diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在给定图上识别出与电阻器串联的「电流表」符号。

words.enDefinition: The SI unit of electric current, equal to one coulomb per second.

examples.en: One ampere corresponds to one coulomb of charge passing a point each second in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，一「安培」对应每秒有一库仑电荷通过该点。

examples.en: The worksheet converts a fraction of an ampere into milliamperes before comparing the branch currents.
examples.zh: 练习纸把不足一「安培」的电流换算为毫安，再比较各支路电流。

words.enDefinition: a signal represented by a physical quantity that can vary continuously in amplitude

examples.en: The sensor produces an analog signal whose voltage varies smoothly as the lamp grows brighter.
examples.zh: 灯变亮时，传感器产生的「模拟信号」电压平滑变化。

examples.en: We compared the analog signal from the microphone with the sequence of codes recorded by the converter.
examples.zh: 我们把传声器发出的「模拟信号」与转换器记录的编码序列比较。

words.enDefinition: a device that represents an analog input with a sequence of numerical codes

examples.en: The analog-to-digital converter produced one code for each sample of the sensor voltage in the simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「模数转换器」为传感器电压的每个采样值生成一个编码。

examples.en: We compared the analog-to-digital converter outputs for two input voltages that fell inside the same code interval.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个落在同一编码区间的输入电压对应的「模数转换器」输出。

words.enDefinition: The angular rotation of one cross-section relative to another under torsion.

examples.en: We measured the angle of twist between two marks on the ends of the classroom rod.
examples.zh: 我们测量课堂杆件两端标记之间的「扭转角」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the angle of twist for two circular rods shown in the same exercise.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了同一练习中两根圆杆的「扭转角」。

collocations: the angle of twist between two sections

words.enDefinition: The time derivative of angular velocity, describing how rotational speed or the rotation axis changes.

examples.en: We found the angular acceleration from the slope of the angular velocity graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据角速度曲线的斜率求出了「角加速度」。

examples.en: The disk has zero angular acceleration while it turns steadily about its fixed axis.
examples.zh: 圆盘绕定轴匀速转动时，「角加速度」为零。

words.enDefinition: Signed change in orientation around a chosen axis between two times

examples.en: We calculated the angular displacement from the two angles shown in the measurement log.
examples.zh: 我们用测量记录表上的两个角求出了「角位移」。

examples.en: The signed angular displacement is negative when the disk turns opposite our chosen direction.
examples.zh: 圆盘朝我们选定方向的反方向转动时，带符号的「角位移」为负。

words.enDefinition: Time integral of a moment about a specified point or axis

examples.en: We found angular impulse from the signed area under the torque versus time graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据力矩随时间变化的图线下的带符号面积求出「角冲量」。

examples.en: Two different torque histories produced equal angular impulse about the axis in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，两种不同的力矩变化过程产生了相同的绕轴「角冲量」。

collocations: angular impulse about a fixed axis

words.enDefinition: External torque impulse about a fixed point equals the angular momentum change

examples.en: We applied the angular impulse-momentum principle to a disk under a moment that changed with time.
examples.zh: 我们将「角冲量动量原理」用于受到随时间变化的力矩作用的圆盘。

examples.en: The angular impulse-momentum principle related the measured moment history to the change in angular momentum.
examples.zh: 「角冲量动量原理」把实测的力矩变化过程与角动量的变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Difference in the directions of two nominally aligned shaft centerlines

examples.en: We recognized angular misalignment because the two shaft centerlines pointed in different directions.
examples.zh: 由于两轴中心线指向不同方向，我们识别出了「角度不对中」。

examples.en: The sketch shows angular misalignment between two shafts that meet at an angle.
examples.zh: 草图显示两根成角度相交的轴之间存在「角度不对中」。

words.enDefinition: Sum of position cross momentum for particles measured from a specified reference point

examples.en: We measured angular momentum about the marked axis for the turning disk in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上测量了转动圆盘绕标记轴的「角动量」。

examples.en: The value of angular momentum in the worksheet depends on the chosen reference point.
examples.zh: 习题中「角动量」的值取决于所选参考点。

words.enDefinition: Orientation measured by an angle from a chosen reference direction

examples.en: We marked the zero direction before recording the disk's angular position in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出零角方向，再在图中记录圆盘的「角位置」。

examples.en: The graph gives angular position at successive times during one turn of the disk.
examples.zh: 图中给出了圆盘转一圈期间各时刻的「角位置」。

words.enDefinition: magnitude of angular velocity, independent of the direction of rotation

examples.en: The disks have equal angular speed values although they rotate in opposite directions.
examples.zh: 尽管两个圆盘的转动方向相反，它们的「角速率」相等。

examples.en: We compared the angular speed of the two wheels during the same time interval.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个轮子在同一时间段内的「角速率」。

words.enDefinition: A vector describing the instantaneous rate and axis of rotation, with its sign or direction given by the right-hand convention.

examples.en: The slope of our angle graph gives the wheel's angular velocity at that moment.
examples.zh: 角度曲线的斜率给出车轮在那个时刻的「角速度」。

examples.en: Both marked points share the same angular velocity because they belong to one disk.
examples.zh: 两个标记点具有相同的「角速度」，因为它们都在同一个圆盘上。

words.enDefinition: Mean daily vehicle volume over a full year for a location

examples.en: The table reports annual average daily traffic based on a modeled full year of daily counts.
examples.zh: 表中根据一年内每天的模拟计数报告了「年平均日交通量」。

examples.en: We compared annual average daily traffic at two locations using the same synthetic yearly dataset.
examples.zh: 我们用同一套合成年数据比较了两处的「年平均日交通量」。

words.enDefinition: a filter applied before sampling to suppress components that would overlap frequencies of interest after sampling

examples.en: The anti-aliasing filter reduced the high-frequency components before the converter sampled the simulated microphone signal.
examples.zh: 转换器对模拟传声器信号采样之前，「抗混叠滤波器」减弱了高频分量。

examples.en: We compared spectra from two simulated converters, one with an anti-aliasing filter and one with unfiltered input.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个模拟转换器的频谱，一个使用「抗混叠滤波器」，另一个使用未滤波的输入。

words.enDefinition: The product of RMS voltage and RMS current, equal to the magnitude of complex power in sinusoidal analysis.

examples.en: The apparent power uses the two effective values shown beside the waveform in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中的「视在功率」用波形旁显示的两个有效值计算。

examples.en: We compared apparent power with active power in the ideal resistive example on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习纸上理想电阻示例的「视在功率」与有功功率。

words.enDefinition: the rule that buoyant force equals the weight of displaced fluid and acts upward

examples.en: We used Archimedes' principle to relate the block's upward force to the volume of water displaced.
examples.zh: 我们用「阿基米德原理」联系块体所受向上的力和它排开的水量。

examples.en: The worksheet applies Archimedes' principle to compare the submerged volumes of an object floating in two liquids.
examples.zh: 练习应用「阿基米德原理」，比较同一物体漂浮在两种液体中时的浸没体积。

words.enDefinition: pressure exerted by the atmosphere at a given location and time

examples.en: The local atmospheric pressure was lower at the hilltop than at our starting point.
examples.zh: 山顶当地的「大气压力」比出发地点低。

examples.en: We used measured atmospheric pressure as the reference for the gauge readings in our notes.
examples.zh: 笔记中的表压读数以实测「大气压力」为基准。

words.enDefinition: Reference water contents separating different consistency states of fine-grained soil

examples.en: The Atterberg limits mark changes in how a fine soil behaves as water content varies.
examples.zh: 随着含水率变化，「阿特伯格界限」标志细粒土性状的变化。

examples.en: We labeled the Atterberg limits along the water content axis in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题的含水率轴上标出了「阿特伯格界限」。

words.enDefinition: Automatic selection of a measurement range by an instrument as the measured value changes.

examples.en: Auto-ranging explains why the position of the decimal point changes between these two display examples.
examples.zh: 「自动量程切换」解释了为什么这两个显示示例的小数点位置不同。

examples.en: We compared automatic switching with a fixed setting while reading the overview of auto-ranging.
examples.zh: 阅读「自动量程切换」概述时，我们比较了自动切换与固定设置。

words.enDefinition: Contraction of a cementitious material caused by internal processes during hydration without external moisture loss.

examples.en: The sealed specimens showed autogenous shrinkage even though moisture did not leave them during the comparison.
examples.zh: 尽管比较过程中没有水分从密封试样逸出，试样仍出现了「自生收缩」。

examples.en: We used the notes about hydration to explain autogenous shrinkage in the sealed paste sample.
examples.zh: 我们根据关于水化的笔记解释密封浆体样品中的「自生收缩」。

words.enDefinition: Mean number of vehicles per day over a specified counting period

examples.en: We computed average daily traffic from a week of vehicle counts in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们根据习题中一周的车辆计数求出了「平均日交通量」。

examples.en: The average daily traffic figure changes when weekends are included in our synthetic dataset.
examples.zh: 我们的合成数据集纳入周末后，「平均日交通量」数值发生变化。

collocations: average daily traffic for a study period

words.enDefinition: The shear force on a surface divided by its area.

examples.en: We computed average shear stress using the total shear force and the area of the section.
examples.zh: 我们用总剪力和截面面积求出「平均剪应力」。

examples.en: The tutor compared average shear stress with the higher local value marked in the diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师将「平均剪应力」与图中标出的较高局部剪应力作了比较。

collocations: average shear stress across a section
compare average shear stress with local stress

words.enDefinition: The change in length of a member along its longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We calculated axial deformation by tracking the change in distance between two marks on the rod.
examples.zh: 我们记录杆上两个标记之间的距离变化，以计算「轴向变形」。

examples.en: The tutor plotted axial deformation against the applied load for the two textbook specimens.
examples.zh: 辅导老师绘图显示教材中两个试样的「轴向变形」如何随载荷变化。

words.enDefinition: A force component along the longitudinal axis of a member.

examples.en: The axial force acted along the centerline of the simple bar in our solved example.
examples.zh: 在我们的已解例题中，「轴力」沿简单杆件的中心线作用。

examples.en: We marked the axial force as tensile because the arrows pulled away from the cut faces.
examples.zh: 由于箭头向外拉离截面，我们把「轴力」标为拉力。

words.enDefinition: Loading applied along the longitudinal axis of a member.

examples.en: The classroom sketch showed axial loading with both arrows lined up along the straight bar's centerline.
examples.zh: 课堂草图显示的是「轴向加载」，两个力的箭头都与直杆中心线重合。

examples.en: We used an example of axial loading to compare the elongation of two bars in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用一个「轴向加载」的例题比较两根杆的伸长量。

words.enDefinition: The product of Young's modulus and cross-sectional area for a member.

examples.en: Two bars had the same axial rigidity because they had identical cross-sections and the same material.
examples.zh: 两根杆的横截面相同，材料也相同，因此「抗拉压刚度」相同。

examples.en: We used axial rigidity together with length to predict how much the classroom rod would stretch.
examples.zh: 我们利用「抗拉压刚度」和长度，预测课堂杆件的伸长量。

collocations: the axial rigidity of a bar

words.enDefinition: The fractional length change along a member's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: The axial strain was negative because the distance between the two marks on the bar decreased.
examples.zh: 由于杆上两个标记之间的距离缩短了，「轴向应变」为负。

examples.en: We compared the axial strain in two samples whose original lengths were marked on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个试样的「轴向应变」，习题上已标明它们的原长度。

collocations: the average axial strain along a bar

words.enDefinition: Line about which an object turns during the motion being analyzed

examples.en: The dashed line through the center marks the axis of rotation in our drawing.
examples.zh: 我们图中穿过中心的虚线标出了「转动轴线」。

examples.en: We measured each marker's distance from the axis of rotation before comparing its speed.
examples.zh: 比较各标记点的速度之前，我们先测量了各点到「转动轴线」的距离。

collocations: distance from the axis of rotation

words.enDefinition: a mixture whose liquid and equilibrium vapor have the same composition at a certain pressure and temperature

examples.en: At the azeotrope, the liquid and vapor compositions coincide where the equilibrium curve meets the diagonal.
examples.zh: 在「共沸物」对应状态，平衡曲线与对角线相交，液相和气相组成相同。

examples.en: We marked the azeotrope on the diagram before explaining the limit of ordinary distillation at that pressure.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中标出「共沸物」，再解释该压力下普通蒸馏的局限。

words.enDefinition: Agreement among the terms of a balance to within a stated tolerance.

examples.en: The balance closure improves after using unrounded masses from the table in the synthetic example.
examples.zh: 合成示例改用表中未经取整的质量后，「衡算闭合」情况改善。

examples.en: We checked balance closure by comparing the calculated total with the reported outlet amount.
examples.zh: 我们将计算总量与报告的出口量比较，以核查「衡算闭合」。

words.enDefinition: The time span over which the material entering, leaving, and accumulating in a system is compared.

examples.en: The balance interval starts with the first reading and ends with the last reading in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「衡算时段」从第一次读数开始，到最后一次读数结束。

examples.en: We used the same balance interval for every stream amount in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表中各股物流的物料量统一采用同一个「衡算时段」。

collocations: total flow over a balance interval

words.enDefinition: The difference left after evaluating the two sides of a balance equation with given data.

examples.en: The balance residual is small after the class substitutes the rounded flow values into the equation.
examples.zh: 全班把取整后的流量值代入方程后，「衡算残差」很小。

examples.en: We examined the balance residual before deciding whether the worksheet values were consistent.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「衡算残差」，再判断练习纸上的数值是否一致。

words.enDefinition: Rolling-element bearing that supports loads with spherical rolling components

examples.en: We identified a ball bearing by the row of spheres in the cutaway.
examples.zh: 我们根据剖开示意图中的一排球体识别出「球轴承」。

examples.en: The ball bearing supports the rotating shaft inside the small demonstration wheel.
examples.zh: 「球轴承」支撑小型演示轮内的转轴。

words.enDefinition: a filter passing a bounded range of frequencies while attenuating frequencies below and above that range

examples.en: The band-pass filter retained the middle tone while weakening both the lowest and highest tones in the mixture.
examples.zh: 「带通滤波器」保留了混合声音的中间音调，减弱了最低和最高音调。

examples.en: We marked the two edges of the band-pass filter on the plotted magnitude response in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在幅频响应图上标出「带通滤波器」的两个边界频率。

words.enDefinition: a filter that attenuates a selected frequency band while passing frequencies above and below it

examples.en: The band-stop filter reduced one band of audible interference while preserving tones on either side in simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，「带阻滤波器」减弱了一段频带内的可闻干扰，保留了两侧频率的音调。

examples.en: We checked whether the noisy tone fell between the band-stop filter edges marked on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们检查干扰音是否落在练习表上标出的「带阻滤波器」两个边界频率之间。

words.enDefinition: a signal whose frequency spectrum is zero outside a bounded frequency range

examples.en: The instructor modeled the example as a bandlimited signal with no components above the stated upper frequency.
examples.zh: 老师把示例建模为「带限信号」，在给定频率上限之上没有分量。

examples.en: We used a bandlimited signal to show when samples can describe a continuous waveform exactly in theory.
examples.zh: 我们用「带限信号」说明什么条件下采样值在理论上可以精确表示连续波形。

words.enDefinition: A schedule listing reinforcing bar identifiers, quantities, dimensions, and bending shapes.

examples.en: The bar bending schedule linked each drawing label to its listed bar shape and quantity.
examples.zh: 「钢筋加工明细表」将图纸上的各个编号与所列钢筋形状和数量对应起来。

examples.en: Our exercise used a bar bending schedule to distinguish two reinforcing bars with different shaped ends.
examples.zh: 我们用「钢筋加工明细表」区分两根端部形状不同的钢筋。

collocations: a bar mark in a bar bending schedule

words.enDefinition: A support shaped to hold reinforcing bars or a reinforcement mat at the intended height.

examples.en: Our class saw a bar chair beneath the upper reinforcement layer in the transparent slab model.
examples.zh: 我们看见透明楼板模型的上层钢筋下方有一个「钢筋马凳」。

examples.en: The illustration used a bar chair symbol beside the line showing the intended height of the bars.
examples.zh: 插图在标示钢筋预定高度的线旁使用了「钢筋马凳」符号。

collocations: a bar chair for the upper reinforcement
the height of a bar chair

words.enDefinition: A drawing or schedule identifier for a reinforcing bar type with specified detailing information.

examples.en: We used the bar mark in the diagram to find the matching shape in the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们根据图中的「钢筋编号」，在明细表中找出对应的形状。

examples.en: The same bar mark appeared twice because both positions called for the same listed bar shape.
examples.zh: 两个位置需要使用明细表中同一种形状的钢筋，因此出现了相同的「钢筋编号」。

collocations: match a bar mark to a schedule
a bar mark on a detail

words.enDefinition: current through the base terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The model changed the base current and recorded how much the collector current changed with it.
examples.zh: 模型改变「基极电流」，并记录集电极电流随之改变多少。

examples.en: We calculated base current from the simulation trace and compared it with the emitter current.
examples.zh: 我们根据模拟曲线算出「基极电流」，再与发射极电流比较。

words.enDefinition: An initial or reference reading used to assess changes in later observations.

examples.en: We took the baseline reading before placing the first paper sample in the classroom setup.
examples.zh: 我们在把第一件纸样放进课堂装置前，先记录了「基线读数」。

examples.en: The graph used the baseline reading as the reference for the later changes in the model.
examples.zh: 图表以「基线读数」作为模型后续变化的参考。

collocations: compare readings with a baseline reading
a baseline reading before a test

words.enDefinition: distillation in which a fixed initial charge is processed without a continuous fresh feed during the run

examples.en: The batch distillation model began with a single charge and recorded changing distillate composition over time.
examples.zh: 「间歇蒸馏」模型从一次装入的物料开始，记录馏出液组成随时间的变化。

examples.en: Our batch distillation graph shows why early and late product fractions can have different compositions.
examples.zh: 我们的「间歇蒸馏」图显示前后收集的馏出馏分为何可能有不同组成。

words.enDefinition: A process that handles a finite amount of material as one discrete run.

examples.en: The batch process in the classroom chart follows one bowl of mixture from start to finish.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的「间歇过程」跟踪一碗混合物从开始到结束。

examples.en: We compared the initial and final material amounts for the illustrated batch process on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上比较图示「间歇过程」的初始与最终物料量。

collocations: material balance for a batch process

words.enDefinition: A record identifying a concrete batch and listing its production or delivery details.

examples.en: The instructor asked us to locate the batch ticket that accompanied the example delivery in the case study.
examples.zh: 老师请我们找出案例示例供货随车携带的「混凝土出料单」。

examples.en: We checked the batch ticket for the mix identification before connecting it to the laboratory results.
examples.zh: 我们在「混凝土出料单」上核对配合比编号，再将它与实验结果关联起来。

collocations: the time on a batch ticket
match a batch ticket to a delivery

words.enDefinition: The change in tangent direction per unit arc length along a bent beam.

examples.en: We compared beam curvature at two locations using the magnified shape of the deflected classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂模型变形后的形状放大，用来比较两处的「梁曲率」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why constant bending moment gave constant beam curvature in our uniform beam example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释，在均匀梁例题中，为何弯矩恒定时「梁曲率」也恒定。

words.enDefinition: The transverse displacement of a beam from its unloaded position.

examples.en: We measured beam deflection at the center of the model with a scale beside it.
examples.zh: 我们用模型旁的刻度测量其中心处的「梁挠度」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to compare beam deflection before and after moving the cardboard model's small load.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们比较纸板模型上的小载荷移动前后的「梁挠度」。

words.enDefinition: The distance between the supports delimiting a length of beam.

examples.en: The diagram labelled the beam span between the two supports rather than the total length.
examples.zh: 图中标注的是两个支座间「梁的跨度」。

examples.en: We placed the point load halfway along the beam span in our first classroom example.
examples.zh: 在第一个课堂例题中，我们把集中载荷放在「跨度」的中点。

collocations: a load at the midpoint of the beam span

words.enDefinition: Component that separates and guides rolling elements around a bearing

examples.en: The bearing cage keeps neighboring balls spaced apart as they move around the ring.
examples.zh: 滚珠沿套圈转动时，「轴承保持架」使相邻滚珠彼此隔开。

examples.en: We removed the outer ring from the drawing to reveal the bearing cage.
examples.zh: 我们在图中隐藏外圈，让「轴承保持架」显露出来。

words.enDefinition: Available movement between bearing components measured in a specified direction

examples.en: The animation exaggerates bearing clearance so viewers can see the available relative movement.
examples.zh: 动画放大了「轴承游隙」，以便观众看清可发生的相对运动。

examples.en: Our model distinguishes bearing clearance along the shaft from clearance perpendicular to it.
examples.zh: 我们的模型区分了沿轴方向与垂直于轴方向的「轴承游隙」。

words.enDefinition: Ring of a rolling bearing carrying a track for rolling elements

examples.en: The inner bearing race turns with the shaft in our simplified assembly.
examples.zh: 在我们的简化组件中，内「轴承套圈」随轴转动。

examples.en: We marked the outer bearing race in the part of the drawing held stationary.
examples.zh: 我们在图中保持静止的位置标出了外「轴承套圈」。

words.enDefinition: The horizontal mortar joint between successive layers of masonry units.

examples.en: We marked the bed joint directly beneath one row of bricks in the classroom elevation.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂立面图的一皮砖正下方标出了「水平灰缝」。

examples.en: The tutor drew a line along the bed joint and then pointed to the shorter vertical joint.
examples.zh: 辅导老师沿「水平灰缝」画了一条线，再指出旁边较短的竖缝。

collocations: the thickness of a bed joint

words.enDefinition: Transmission using a moving belt stretched around two or more pulleys

examples.en: The belt drive transfers rotation between the two separated wheels in the model.
examples.zh: 「带传动」在模型中将转动从一个轮子传到另一个分开的轮子。

examples.en: We traced the belt drive around the pulleys drawn at different sizes.
examples.zh: 我们沿着绕过图中不同大小带轮的「带传动」路径观察。

words.enDefinition: A laboratory instrument that provides adjustable power for a circuit under its stated output limits.

examples.en: The bench power supply display in the training screenshot shows separate voltage and current values.
examples.zh: 训练截图中的「台式电源」分别显示电压和电流。

examples.en: We matched the bench power supply symbol to the low-voltage source in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「台式电源」的符号与电路图中的低压电源对应起来。

collocations: output of a bench power supply

words.enDefinition: An internal moment tending to bend a member about an axis in its section.

examples.en: We found the bending moment at the cut by summing moments on the left segment.
examples.zh: 我们对左段的各力取矩并相加，求出截面处的「弯矩」。

examples.en: The tutor showed that the bending moment could change even where the beam cross-section stayed constant.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，即使梁的横截面不变，「弯矩」也可能随位置变化。

collocations: calculate a bending moment at a section

words.enDefinition: A graph of internal bending moment against position along a member.

examples.en: The bending moment diagram reached its highest value at the center of the symmetrically loaded beam.
examples.zh: 载荷对称的梁，其「弯矩图」在梁中心达到最高点。

examples.en: The tutor marked where the bending moment diagram crossed the horizontal axis in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师标出了课堂例题中「弯矩图」与横轴的交点。

collocations: the peak of a bending moment diagram

words.enDefinition: Longitudinal normal stress caused by bending a member.

examples.en: We plotted bending stress across the section and saw its sign change at the neutral axis.
examples.zh: 我们画出截面上的「弯曲应力」分布，发现其符号在中性轴处改变。

examples.en: The bending stress was largest in magnitude farthest from the neutral axis in our simple example.
examples.zh: 在这个简单例题中，离中性轴最远的地方「弯曲应力」的绝对值最大。

words.enDefinition: for steady inviscid incompressible flow, the relation keeping pressure plus kinetic and gravitational potential energy per unit volume constant along a streamline

examples.en: We applied Bernoulli's equation along a streamline in steady flow with constant density and negligible viscosity.
examples.zh: 在密度恒定且黏性可忽略的稳态流动中，我们沿同一条流线应用「伯努利方程」。

examples.en: The example combines Bernoulli's equation with mass conservation to compare two sections of an ideal flow.
examples.zh: 该示例把「伯努利方程」与质量守恒结合起来，比较理想流动中的两个截面。

words.enDefinition: Gear with a conical pitch surface, commonly transmitting motion between intersecting shafts

examples.en: The bevel gear redirects rotation between shafts meeting at an angle in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「锥齿轮」在成角度相交的轴之间改变转动方向。

examples.en: We recognized the bevel gear by the cone shape marked on the model.
examples.zh: 我们根据模型上标出的锥形辨认出「锥齿轮」。

words.enDefinition: the steady operating values of current and voltage that are set before variations due to a signal

examples.en: The bias point appears at the intersection of the device curve and the load line in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，「偏置点」标在器件曲线与负载线的交点。

examples.en: We checked where the bias point lay before applying the linear approximation to the amplifier model.
examples.zh: 我们先确认「偏置点」的位置，再对放大器模型应用线性近似。

words.enDefinition: A size tolerance allowing departures in both directions from the stated nominal dimension.

examples.en: The bilateral tolerance allowed the sample width to fall slightly above or below the nominal value.
examples.zh: 「双向公差」允许试样宽度略高于或略低于公称值。

examples.en: We identified a bilateral tolerance when the drawing showed deviations both above and below the nominal dimension.
examples.zh: 图样显示公称尺寸上、下都允许有偏差，我们据此认出了「双向公差」。

collocations: show a bilateral tolerance beside a dimension

words.enDefinition: A dimensionless ratio comparing internal conduction resistance with surface convection resistance for a body.

examples.en: The Biot number compares internal opposition to heat flow with the surface resistance in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「毕奥数」比较内部导热热阻和表面热阻。

examples.en: We used the Biot number to discuss whether internal temperature gradients matter in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们利用「毕奥数」讨论课堂模型中内部温度梯度是否重要。

words.enDefinition: a three-terminal semiconductor device in which both electrons and holes participate, with emitter, base and collector terminals

examples.en: The diagram labels the three terminals of the bipolar junction transistor before showing its current directions.
examples.zh: 图中先标出「双极结型晶体管」的三个端子，再显示电流方向。

examples.en: Our bipolar junction transistor model linked a small base current to a larger change in collector current.
examples.zh: 我们的「双极结型晶体管」模型将较小的基极电流变化与较大的集电极电流变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: An ideal body that absorbs all incident radiation and emits the maximum thermal radiation for its temperature.

examples.en: The blackbody serves as the reference emitter in the classroom comparison of two warm surfaces.
examples.zh: 在课堂比较两个温暖表面时，「黑体」作为参考辐射体。

examples.en: We used a blackbody to define the reference emission at each illustrated temperature on paper.
examples.zh: 我们用「黑体」定义纸面上各图示温度的参考发射量。

words.enDefinition: The upward movement of water in fresh concrete as solid particles settle.

examples.en: We recognized bleeding of concrete in the time sequence when water first appeared on the sample surface.
examples.zh: 我们在连续图像中看到试样表面首次出现水，据此认出「混凝土泌水」。

examples.en: The worksheet linked bleeding of concrete to settling particles beneath the shiny surface in the photograph.
examples.zh: 习题把「混凝土泌水」与照片中反光表面下方的颗粒沉降联系起来。

collocations: bleeding of concrete at the surface

words.enDefinition: A manufactured cement combining Portland cement or clinker with additional cementitious constituents.

examples.en: The blended cement label listed a second constituent alongside the Portland cement clinker in the product.
examples.zh: 「混合水泥」标签除了硅酸盐水泥熟料，还列出了该产品的另一种组分。

examples.en: We compared the blended cement sample with the reference binder by reading their listed components in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看组分表，将「混合水泥」样品与参考胶结料进行比较。

collocations: a mix made with blended cement

words.enDefinition: a pair of plots showing frequency response magnitude and phase against logarithmically scaled frequency

examples.en: The upper part of the Bode plot showed gain, while the lower part showed phase shift.
examples.zh: 「波德图」的上半部分显示增益，下半部分显示相移。

examples.en: We read the amplitude ratio from the Bode plot after locating the input frequency on its axis.
examples.zh: 我们在「波德图」的频率轴上定位输入频率，再读出振幅比。

collocations: Bode plot of a transfer function

words.enDefinition: the material withdrawn as a product from the base of a distillation column

examples.en: The bottoms product in the diagram came from the liquid leaving the bottom of the column.
examples.zh: 图中的「塔底产品」来自塔底流出的液体。

examples.en: We compared the bottoms product with the overhead product using the two listed sample compositions.
examples.zh: 我们用列出的两种样品组成对照「塔底产品」与塔顶产品。

words.enDefinition: mechanical work associated with movement of a system boundary, such as an expanding piston face

examples.en: The expanding gas performed boundary work while the piston moved against a steady external force.
examples.zh: 活塞克服恒定外力移动时，膨胀气体做了「边界功」。

examples.en: We calculated boundary work from the area under the reversible path on the pressure-volume plot.
examples.zh: 我们用压力体积图中可逆路径下方的面积计算「边界功」。

collocations: find boundary work from a pressure-volume plot

words.enDefinition: The current assigned to a specified branch of a circuit.

examples.en: The branch current is smaller through the larger resistor in the classroom parallel circuit.
examples.zh: 课堂并联电路中，阻值较大的电阻器所在支路的「支路电流」较小。

examples.en: We wrote each branch current with its own arrow and matched variable on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上用各自的箭头和对应的变量标出每条「支路电流」。

words.enDefinition: an idealized gas turbine cycle with isentropic compression and expansion and constant-pressure heat addition and rejection

examples.en: In the ideal Brayton cycle, the compressor raises the pressure before the modeled heat addition.
examples.zh: 在理想「布雷顿循环」中，压气机在模型的加热环节之前提高工质压力。

examples.en: The plotted Brayton cycle helped us visualize how the gas gains energy before expanding through the turbine.
examples.zh: 图示「布雷顿循环」帮助我们理解气体进入涡轮膨胀前如何获得能量。

words.enDefinition: a graph showing how the outlet concentration from a fixed bed rises over time or processed volume

examples.en: The breakthrough curve rose when the modeled carbon bed no longer retained most of the incoming dye.
examples.zh: 模拟炭床不再截留进料中的大部分染料时，「穿透曲线」上升。

examples.en: We plotted the breakthrough curve using outlet concentrations recorded at successive times in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟中按时间顺序记录的出口浓度绘制「穿透曲线」。

collocations: breakthrough curve for a fixed bed

words.enDefinition: End support receiving loads from a bridge span and often retaining fill

examples.en: The bridge abutment supports the end of the short span in our sketch.
examples.zh: 我们草图中的「桥台」支承短跨的端部。

examples.en: We distinguished the bridge abutment at the bank from the intermediate pier.
examples.zh: 我们区分了岸边的「桥台」与跨间的桥墩。

words.enDefinition: Component transmitting bridge forces to supports while permitting movement as intended

examples.en: The bridge bearing lies between the deck assembly and the pier in our model.
examples.zh: 我们的模型中，「桥梁支座」位于桥面结构和桥墩之间。

examples.en: We marked the bridge bearing that allows rotation in the simplified bridge diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在桥梁简图中标出了允许转动的「桥梁支座」。

collocations: local movement at a bridge bearing

words.enDefinition: Part of a bridge that directly supports its traveled surface

examples.en: The bridge deck is the top surface assembly shown in the model.
examples.zh: 「桥面结构」是模型图上方所示的表面组件。

examples.en: We traced the arrows from the bridge deck into the supporting members below.
examples.zh: 我们沿箭头观察力如何从「桥面结构」传到下方的支承构件。

words.enDefinition: Intermediate bridge support transferring loads from adjoining spans to the foundation

examples.en: The bridge pier is the upright support between two spans in our diagram.
examples.zh: 「桥墩」是我们图中两跨之间的竖直支承。

examples.en: We marked the bridge pier below the center of the classroom bridge model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂桥梁模型的中央下方标出了「桥墩」。

words.enDefinition: Span-carrying assembly above the supports, normally including deck and main members

examples.en: The shaded parts above the piers represent the bridge superstructure in our drawing.
examples.zh: 我们图中桥墩上方带阴影的部分表示「桥梁上部结构」。

examples.en: We discussed how the bridge superstructure spans between supports in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了课堂模型中「桥梁上部结构」如何跨越各支承之间的空间。

words.enDefinition: the temperature or pressure at which an equilibrium vapor phase first appears from a liquid of specified composition

examples.en: On heating the modeled liquid at fixed pressure, the first vapor appears at its bubble point.
examples.zh: 在定压下加热模型中的液体，达到「泡点」时首次出现气相。

examples.en: We found the bubble point by locating where the liquid composition intersects the lower boundary curve.
examples.zh: 我们找到液相组成与下方边界曲线相交的位置，确定「泡点」。

words.enDefinition: The concentration used to represent the main body of a fluid away from a specified interface.

examples.en: The bulk concentration is read in the main body of the liquid in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中从液体主体部分读出「主体浓度」。

examples.en: We compared bulk concentration with the value at the wall in the classroom solution model.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂溶液模型中的「主体浓度」与壁面处的浓度。

words.enDefinition: A reference temperature representing the main fluid away from a surface or averaged over the flowing stream.

examples.en: The bulk fluid temperature represents the main water stream outside the thin near-wall region.
examples.zh: 「流体主体温度」表示近壁薄层之外主体水流的温度。

examples.en: We compared bulk fluid temperature with the temperature of the surface in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂示例中的「流体主体温度」与表面温度。

collocations: bulk fluid temperature at a location

words.enDefinition: the net upward force exerted on an immersed or floating object by a fluid in a gravitational field

examples.en: The buoyant force increased as a larger part of the test block entered the water.
examples.zh: 试验块浸入水中的部分增大时，所受「浮力」随之增大。

examples.en: The floating block rested at a depth where its buoyant force balanced its weight.
examples.zh: 漂浮块体在某个深度处保持静止，所受「浮力」与重量平衡。

words.enDefinition: The voltage drop introduced across a meter when current passes through its measuring path.

examples.en: The burden voltage is included as a small drop in the classroom model of an ammeter.
examples.zh: 课堂电流表模型把「负担电压」计为一小段压降。

examples.en: We compared burden voltage for two simulated instruments measuring the same small current in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较两台模拟仪表测量同一小电流时的「负担电压」。

words.enDefinition: The pulling force transmitted along a taut cable.

examples.en: We marked each cable tension along the line of its cable in the drawing of the ring.
examples.zh: 我们在圆环受力图上沿各自的缆索方向标出了「缆索拉力」。

examples.en: We found the cable tension by balancing its vertical component against the weight in the exercise.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们通过令竖直分量与重力平衡，求出了「缆索拉力」。

words.enDefinition: filtration in which solid particles accumulate as a permeable layer and increasingly govern the flow resistance

examples.en: The cake filtration graph showed the collected liquid accumulating more slowly as the retained solids built up.
examples.zh: 「滤饼过滤」图显示，随着被截留的固体积累，收集到的液体增长变慢。

examples.en: We compared cake filtration with a depth filter that captures particles throughout a thicker medium.
examples.zh: 我们把「滤饼过滤」与在较厚介质内部各处截留颗粒的深层过滤作比较。

words.enDefinition: Clay heat-treated to make suitable minerals reactive for use in a cementitious binder.

examples.en: The presentation identified calcined clay as the heat-treated powder used in one blended cement sample.
examples.zh: 演示文稿指出，「煅烧黏土」就是一种混合水泥样品中采用的经热处理粉料。

examples.en: We matched calcined clay to the sample description that mentioned heating a clay source before grinding.
examples.zh: 我们把「煅烧黏土」与一项样品说明对应起来，其中提到黏土经加热后粉磨。

collocations: calcined clay as a supplementary material

words.enDefinition: A document reporting calibration results and relevant information such as uncertainties and conditions.

examples.en: The sample calibration certificate listed the reference values and the uncertainty associated with each reported result.
examples.zh: 「校准证书」样例列出了参考值和各项报告结果对应的不确定度。

examples.en: We matched the instrument number on the calibration certificate with the number shown in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「校准证书」上的仪器编号与习题中显示的编号对应起来。

collocations: a result on a calibration certificate
the uncertainty on a calibration certificate

words.enDefinition: A specified reference value or setting at which a calibration comparison is made.

examples.en: The lowest calibration point corresponded to the shortest reference piece in the classroom data table.
examples.zh: 课堂数据表中，最低的「校准点」对应最短的参考件。

examples.en: We traced the calibration point on the chart back to the reading recorded for that reference length.
examples.zh: 我们根据图表上的「校准点」，找到了该参考长度对应的读数记录。

collocations: a reading at a calibration point
record data for each calibration point

words.enDefinition: A beam fixed at one end and free at the other.

examples.en: The cantilever beam model was clamped at one end and visibly free to move at the other.
examples.zh: 这根「悬臂梁」模型一端被夹住，另一端显然是自由端。

examples.en: We drew the reaction moment at the fixed end of the cantilever beam in class.
examples.zh: 课上，我们在「悬臂梁」的固定端画出了反力矩。

collocations: the free end of a cantilever beam

words.enDefinition: For an ideal linear capacitor, the magnitude of charge on one plate divided by the magnitude of voltage between the plates, in farads.

examples.en: The component with greater capacitance holds more charge at the same voltage in our classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，电压相同时，「电容」较大的元件储存更多电荷。

examples.en: We used capacitance and the given voltage to calculate charge in the simulated component.
examples.zh: 我们用「电容」和给定电压计算模拟元件上的电荷。

words.enDefinition: The contribution of an ideal capacitor to reactance, negative under the usual positive-frequency phasor convention.

examples.en: The magnitude of capacitive reactance decreases when the frequency rises in our ideal capacitor exercise.
examples.zh: 在理想电容器练习中，频率上升时，「容抗」的绝对值减小。

examples.en: We kept the sign of capacitive reactance when combining it with inductive reactance on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上合并「容抗」和感抗时，保留了容抗的正负号。

words.enDefinition: The increase in the magnitude of charge stored on a capacitor under the stated circuit conditions.

examples.en: The capacitor charging curve rises quickly at first and then levels off in the simulated example.
examples.zh: 模拟示例的「电容器充电」曲线起初上升很快，随后趋缓。

examples.en: We compared capacitor charging in two models with the same source voltage and different resistances.
examples.zh: 两个模型具有同样的电源电压和不同的电阻，我们比较了它们的「电容器充电」过程。

words.enDefinition: The decrease in the magnitude of stored charge as a capacitor releases stored energy to a circuit.

examples.en: The capacitor discharging curve approaches zero in the ideal resistor circuit shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习所示理想电阻电路的「电容器放电」曲线趋近于零。

examples.en: We compared the simulated capacitor discharging curves for two resistance values during the class discussion.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论时，我们比较了两种阻值下模拟的「电容器放电」曲线。

collocations: observe capacitor discharging in a simulation

words.enDefinition: A passive component that stores energy in an electric field between separated conductors.

examples.en: The capacitor stores energy while its voltage increases in the simulated low voltage circuit.
examples.zh: 模拟低压电路中，「电容器」两端的电压增加时逐渐储存能量。

examples.en: We identified the capacitor by the two separated plates in the circuit symbol on paper.
examples.zh: 我们根据纸上电路符号中彼此分开的两片极板识别出「电容器」。

words.enDefinition: The rule that an ideal capacitor's voltage cannot change instantaneously with finite current.

examples.en: Capacitor voltage continuity makes the initial voltage match the value just before the simulated switch changes.
examples.zh: 「电容电压连续性」使模拟开关切换后的初始电压与切换前瞬间的电压相同。

examples.en: We applied capacitor voltage continuity when comparing the two sides of the switching instant on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上比较切换瞬间前后两侧时，应用了「电容电压连续性」。

words.enDefinition: Reaction of penetrating carbon dioxide with cementitious compounds in concrete, reducing its alkalinity.

examples.en: The tutor used a cross section to show how carbonation of concrete can advance from exposed surfaces.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用横截面说明「混凝土碳化」如何从暴露表面向内发展。

examples.en: We read about carbonation of concrete in the report section that discussed changes in the binder's alkalinity.
examples.zh: 报告讨论胶结料碱度变化的部分介绍了「混凝土碳化」。

collocations: the depth of carbonation of concrete

words.enDefinition: a reversible cycle between two thermal reservoirs, with two isothermal and two adiabatic processes

examples.en: On the classroom sketch, the Carnot cycle absorbs heat along its higher-temperature isothermal branch.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图上，「卡诺循环」沿温度较高的等温支路吸热。

examples.en: We compared a practical cycle with the Carnot cycle operating between the same two reservoirs.
examples.zh: 我们把实际循环与在相同两个热库之间运行的「卡诺循环」作比较。

words.enDefinition: the maximum heat engine efficiency between two thermal reservoirs, equal to one minus the cold reservoir's absolute temperature divided by the hot reservoir's

examples.en: The Carnot efficiency fell when the hot reservoir temperature approached that of the cold reservoir.
examples.zh: 高温热库的温度向低温热库靠近时，「卡诺效率」下降。

examples.en: We converted both temperatures to kelvins before evaluating the Carnot efficiency in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先把两种温度换算成开尔文，再求「卡诺效率」。

collocations: compare measured efficiency with Carnot efficiency

words.enDefinition: Concrete placed and hardened in its final position.

examples.en: The section drawing labeled the slab as cast-in-place concrete within the shaded part of the structure.
examples.zh: 剖面图在结构的阴影区域内把板标为「现浇混凝土」。

examples.en: Our classroom timeline showed the cast-in-place concrete wall being formed and hardened in its final position.
examples.zh: 课堂时间轴显示，「现浇混凝土」墙在最终位置成形、硬化。

collocations: cast-in-place concrete shown in a section

words.enDefinition: The nodular kiln product ground with other constituents to make cement.

examples.en: The cement clinker sample looked like small gray nodules next to the finely ground cement powder.
examples.zh: 放在细磨水泥粉末旁的「水泥熟料」样品看起来像灰色小颗粒。

examples.en: Our lecturer showed where cement clinker appeared between the kiln and the grinding stage in the process chart.
examples.zh: 老师在流程图中指出了「水泥熟料」位于窑炉与粉磨阶段之间的位置。

words.enDefinition: A flowable cement-based mixture used to fill gaps, joints, or other spaces.

examples.en: The drawing labeled the thin layer beneath the model plate as cement grout in the case study.
examples.zh: 案例图将模型底板下的薄层标注为「水泥灌浆料」。

examples.en: We identified cement grout in the illustration by matching its label with the filled space below the piece.
examples.zh: 我们将标签与构件下方已填充的空间对应起来，在插图中找到了「水泥灌浆料」。

words.enDefinition: The chemical reaction of hydraulic cement with water that produces binding compounds.

examples.en: The professor used cement hydration to explain why the specimen warmed slightly after it was mixed.
examples.zh: 老师用「水泥水化」解释了为什么试样拌合后温度略有升高。

examples.en: We saw diagrams showing how cement hydration gradually changed the paste around the original particles.
examples.zh: 我们看了几幅示意图，了解「水泥水化」如何逐渐改变原有颗粒周围的浆体。

words.enDefinition: The binder phase formed by mixing cementitious material with water.

examples.en: The cement paste filled the spaces between grains in the magnified photograph of the concrete sample.
examples.zh: 混凝土样品的放大照片显示，「水泥浆体」填充了颗粒间的空隙。

examples.en: We compared fresh cement paste with the solid paste shown in the second classroom photograph.
examples.zh: 我们把新拌「水泥浆体」与第二张课堂照片里的固态浆体进行了比较。

collocations: the bond between cement paste and aggregate

words.enDefinition: A material that contributes to the binding and strength of a cement-based mixture through chemical reaction.

examples.en: The table listed each cementitious material beneath the binder heading on the sample mix sheet.
examples.zh: 示例配合比表在胶结料一栏下列出了各种「胶凝材料」。

examples.en: We discussed why a cementitious material could affect the strength of the hardened paste in the report.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了报告中的「胶凝材料」为什么会影响硬化浆体的强度。

words.enDefinition: Position obtained by averaging the locations of mass with mass-based weights

examples.en: The uneven plate's center of mass lies nearer the side with more material.
examples.zh: 不均匀平板的「质心」更靠近材料较多的一侧。

examples.en: We tracked the center of mass separately from the marked point on the rotating rim.
examples.zh: 我们分别追踪了「质心」和转动轮缘上的标记点。

collocations: motion of the center of mass

words.enDefinition: A drawing line marking an axis, center, or line of symmetry.

examples.en: The centerline passed through the middle of both round holes in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸上的「中心线」穿过两个圆孔的中心。

examples.en: We used the centerline to locate the position of each slot relative to the model's symmetry.
examples.zh: 我们用「中心线」确定各个槽相对于模型对称轴的位置。

collocations: mark the centerline of a hole

words.enDefinition: separation in a rotating system where components move differently under centrifugal effects due to differences such as density or size

examples.en: The centrifugal separation diagram places the denser droplets farther from the center of rotation in the model.
examples.zh: 「离心分离」图中，模型里较密的液滴距旋转中心更远。

examples.en: We compared centrifugal separation with gravity settling using illustrations of the same model suspension in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用同一种模拟悬浮液的示意图比较「离心分离」与重力沉降。

words.enDefinition: Inward acceleration component directed toward the center of curvature of a path

examples.en: A point on the rim has centripetal acceleration even during rotation at constant speed.
examples.zh: 即使匀速转动，轮缘上的一个点也有「向心加速度」。

examples.en: The arrow for centripetal acceleration points directly toward the center of the circular path.
examples.zh: 「向心加速度」的箭头直接指向圆形路径的中心。

words.enDefinition: Mechanism transmitting rotation between toothed wheels using a moving chain

examples.en: The chain drive in our diagram connects two toothed wheels across an open space.
examples.zh: 图中的「链传动」跨过一段间隔，连接两个有齿的轮子。

examples.en: We compared a chain drive with a smooth belt in our transmission exercise.
examples.zh: 在传动练习中，我们把「链传动」与光面皮带作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Drop in channel bed elevation per unit horizontal distance downstream

examples.en: The channel bed slope is marked by the lower line in the side view.
examples.zh: 侧视图中的下方线条标示了「渠底坡度」。

examples.en: We compared channel bed slope values across two hypothetical channel reaches on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较了习题中两段假想渠道的「渠底坡度」。

collocations: channel bed slope in a profile

words.enDefinition: in an enhancement-mode MOSFET, the creation of a conducting inversion layer between source and drain by the gate field

examples.en: The band sketch associates channel formation with the appearance of an inversion layer below the gate.
examples.zh: 能带示意图把「沟道形成」与栅下反型层的出现联系起来。

examples.en: We used a sequence of carrier density plots to illustrate channel formation in the transistor model.
examples.zh: 我们用一系列载流子密度图展示晶体管模型中的「沟道形成」。

words.enDefinition: a mobile particle or quasiparticle, such as an electron or hole, that contributes to current

examples.en: In the model, either a conduction electron or a hole can act as a charge carrier.
examples.zh: 在模型里，导带电子和空穴都可以充当「载流子」。

examples.en: The electric field changes the average drift velocity of each type of charge carrier in the sample.
examples.zh: 电场改变了样品中每类「载流子」的平均漂移速度。

words.enDefinition: The movement of chloride ions from the environment into concrete.

examples.en: The report discussed chloride ingress after showing measurements at several depths below the exposed concrete surface.
examples.zh: 报告先展示混凝土暴露表面以下不同深度的测量数据，再讨论「氯离子侵入」。

examples.en: We located the graph of chloride ingress in the section about concrete samples exposed to saltwater.
examples.zh: 我们在关于接触盐水的混凝土试样一节中找到了「氯离子侵入」的图表。

words.enDefinition: Member forming part of the top or bottom boundary of a truss

examples.en: The instructor highlighted the upper chord of a truss in the side view of the model.
examples.zh: 老师在模型侧视图中标出了上部的「桁架弦杆」。

examples.en: We labeled each chord of a truss before adding the diagonal members to our sketch.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各根「桁架弦杆」，再在草图中加入斜杆。

collocations: forces in a chord of a truss

words.enDefinition: a record of a chromatography run, often showing detector response against time or retention volume

examples.en: The chromatogram showed two peaks because the detector registered both pigments leaving at different times.
examples.zh: 「色谱图」显示两个峰，因为检测器记录到两种色素在不同时间流出。

examples.en: We labeled the horizontal axis of the chromatogram in minutes before reading the peak positions.
examples.zh: 读取峰位置之前，我们将「色谱图」横轴的单位标为分钟。

words.enDefinition: separation based on different components moving at different rates because they interact differently with stationary and mobile phases

examples.en: The chromatographic separation produced different colored bands from the ink mixture in the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 在课堂演示中，墨水混合物经「色谱分离」形成了颜色不同的条带。

examples.en: We interpreted the chromatographic separation by comparing how far the two colored spots moved on paper.
examples.zh: 我们通过对照两个色斑在纸上移动的距离，解读「色谱分离」结果。

words.enDefinition: A connection between two circuit nodes containing an element or a series path with one current.

examples.en: The upper circuit branch contains a single resistor in the drawing given to the class.
examples.zh: 提供给全班的图中，上方的「电路支路」含一个电阻器。

examples.en: We labelled each circuit branch with the current variable shown in the worksheet legend.
examples.zh: 我们用练习图例里的电流变量标注各条「电路支路」。

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing circuit elements and their connections with conventional symbols.

examples.en: The circuit diagram shows two resistors sharing the same pair of electrical nodes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「电路图」显示两个电阻器接在同一对电路节点之间。

examples.en: We redrew the circuit diagram without changing the connections between its labelled components.
examples.zh: 我们重画了「电路图」，同时保持标注元件之间的连接不变。

words.enDefinition: A closed loop containing no smaller loops inside it in a planar circuit diagram.

examples.en: The circuit mesh on the left contains one source and two resistors in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图左侧的「电路网孔」包含一个电源和两个电阻器。

examples.en: We identified each circuit mesh before assigning arrows to the independent loop currents in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先识别每个「电路网孔」，再为各独立回路电流画箭头。

words.enDefinition: A point or set of ideally connected points sharing the same potential in a circuit model.

examples.en: Several component terminals share one circuit node in the ideal three-branch example on the board.
examples.zh: 白板上的理想三支路示例中，几个元件端子共用一个「电路节点」。

examples.en: We marked each circuit node before writing the current equations for the textbook network.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各个「电路节点」，再写出教材电路的电流方程。

words.enDefinition: The pattern of how circuit elements are interconnected, independent of their physical arrangement.

examples.en: The circuit topology stays unchanged when the same branches are rearranged on the worksheet page.
examples.zh: 在练习纸上重新排布同样的支路时，「电路拓扑」保持不变。

examples.en: We compared the circuit topology of the two drawings before attempting any numerical calculations.
examples.zh: 在进行数值计算之前，我们先比较了两张图的「电路拓扑」。

words.enDefinition: a vessel that produces clearer liquid by allowing suspended solids to settle and be collected separately

examples.en: The clarifier model has a liquid overflow at the top and a solids outlet below.
examples.zh: 「澄清池」模型在上方设液体溢流口，下方设固体出口。

examples.en: We traced both streams leaving the clarifier in the flow sheet for the classroom water example.
examples.zh: 在课堂水处理流程图上，我们追踪了离开「澄清池」的两股物流。

words.enDefinition: the second-law result that the cyclic integral of heat entering a system divided by boundary temperature cannot be positive

examples.en: The Clausius inequality becomes an equality for the reversible cycle used as our reference case.
examples.zh: 我们以可逆循环作为参考情形，此时「克劳修斯不等式」取等号。

examples.en: We applied the Clausius inequality after choosing heat entering the system as positive in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中先以进入系统的热量为正，我们随后应用「克劳修斯不等式」。

words.enDefinition: A masonry unit made from clay that is shaped and fired.

examples.en: The tray held a fired clay brick beside a concrete block for the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 托盘里放着一块烧制的「黏土砖」和一块混凝土砌块供课堂比较。

examples.en: We recognized the clay brick because its description mentioned shaping and firing the source material.
examples.zh: 我们根据说明中提到原料经过成型和烧制，认出了这件「黏土砖」。

words.enDefinition: A fit whose permitted dimensions allow mating parts to assemble without dimensional interference.

examples.en: The example used a clearance fit so the paper tube sat loosely inside its outer ring.
examples.zh: 例题采用「间隙配合」，让纸管可以较松地套在外环里。

examples.en: We identified the clearance fit after comparing the allowed sizes in the classroom drawing's table.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图样表格中的允许尺寸后，认出了「间隙配合」。

collocations: a clearance fit between mating parts

words.enDefinition: A moment tending to rotate a body clockwise in the stated view.

examples.en: We marked the downward load on the right as producing a clockwise moment about the center.
examples.zh: 我们标注出右侧向下的载荷会对中心产生「顺时针力矩」。

examples.en: The clockwise moment received a negative sign under the convention written at the top of our worksheet.
examples.zh: 按照习题顶部的符号约定，我们给「顺时针力矩」记负号。

collocations: assign a sign to a clockwise moment

words.enDefinition: A path in a circuit diagram that returns to its starting node.

examples.en: We followed one closed circuit loop in the drawing and returned to the same labelled node.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中的一条「闭合回路」走一圈，回到同一标记节点。

examples.en: The closed circuit loop in the worksheet includes the source and both of the series resistors.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「闭合回路」包括电源和两个串联电阻器。

collocations: voltage changes around a closed circuit loop

words.enDefinition: control that uses measured output feedback to determine the action applied to a system

examples.en: The thermostat example shows closed-loop control because a temperature reading influences the next heating command.
examples.zh: 温控器示例中，温度读数会影响下一次加热指令，体现了「闭环控制」。

examples.en: We tested closed-loop control in simulation by changing the outside temperature and observing the indoor response.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中改变室外温度、观察室内温度响应，测试「闭环控制」。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of output to input for a system operating with its feedback path connected

examples.en: We measured closed-loop gain after the output signal was fed back through the resistor network.
examples.zh: 输出信号经电阻网络返回后，我们测量了「闭环增益」。

examples.en: The closed-loop gain stayed nearly constant when the model varied the amplifier's internal gain slightly.
examples.zh: 模型略微改变放大器的内部增益时，「闭环增益」几乎保持不变。

words.enDefinition: a system across whose boundary energy can pass but matter cannot

examples.en: The sealed flask served as a closed thermodynamic system while its contents warmed in a bath.
examples.zh: 密封烧瓶内的物质在浴液中升温时，烧瓶可作为「闭口热力学系统」。

examples.en: We accounted for heat and work crossing the boundary of the closed thermodynamic system.
examples.zh: 我们计入了穿过「闭口热力学系统」边界的热量和功。

collocations: apply the first law to a closed thermodynamic system

words.enDefinition: The larger aggregate particles in a mixture, such as gravel or crushed stone.

examples.en: We could see the coarse aggregate in the cut sample because the larger stones were exposed.
examples.zh: 剖开的样品露出较大的石粒，因此我们能看到「粗集料」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to distinguish the coarse aggregate from the cement paste in the photograph.
examples.zh: 习题让我们在照片中区分「粗集料」和水泥浆。

words.enDefinition: contact in which two phases or streams move in the same overall direction

examples.en: Both arrows run downward through the classroom device, indicating cocurrent contact between the two phases.
examples.zh: 课堂设备图中两支箭头都朝下，表示两相进行「并流接触」。

examples.en: We highlighted the shared inlet end of the device in the example of cocurrent contact.
examples.zh: 我们在「并流接触」示例中突出显示设备的共同入口端。

words.enDefinition: Square of D30 divided by the product of D10 and D60

examples.en: The coefficient of curvature uses the particle sizes at ten, thirty, and sixty percent passing.
examples.zh: 「曲率系数」使用通过率分别为百分之十、三十和六十的三个粒径。

examples.en: We squared the intermediate size before calculating the coefficient of curvature in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上计算「曲率系数」之前，我们先将中间的特征粒径平方。

collocations: particle sizes for the coefficient of curvature

words.enDefinition: the desired heating or cooling rate divided by the required power input for a heat pump or refrigerator

examples.en: The refrigerator's coefficient of performance exceeded one because the cooling rate was greater than its input power.
examples.zh: 制冷速率大于输入功率，所以冰箱的「性能系数」大于一。

examples.en: We compared each coefficient of performance by dividing the indoor heat delivery rate by its input power.
examples.zh: 我们用各设备的室内供热速率除以相应输入功率，比较「性能系数」。

words.enDefinition: Ratio of separation speed to approach speed along the line of impact

examples.en: We found the coefficient of restitution using the two relative speeds of the colliding carts.
examples.zh: 我们用相碰小车的接近和分离相对速率求出了「恢复系数」。

examples.en: The coefficient of restitution was zero in the example where both carts stayed together.
examples.zh: 在两辆小车碰后粘在一起的例子中，「恢复系数」为零。

collocations: coefficient of restitution for an impact

words.enDefinition: The ratio of maximum static friction force to normal force for the contacting surfaces.

examples.en: The exercise gave the coefficient of static friction for the two surfaces in the sketch.
examples.zh: 题目给出了图中两个接触面之间的「静摩擦系数」。

examples.en: We multiplied the normal force by the coefficient of static friction to find the limiting friction force.
examples.zh: 我们将法向力乘以「静摩擦系数」，求得极限摩擦力。

collocations: measure the coefficient of static friction
estimate the coefficient of static friction
use the coefficient of static friction

words.enDefinition: Ratio of the sixty-percent-finer grain size to the ten-percent-finer grain size

examples.en: We calculated the coefficient of uniformity from two points on the particle size curve.
examples.zh: 我们从粒径曲线上读取两个点并计算了「不均匀系数」。

examples.en: A larger coefficient of uniformity indicates a wider spread between the two specified sizes.
examples.zh: 「不均匀系数」越大，所指定的两个粒径相差的倍数越大。

words.enDefinition: current through the collector terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The collector current varied little with collector voltage in the forward-active region at fixed base current.
examples.zh: 在基极电流固定的正向有源区，「集电极电流」随集电极电压的变化很小。

examples.en: We read the collector current at the marked bias point on the transistor characteristic curves.
examples.zh: 我们在晶体管特性曲线上读出标定偏置点处的「集电极电流」。

collocations: collector current at the bias point

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action coincide along the same straight line.

examples.en: The two cords pulled along the same straight line, so we added their collinear forces algebraically.
examples.zh: 两根绳子沿同一直线拉动，因此我们把这两个「共线力」作代数相加。

examples.en: We drew collinear forces pointing in opposite directions at the two ends of the bar.
examples.zh: 我们在杆件两端画出方向相反的两个「共线力」。

words.enDefinition: solid inserts in a column that create wetted surfaces for contact between gas and liquid

examples.en: The open spaces in the column packing let gas move between the wetted surfaces in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，气体经「塔填料」的空隙在润湿表面之间流动。

examples.en: We identified the column packing in the cutaway picture rather than mistaking it for a filter layer.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出剖视图中的「塔填料」，并区分了填料和过滤层。

words.enDefinition: a horizontal internal platform where vapor and liquid contact in a staged column

examples.en: The column tray drawing shows vapor rising through openings beneath the liquid layer in the model.
examples.zh: 「塔板」图显示，模型中的蒸气经液层下方的开孔向上流动。

examples.en: We identified a column tray as the contacting platform rather than the whole stage assembly in the sketch.
examples.zh: 示意图中，我们把作为接触平台的部件认作「塔板」，并区分它与整套级组件。

collocations: vapor passing through a column tray

words.enDefinition: a field-effect transistor amplifier with input at the gate, output at the drain and source as the common reference

examples.en: The output of the unloaded common-source amplifier fell when the simulated gate voltage rose slightly.
examples.zh: 模拟栅极电压略微升高时，空载「共源极放大器」的输出下降。

examples.en: We identified the shared source node before explaining the name of the common-source amplifier in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出公共源极节点，再解释「共源极放大器」这一名称。

collocations: small-signal model of a common-source amplifier

words.enDefinition: a circuit with output states that indicate which of two input voltages is greater

examples.en: The comparator switched its output state whenever the sensor signal crossed the fixed reference voltage in simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，传感器信号每次跨越固定参考电压，「比较器」的输出状态就切换。

examples.en: We plotted both input voltages to see why the comparator output remained low between the two crossings.
examples.zh: 我们绘出两个输入电压，理解「比较器」输出为何在两次交越之间保持低电平。

words.enDefinition: Equation ensuring related displacements satisfy geometric connections and support constraints

examples.en: The compatibility equation sets the computed displacement to zero at the ideal support.
examples.zh: 「变形协调方程」将理想支座处的计算位移设为零。

examples.en: We wrote a compatibility equation to make the two connected points move together.
examples.zh: 我们写出一个「变形协调方程」，使两个相连点的位移一致。

words.enDefinition: A material balance tracking one specified component through a system.

examples.en: The component balance follows only the dissolved sugar in the diagram on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「组分衡算」只追踪溶解的糖。

examples.en: We wrote a component balance for water before comparing it with the total mass balance.
examples.zh: 我们先为水列写「组分衡算」，再将其与总质量衡算作比较。

words.enDefinition: The amount of a particular component present within the system boundary at a specified time.

examples.en: The component inventory shows how much salt is inside the model vessel at the recorded instant.
examples.zh: 「组分存量」表示在记录时刻模型容器里的盐量。

examples.en: We compared the component inventory at two times before calculating the change in stored salt.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两个时刻的「组分存量」，再算容器中存盐量的变化。

words.enDefinition: The mass of one component carried by a stream per unit time.

examples.en: The component mass flow rate for sugar is part of the stream's total mass flow rate.
examples.zh: 糖的「组分质量流率」是该股物流总质量流率的一部分。

examples.en: We used the component mass flow rate when writing the sugar balance for the outlet.
examples.zh: 我们列写出口物流的糖衡算时，用到了「组分质量流率」。

collocations: calculate a component mass flow rate
component mass flow rate of water
component mass flow rate in a stream

words.enDefinition: the fraction of a component in a feed that is obtained in a designated product stream

examples.en: The chart shows component recovery rising as more of the feed sugar reached the selected product.
examples.zh: 更多进料糖分进入所选产品时，图中的「组分回收率」随之上升。

examples.en: We calculated component recovery using the amount of salt in the product and its initial feed amount.
examples.zh: 我们用产品中的盐量和最初的进料盐量计算「组分回收率」。

words.enDefinition: A cross-section analyzed as a combination of simpler shapes or materials.

examples.en: We divided the composite cross-section into three rectangles before finding its overall centroid in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们先将「组合截面」分成三个矩形，再求整体形心。

examples.en: The tutor drew each piece of the composite cross-section in a different color on the board.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在黑板上用不同颜色画出「组合截面」的各个部分。

collocations: the centroid of a composite cross-section
divide a composite cross-section into parts

words.enDefinition: A wall model consisting of layers of different materials through which heat can be conducted.

examples.en: The composite wall has two different material layers between the warm and cool sides in class.
examples.zh: 课堂里的「多层复合壁」在暖侧和冷侧之间含两层不同材料。

examples.en: We marked each material boundary in the composite wall before drawing its temperature profile.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「多层复合壁」各材料间的边界，再画温度分布。

collocations: heat conduction through a composite wall

words.enDefinition: the actual molar volume divided by the ideal gas molar volume at the same temperature and pressure

examples.en: A compressibility factor near one supported the ideal gas approximation for our low-pressure sample.
examples.zh: 「压缩因子」接近一，支持把我们的低压样品近似成理想气体。

examples.en: We used the compressibility factor to correct the volume predicted by the ideal gas law.
examples.zh: 我们用「压缩因子」修正理想气体定律预测的体积。

collocations: correct an ideal prediction with the compressibility factor

words.enDefinition: flow in which changes in fluid density are important to its behavior and must be represented

examples.en: The second simulation used compressible flow because the gas density changed appreciably along the modeled passage.
examples.zh: 第二个模拟采用「可压缩流动」模型，因为气体密度沿流道有明显变化。

examples.en: We retained density in the mass balance when comparing two sections of the compressible flow example.
examples.zh: 比较「可压缩流动」示例中的两个截面时，我们在质量平衡式中保留密度项。

words.enDefinition: A force tending to compress a member by pushing toward its interior.

examples.en: The compressive force in our example pushed inward at the end of the model bar.
examples.zh: 例题中的「压缩力」从模型杆的端部向内推压。

examples.en: We showed the compressive force by pointing the two end arrows toward the center of the member.
examples.zh: 我们用两端指向杆件中心的箭头表示「压缩力」。

collocations: a compressive force along the axis

words.enDefinition: The greatest compressive stress a concrete specimen sustains under a stated test method.

examples.en: The worksheet listed the compressive strength of concrete beside pictures of the two broken specimens.
examples.zh: 习题在两个破坏试件的图片旁列出了「混凝土抗压强度」。

examples.en: We recorded the specimen shape before comparing the compressive strength of concrete from two test reports.
examples.zh: 比较两份报告中的「混凝土抗压强度」前，我们先记录了试件形状。

collocations: report the compressive strength of concrete
measure the compressive strength of concrete
compare the compressive strength of concrete samples

words.enDefinition: Normal stress that tends to press material together across a section.

examples.en: We marked compressive stress on one side of the neutral axis in the beam sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在梁草图中标出了中性轴一侧的「压应力」。

examples.en: A larger cross-sectional area gave a smaller average compressive stress for the same force in our example.
examples.zh: 在例题中，力的大小相同，横截面积越大，平均「压应力」越小。

words.enDefinition: mechanical work supplied to a compressor to raise the pressure of a flowing gas

examples.en: Our energy balance includes compressor work input because the refrigerant enters the compressor at a lower pressure.
examples.zh: 制冷剂以较低压力进入压缩机，因此我们的能量平衡计入「压缩机输入功」。

examples.en: We read the compressor work input from the component results in the steady flow simulation.
examples.zh: 我们从稳态流动模拟的部件结果中读取了「压缩机输入功」。

words.enDefinition: The stated reference quantity used to express how much of a component is present.

examples.en: The concentration basis is stated as mass per volume in the classroom table of sugar solutions.
examples.zh: 课堂糖溶液表里，「浓度基准」注明为质量除以体积。

examples.en: We checked the concentration basis before comparing two labels printed on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「浓度基准」，再比较练习纸上印出的两个标签。

words.enDefinition: A region near an interface where concentration changes from an interfacial value toward a bulk value.

examples.en: The concentration boundary layer marks where the dissolved sugar level changes close to the model surface.
examples.zh: 「浓度边界层」标出靠近模型表面且溶解糖浓度发生变化的区域。

examples.en: We drew the concentration boundary layer separately from the thermal layer in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂草图上把「浓度边界层」与热边界层分开绘制。

collocations: concentration boundary layer near a surface
profile in a concentration boundary layer

words.enDefinition: The spatial rate and direction of concentration increase, represented as a vector.

examples.en: The concentration gradient points toward the higher sugar concentration in the example's one-dimensional drawing.
examples.zh: 在示例的一维图中，「浓度梯度」指向糖浓度较高的方向。

examples.en: We compared the concentration gradient at two marked locations on the classroom solution profile.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂溶液分布图中两个标记位置的「浓度梯度」。

words.enDefinition: a concentration difference between the membrane surface and nearby bulk liquid caused by selective transport

examples.en: The concentration polarization plot showed salt concentration near the membrane exceeding that of the bulk solution.
examples.zh: 「浓差极化」图显示，膜附近的盐浓度超过主体溶液的盐浓度。

examples.en: We distinguished concentration polarization in the adjacent liquid from material adhering to the membrane itself.
examples.zh: 我们区分了邻近液体里的「浓差极化」与物质附着在膜表面这两种现象。

words.enDefinition: The stage of generating and refining candidate solutions for a design problem.

examples.en: During concept development, we explored three ways to arrange the compartments in the small cardboard tray.
examples.zh: 在「设计概念开发」阶段，我们探索了小纸板托盘的三种分格方式。

examples.en: The journal kept our early model photos together with the sketches from concept development.
examples.zh: 日志把早期模型照片与「设计概念开发」阶段的草图放在一起留存。

words.enDefinition: The process of choosing among candidate design concepts using stated criteria.

examples.en: We kept all three sketches until concept selection, when we compared them against the same criteria.
examples.zh: 我们保留了三幅草图，到了「设计概念筛选」阶段才按同一套准则比较。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to explain how accessibility influenced concept selection for the classroom storage model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们解释易用的取放方式如何影响课堂收纳模型的「设计概念筛选」。

words.enDefinition: An early drawing used to communicate the main idea of a possible design.

examples.en: My concept sketch showed the tray from above and included arrows for the removable dividers.
examples.zh: 我的「概念草图」从上方画出托盘，并用箭头指出可拆卸隔板。
