examples.en: The team added notes to the concept sketch after another group asked how the parts fitted together.
examples.zh: 另一组同学问部件如何拼合后，我们在「概念草图」上补了说明。

words.enDefinition: An ingredient other than water, aggregate, or cementitious material added to modify concrete properties.

examples.en: The mix sheet named a concrete admixture and showed its intended effect on the fresh mixture.
examples.zh: 配合比表列明一种「混凝土外加剂」，并说明希望它对新拌混合料起到什么作用。

examples.en: The lecturer asked why the small bottle was labeled as a concrete admixture in the display.
examples.zh: 老师问，展台上的小瓶为什么标成「混凝土外加剂」。

collocations: the purpose of a concrete admixture

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a concrete sample's volume occupied by air voids.

examples.en: We entered concrete air content in the table as a percentage of the sample's total volume.
examples.zh: 我们在表中把「混凝土含气量」填成占试样总体积的百分比。

examples.en: The laboratory chart compared concrete air content for two fresh samples that looked similar at first.
examples.zh: 实验图比较了两种起初看起来相似的新拌试样的「混凝土含气量」。

collocations: a difference in concrete air content

words.enDefinition: A quantity of concrete produced together from one set of measured ingredients.

examples.en: One concrete batch supplied three classroom samples, so their labels shared the same reference number.
examples.zh: 三个课堂样品来自同一「混凝土拌合批次」，因此标签上的参考编号相同。

examples.en: We linked each concrete batch to the relevant mix entry in the laboratory's shared table.
examples.zh: 我们在实验室共用表上将各个「混凝土拌合批次」与相应的配合比条目联系起来。

words.enDefinition: The process of compacting fresh concrete to reduce entrapped air and fill spaces.

examples.en: The classroom diagram showed fewer large pockets after concrete consolidation in the pictured specimen.
examples.zh: 课堂图示显示，试样经过「混凝土密实」后，大气孔变少了。

examples.en: We read a note about concrete consolidation when interpreting the voids along the edge of the sample.
examples.zh: 解释试样边缘孔洞时，我们阅读了一则关于「混凝土密实」的说明。

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical sample removed from already hardened concrete for examination or testing.

examples.en: The report used a concrete core sample to show the visible layers inside the existing slab.
examples.zh: 报告通过「混凝土芯样」展示现有板件内部可见的层次。

examples.en: Our class compared a concrete core sample with a cylinder that had been made in a mold.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们将「混凝土芯样」与在模具中制作的圆柱试件进行比较。

collocations: strength results for a concrete core sample

words.enDefinition: The thickness of concrete between its surface and the nearest surface of embedded reinforcement.

examples.en: The section drawing marked concrete cover as the gap from the outer face to the nearest steel.
examples.zh: 剖面图用外表面至最近钢筋表面的距离表示「混凝土保护层」厚度。

examples.en: We highlighted concrete cover in the drawing while reading the case about reinforcement durability.
examples.zh: 阅读钢筋耐久性案例时，我们在图上高亮了「混凝土保护层」。

words.enDefinition: Gradual additional deformation in hardened concrete under sustained stress.

examples.en: The graph showed concrete creep as the specimen continued deforming while the load remained the same.
examples.zh: 尽管载荷保持不变，图中试样仍继续变形，显示出「混凝土徐变」。

examples.en: We separated the immediate displacement from the later change associated with concrete creep in the example.
examples.zh: 我们区分例题中的即时位移和随后与「混凝土徐变」相关的变形。

collocations: the time dependence of concrete creep

words.enDefinition: A cube-shaped concrete sample made for a material test, commonly compressive strength.

examples.en: We recognized the concrete cube specimen in the photograph because it had six square faces.
examples.zh: 照片里的「混凝土立方体试件」有六个正方形面，我们据此认出了它。

examples.en: The lab worksheet listed the concrete cube specimen in a separate row from the cylindrical sample.
examples.zh: 实验习题将「混凝土立方体试件」与圆柱形试样分行列出。

collocations: results for a concrete cube specimen

words.enDefinition: The development of solid structure and mechanical strength as the binder reacts over time.

examples.en: We tracked concrete hardening in the example by comparing strength results from specimens tested at different ages.
examples.zh: 例题中，我们用不同龄期试样的强度结果来追踪「混凝土硬化」。

examples.en: The instructor drew a timeline to show how concrete hardening continued beyond the marked setting points.
examples.zh: 老师用时间轴说明在图示凝结点之后「混凝土硬化」仍会继续。

words.enDefinition: A weak surface layer of cement and fine particles deposited by upward water movement in fresh concrete.

examples.en: The report described the pale surface film as concrete laitance after examining the cut sample photograph.
examples.zh: 报告查看试样剖面照片后，将浅色表层描述为「混凝土浮浆」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to concrete laitance when explaining the difference between surface material and the paste below.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指着「混凝土浮浆」，说明表面材料与下方浆体的不同。

words.enDefinition: A solid or hollow manufactured concrete unit used to build masonry.

examples.en: The classroom concrete masonry unit had two open cells that were easy to see from above.
examples.zh: 从上面看，课堂展示的「混凝土砌块」有两个清晰可见的开孔。

examples.en: We identified the concrete masonry unit in the section before labeling the spaces between adjacent blocks.
examples.zh: 我们先在剖面图上找出「混凝土砌块」，再标记相邻砌块之间的空隙。

collocations: the cells of a concrete masonry unit

words.enDefinition: A project form documenting a particular concrete placement and its related checks.

examples.en: The example concrete pour card listed the location of the placement discussed in our classroom case study.
examples.zh: 示例「混凝土浇筑记录卡」列出了课堂案例所讨论的浇筑位置。

examples.en: We matched the concrete pour card in the exercise to the area identified in the project notes.
examples.zh: 我们把练习中的「混凝土浇筑记录卡」与项目说明中标出的区域对应起来。

collocations: the location on a concrete pour card

words.enDefinition: Separation of fresh concrete constituents that makes their distribution uneven.

examples.en: The tray photograph showed concrete segregation where large stones had collected away from the wetter paste.
examples.zh: 托盘照片中，大石粒聚集在远离较湿浆体的地方，显示出「混凝土离析」。

examples.en: We looked for concrete segregation in the classroom images by checking whether the mixture still appeared uniform.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂图片中的混合料是否仍然均匀，以判断有无「混凝土离析」。

words.enDefinition: The vertical decrease in fresh concrete height measured in a cone test.

examples.en: The chart reported concrete slump as the vertical drop of the sample shown in the photograph.
examples.zh: 图表用照片中试样竖向下沉的高度表示「混凝土坍落度」。

examples.en: We compared the recorded concrete slump values from two mixtures in the same set of laboratory notes.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一份实验记录中两种混合料的「混凝土坍落度」。

words.enDefinition: The breaking away of pieces from a hardened concrete surface or edge.

examples.en: The inspector's example photo showed concrete spalling where a piece had broken away from the corner.
examples.zh: 检查记录的示例照片显示，角部脱落一块材料，形成了「混凝土剥落」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked us to mark concrete spalling on the drawing before comparing the images.
examples.zh: 习题让我们先在图上标出「混凝土剥落」，再比较各张图片。

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical concrete specimen prepared for measuring a material property, commonly compressive strength.

examples.en: Each concrete test cylinder in the photo carried the batch identifier used in the results table.
examples.zh: 照片中的每件「混凝土圆柱试件」都标有结果表使用的批次编号。

examples.en: Our tutor passed around a concrete test cylinder so we could recognize its shape in reports.
examples.zh: 辅导老师传看一个「混凝土圆柱试件」，让我们能在报告中认出这种形状。

collocations: results for a concrete test cylinder

words.enDefinition: How readily fresh concrete can be mixed, placed, consolidated, and finished while remaining uniform.

examples.en: We discussed concrete workability when comparing how readily two fresh mixtures filled the same classroom model.
examples.zh: 比较两种新拌料填满同一课堂模型的难易程度时，我们讨论了「混凝土和易性」。

examples.en: The report discussed concrete workability separately from strength because the words described different stages of the material.
examples.zh: 报告将「混凝土和易性」与强度分开讨论，因为这两个词描述材料的不同阶段。

collocations: concrete workability in a fresh mix

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action pass through one common point.

examples.en: The extensions of the three arrows met at one point, so they represented concurrent forces.
examples.zh: 三个箭头的延长线交于一点，因此它们表示「汇交力」。

examples.en: The tutor used the concurrent forces at the small ring to review horizontal and vertical equilibrium.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用作用在小圆环上的「汇交力」复习水平和竖直方向的平衡。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal of resistance for a resistor or a resistive path, measured in siemens.

examples.en: The branch with the smaller resistance has the larger conductance in the simplified textbook circuit.
examples.zh: 教材简化电路里，电阻较小的支路有较大的「电导」。

examples.en: We used conductance when adding the contributions of the parallel branches in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「电导」来相加示例中各并联支路的贡献。

words.enDefinition: A conclusion about whether specified requirements are met under a stated decision rule.

examples.en: The exercise showed how uncertainty could affect a conformance decision when the result was near a limit.
examples.zh: 练习表明，结果接近极限值时，不确定度可能影响「符合性判定」。

examples.en: We recorded the conformance decision alongside the reason given in the instructor's hypothetical example.
examples.zh: 我们记录了辅导老师假设例题中的「符合性判定」及其理由。

collocations: a decision rule for a conformance decision

words.enDefinition: Constant angular momentum about a fixed point when external moment vanishes there

examples.en: We used conservation of angular momentum to explain why the model spins faster as mass moves inward.
examples.zh: 我们用「角动量守恒」说明质量向轴线移近时，模型为什么转得更快。

examples.en: We assumed conservation of angular momentum about the vertical axis because the external moment was negligible.
examples.zh: 由于绕竖直轴的外力矩可忽略，我们假定绕该轴的「角动量守恒」。

words.enDefinition: Constant total momentum of a system when net external force is zero

examples.en: We used conservation of linear momentum for two carts with negligible external impulse during their interaction.
examples.zh: 两辆小车相互作用期间，外力冲量可忽略，因此我们使用了「线动量守恒」。

examples.en: The model illustrates conservation of linear momentum by comparing total momentum before and after contact.
examples.zh: 模型通过比较接触前后的总动量来说明「线动量守恒」。

words.enDefinition: An identifiable substance assumed not to react, form, or disappear within the modelled system.

examples.en: The fictional dye serves as a conservative tracer in the water diagram on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 虚构染料在练习水流程图里用作「守恒示踪物」。

examples.en: We tracked the conservative tracer entering and leaving the water region in the simplified classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 在简化的课堂练习中，我们追踪了进出水域的「守恒示踪物」。

words.enDefinition: A supply mode in which the output current stays at the set value within available limits.

examples.en: The constant-current mode indicator appears when the simulated supply holds its output at the selected current.
examples.zh: 模拟电源将输出保持在设定电流时，会出现「恒流模式」指示。

examples.en: We compared constant-current mode with the model that holds its output voltage fixed in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了「恒流模式」与维持输出电压恒定的模型。

words.enDefinition: A condition in which the total stored amount stays unchanged even if material enters and leaves.

examples.en: Constant holdup results in the model when the total incoming and outgoing mass rates match.
examples.zh: 模型里，总流入和总流出质量速率相同时，实现「恒定持有量」。

examples.en: We showed that constant holdup can coexist with a changing salt fraction in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们说明练习中「恒定持有量」可与变化的盐质量分数并存。

collocations: maintain constant holdup in a model

words.enDefinition: a thermodynamic process in which the pressure of the system remains constant

examples.en: The constant-pressure process appeared as a horizontal line on the pressure-volume graph used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂使用的压力体积图上，「定压过程」表现为一条水平线。

examples.en: We tracked how the gas volume changed with temperature during the constant-pressure process in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例的「定压过程」中，我们追踪气体体积如何随温度变化。

words.enDefinition: the derivative of specific enthalpy with respect to temperature at constant pressure

examples.en: The air model used constant-pressure specific heat to estimate the enthalpy change across the heater.
examples.zh: 空气模型用「定压比热容」估算流体通过加热器时的焓变。

examples.en: We integrated the constant-pressure specific heat over temperature because its tabulated values changed appreciably.
examples.zh: 因为表中的「定压比热容」随温度变化明显，我们对温度积分。

words.enDefinition: A supply mode in which the output voltage stays at the set value within available limits.

examples.en: The constant-voltage mode indicator is active in the first low-voltage supply screenshot shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的第一张低压电源截图中，「恒压模式」指示亮起。

examples.en: We used constant-voltage mode to explain why the model output voltage stayed fixed in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「恒压模式」解释为什么示例中模型的输出电压保持不变。

words.enDefinition: a thermodynamic process in which the volume of the system remains unchanged

examples.en: The constant-volume process raised the pressure when the gas in the rigid chamber warmed.
examples.zh: 刚性腔室里的气体升温时，「定容过程」使压力升高。

examples.en: We drew a vertical line to represent the constant-volume process on the pressure-volume graph.
examples.zh: 我们在压力体积图上画了一条竖线来表示「定容过程」。

words.enDefinition: the derivative of specific internal energy with respect to temperature at constant specific volume

examples.en: The example used constant-volume specific heat to find the internal energy change in a rigid vessel.
examples.zh: 示例用「定容比热容」求刚性容器内物质的内能变化。

examples.en: We distinguished constant-volume specific heat from the value tabulated for heating at fixed pressure.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「定容比热容」和表中列出的定压加热对应值。

words.enDefinition: Granular material such as sand, gravel, or crushed stone used in construction mixtures.

examples.en: The lecturer passed around samples of construction aggregate so we could compare their shapes and textures.
examples.zh: 老师传看几种「建筑集料」样品，让我们比较它们的形状和质地。

examples.en: Our materials chart listed construction aggregate separately from the binder in each illustrated concrete mixture.
examples.zh: 材料表把每种示例混凝土中的「建筑集料」与胶凝材料分开列出。

words.enDefinition: An interface where one concrete placement ends and a later placement begins.

examples.en: The pour sequence drawing used a dashed line to mark the construction joint between two planned placements.
examples.zh: 浇筑顺序图用虚线标出了两次计划浇筑之间的「施工缝」。

examples.en: We found the construction joint on the schedule boundary separating the first and second concrete placements.
examples.zh: 我们在进度图上第一、二次混凝土浇筑的分界处找到了「施工缝」。

collocations: a detail of a construction joint

words.enDefinition: an equation expressing mass conservation through the local density change and net mass flow

examples.en: We applied the continuity equation for fluids to relate the average speeds in the two pipe sections.
examples.zh: 我们用「流体连续性方程」联系管道两个截面的平均流速。

examples.en: The continuity equation for fluids balanced the mass entering our model tank against accumulation and outflow.
examples.zh: 「流体连续性方程」使模型水箱中的流入质量与积累量和流出量相平衡。

collocations: apply the continuity equation for fluids
derive the continuity equation for fluids
use the continuity equation for fluids in steady flow

words.enDefinition: An indication that the instrument detects a path with resistance below its continuity threshold.

examples.en: The continuity indicator is shown next to the reading for an intact isolated wire in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸中，一根与电路分离且完好的导线读数旁显示「通断指示」。

examples.en: We identified the continuity indicator in the illustrated meter display for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习所示的仪表显示屏上识别出「通断指示」。

words.enDefinition: distillation in which feed enters and product streams leave the equipment on an ongoing basis

examples.en: The continuous distillation sketch shows a feed arrow that remains active while product streams leave the model.
examples.zh: 「连续蒸馏」示意图显示，当产品物流流出时，仍有进料进入模型。

examples.en: We assumed steady conditions for the continuous distillation example so that no material accumulated in the column.
examples.zh: 在「连续蒸馏」示例中，我们假定处于稳态，塔内没有物料积累。

words.enDefinition: A process in which material enters and leaves on an ongoing basis during operation.

examples.en: The continuous process diagram shows prepared juice coming in while blended juice leaves another side.
examples.zh: 「连续过程」图显示配好的果汁一边流入，混合果汁一边从另一侧流出。

examples.en: We distinguished the continuous process from repeated batches when reading the two fictional diagrams.
examples.zh: 阅读两张虚构的工艺图时，我们区分了「连续过程」与反复批量操作。

words.enDefinition: a signal defined at every instant over a continuous time interval

examples.en: The continuous-time signal describes the modeled microphone voltage at any instant within the plotted interval.
examples.zh: 「连续时间信号」描述所绘时段内任一时刻的模拟传声器电压。

examples.en: We drew a curve for the continuous-time signal before marking the separate sampling instants on it.
examples.zh: 我们先画「连续时间信号」曲线，再在曲线上标出各个采样时刻。

words.enDefinition: the difference between a reference value and the measured controlled output under the stated sign convention

examples.en: The control error became positive when the modeled room temperature dropped below the reference value.
examples.zh: 设定参考量减输出为误差时，模型室温低于参考值后，「控制误差」变为正。

examples.en: The plot shows how the control error shrank after the simulated thermostat changed the heating command.
examples.zh: 情境中的温控器改变加热指令后，图中「控制误差」逐渐缩小。

words.enDefinition: A deliberate joint used to accommodate shrinkage or localize shrinkage cracking, depending on the construction material.

examples.en: The instructor identified the straight line in the slab model as a control joint in the example.
examples.zh: 老师指出，示例中楼板模型上的直线表示「控制缝」。

examples.en: We used the plan legend to tell a control joint from a line dividing two concrete placements.
examples.zh: 我们用平面图图例区分「控制缝」与划分两次混凝土浇筑的线。

collocations: a control joint on a plan

words.enDefinition: A specimen kept under reference conditions or left untreated for comparison with tested specimens.

examples.en: The control specimen came from the same paper stock but did not receive the classroom treatment.
examples.zh: 「对照试件」取自相同纸料，但没有接受课堂实验所采用的处理。

examples.en: We placed the control specimen beside the treated piece when taking photographs for the report.
examples.zh: 为报告拍照时，我们把「对照试件」放在经过处理的样件旁边。

collocations: compare results with a control specimen

words.enDefinition: the boundary of a control volume through which mass, momentum or energy may pass

examples.en: The outlet stream crosses the control surface where the dashed line intersects the pipe in our sketch.
examples.zh: 示意图中，出口流在虚线与管道的交点穿过「控制面」。

examples.en: We accounted for heat passing through the control surface even where the wall prevented mass transfer.
examples.zh: 即使壁面阻止了质量传递，我们也把穿过「控制面」的热量计入。

words.enDefinition: a selected region of space, fixed or moving, whose mass, momentum or energy exchanges are analyzed

examples.en: We outlined a control volume around the mixing chamber to identify where water enters and leaves.
examples.zh: 我们在混水腔周围画出「控制体」，明确水的进出位置。

examples.en: The control volume moved with the device in the second version of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型的第二个版本中，「控制体」随装置移动。

collocations: apply a balance to a control volume

words.enDefinition: the command issued by a controller to influence the system through an actuator or other input

examples.en: The controller output increased while the temperature sensor reported a value below the target in simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，温度传感器报告低于目标值的读数时，「控制器输出」增大。

examples.en: We plotted the controller output separately from the room temperature because they represent different quantities.
examples.zh: 我们分开绘制「控制器输出」和室温，因为它们代表不同的量。

words.enDefinition: A coefficient relating convective heat flux to a temperature difference between a surface and the bulk fluid.

examples.en: The convective heat transfer coefficient appears beside the air side of the wall in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图把「对流换热系数」标在壁面的空气侧。

examples.en: We compared the given convective heat transfer coefficient for two idealized cases in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习里两个理想化情形各自给出的「对流换热系数」。

collocations: convective heat transfer coefficient at a surface
estimate a convective heat transfer coefficient

words.enDefinition: Transfer of a component involving fluid motion, often modelled between a surface and the bulk fluid.

examples.en: Convective mass transfer relates the moving water and the dissolved sugar near a model surface.
examples.zh: 「对流传质」联系流动的水和模型表面附近的溶解糖。

examples.en: We contrasted convective mass transfer with diffusion alone in the two simplified diagrams on paper.
examples.zh: 我们对照纸上两张简化图，比较「对流传质」与单独扩散。

collocations: convective mass transfer at a surface

words.enDefinition: The resistance relating a surface-to-fluid temperature difference to the rate of convective heat transfer.

examples.en: The convective thermal resistance links the wall surface and water in the classroom thermal network.
examples.zh: 课堂热阻网络里，「对流热阻」把壁面与水连接起来。

examples.en: We used convective thermal resistance as one term in the simplified comparison of two cases.
examples.zh: 在简化对比两个情形时，我们将「对流热阻」作为其中一项。

collocations: convective thermal resistance at a wall

words.enDefinition: Electric current with its positive direction defined as the direction positive charge would move.

examples.en: The conventional current arrow points opposite to the electron motion in the diagram of a metal wire.
examples.zh: 金属导线图中，「约定电流」的箭头指向与电子运动相反。

examples.en: We labelled conventional current before comparing charge motion in two models of the same wire.
examples.zh: 我们先标明「约定电流」，再比较同一导线两个模型中的电荷运动。

words.enDefinition: the number of distinguishable levels of an ideal data converter, often expressed as the number of bits

examples.en: At a fixed input range, higher converter resolution gave more closely spaced code intervals in the model.
examples.zh: 固定输入范围内，模型的「转换器分辨率」越高，编码区间排列得越紧密。

examples.en: The specification states converter resolution in bits so readers can infer the nominal number of codes.
examples.zh: 规格用位数标明「转换器分辨率」，读者可据此推算标称编码数量。

words.enDefinition: the integral of one function at a running time multiplied by a second function at the output time minus that running time

examples.en: We evaluated the convolution integral by finding where the shifted pulse overlapped the nonzero input interval.
examples.zh: 我们找出平移后的脉冲与输入非零区间的重叠范围，计算「卷积积分」。

examples.en: The model took the convolution integral of the input and impulse response to predict the continuous output.
examples.zh: 模型对输入和冲激响应求「卷积积分」，预测连续输出。

collocations: determine the limits of a convolution integral

words.enDefinition: the discrete-time convolution of two sequences at a given index, summing pairwise products over all indices whose sum equals that index

examples.en: We used the convolution sum to predict the sampled filter output from the input and impulse response.
examples.zh: 我们用「卷积和」根据输入与冲激响应预测采样滤波器的输出。

examples.en: The first output in the convolution sum involved only one overlap between the two finite sequences.
examples.zh: 在「卷积和」的第一个输出位置，两个有限序列只有一处重叠。

words.enDefinition: crystallization obtained by cooling a solution so that its solubility decreases below the actual dissolved concentration

examples.en: The exercise illustrates cooling crystallization by moving the solution state to a lower temperature on the diagram.
examples.zh: 练习在图上将溶液状态移至较低温度，用以展示「冷却结晶」。

examples.en: We interpreted cooling crystallization using the reduction in equilibrium solubility shown on the curve for this solute.
examples.zh: 我们用该溶质曲线上平衡溶解度的降低来解读「冷却结晶」。

words.enDefinition: Forces whose lines of action lie in a single plane.

examples.en: All the arrows represented coplanar forces, so the class placed the coordinate axes in the sketch plane.
examples.zh: 所有箭头都表示「共面力」，因此我们把坐标轴设在草图所在的平面内。

examples.en: We checked whether the forces were coplanar forces by tracing their lines on the plate model.
examples.zh: 我们在薄板模型上描出各力的作用线，判断它们是否为「共面力」。

words.enDefinition: A moment tending to rotate a body counterclockwise in the stated view.

examples.en: The upward force on the right produced a counterclockwise moment about the center of the sketch.
examples.zh: 右侧向上的力对草图中的中心点产生了「逆时针力矩」。

examples.en: We took the counterclockwise moment as positive and wrote its contribution beside the curved arrow.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆时针力矩」取为正，并在弧形箭头旁写出其大小。

words.enDefinition: contact in which two phases or streams move in opposite overall directions through a device

examples.en: The arrows point in opposite directions to indicate countercurrent contact between the two streams in the column.
examples.zh: 箭头朝向相反，表示塔内两股物流进行「逆流接触」。

examples.en: We compared countercurrent contact with a sketch in which both streams entered the same end.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆流接触」与两股物流从同一端进入的图作比较。

words.enDefinition: an exchanger in which the hot and cold streams move in opposite overall directions

examples.en: The counterflow heat exchanger has its hot and cold inlets at opposite ends in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「逆流换热器」的冷热流体入口位于相反两端。

examples.en: We compared the temperature differences at both ends of the counterflow heat exchanger in the example.
examples.zh: 我们比较了示例中「逆流换热器」两端的温差。

words.enDefinition: The moment produced by a force couple, independent of the choice of reference point.

examples.en: The couple moment stayed the same when we recalculated it about the other corner of the plate.
examples.zh: 换到板的另一个角重新计算后，「力偶矩」保持不变。

examples.en: We showed the couple moment with a curved arrow beside the two equal and opposite forces.
examples.zh: 我们在两个等大反向的力旁画了一个弧形箭头来表示「力偶矩」。

collocations: represent a couple moment with a curved arrow

words.enDefinition: The multiplier that scales combined standard uncertainty to obtain expanded uncertainty.

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to find the coverage factor printed next to the expanded uncertainty.
examples.zh: 习题让我们找出印在扩展不确定度旁的「包含因子」。

examples.en: We checked whether both examples used the same coverage factor before comparing their expanded uncertainties.
examples.zh: 比较两个示例的扩展不确定度之前，我们先核对它们是否使用相同的「包含因子」。

collocations: apply a coverage factor to combined standard uncertainty

words.enDefinition: The formation of a new crack in a material.

examples.en: The first faint mark near the fold showed crack initiation in the sequence of classroom photographs.
examples.zh: 课堂系列照片中，折痕旁最早出现的一道浅痕显示了「裂纹萌生」。

examples.en: We used the earlier pictures to discuss where crack initiation might have occurred on the chalk sample.
examples.zh: 我们根据较早的照片讨论粉笔试样上可能发生「裂纹萌生」的位置。

words.enDefinition: Growth of an existing crack through a material.

examples.en: The time sequence showed crack propagation from one edge of the paper sample toward its center.
examples.zh: 连续图像显示，纸试样中的「裂纹扩展」从一侧边缘向中心发展。

examples.en: We marked the direction of crack propagation on the diagram rather than recording only the final break.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上标出了「裂纹扩展」的方向，也记录了最终断裂。

words.enDefinition: Viscous damping value at the boundary between oscillatory and nonoscillatory free responses

examples.en: We compared the model's damping with the critical damping coefficient before classifying the motion.
examples.zh: 我们将模型的阻尼系数与「临界阻尼系数」比较，再判断运动类型。

examples.en: The critical damping coefficient depends on both mass and stiffness in our linear model.
examples.zh: 在我们的线性模型中，「临界阻尼系数」取决于质量和刚度。

collocations: compare with the critical damping coefficient

words.enDefinition: Damping level separating oscillatory from nonoscillatory free motion in the linear model

examples.en: The graph labeled critical damping marks the boundary between the two response types.
examples.zh: 标有「临界阻尼」的图对应两种响应类型的分界。

examples.en: In our release-from-rest model, critical damping returns the mass fastest without repeated crossings.
examples.zh: 在我们从静止状态释放质量块的模型中，「临界阻尼」使质量块最快趋回平衡位置，且不反复穿过该点。

words.enDefinition: Traffic density corresponding to the maximum flow in a specified model

examples.en: The best-fitting curve places critical density at the density of its highest point.
examples.zh: 拟合最好的曲线将最高点对应的密度标为「临界交通密度」。

examples.en: We marked the critical density before comparing the two branches of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「临界交通密度」，再比较图中的两个分支。

words.enDefinition: Depth minimizing specific energy for fixed discharge in a channel section

examples.en: We marked the critical depth at the minimum of the specific energy curve.
examples.zh: 我们在比能曲线的最低点标出了「临界水深」。

examples.en: The critical depth separates the shallow and deep flow branches in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，「临界水深」分开了浅水流和深水流两条分支。

words.enDefinition: Flow with mean speed equal to the speed of small gravity waves

examples.en: The worksheet marks critical flow where the Froude number equals one in the model.
examples.zh: 习题将模型中弗劳德数等于一的状态标为「临界流」。

examples.en: We drew critical flow at the boundary between the two modeled flow regimes.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中两种流态的分界处画出了「临界流」。

words.enDefinition: the endpoint of the liquid-vapor coexistence curve, where liquid and vapor become indistinguishable

examples.en: The critical point of a fluid is where the two sides of its saturation dome meet.
examples.zh: 「流体的临界点」位于饱和穹顶两侧相交处。

examples.en: We marked the critical point of a fluid at the upper end of its coexistence curve.
examples.zh: 我们在液汽共存曲线的上端标出了「流体的临界点」。

collocations: identify the critical point of a fluid
locate the critical point of a fluid
approach the critical point of a fluid

words.enDefinition: An engineered wood panel made from bonded layers with adjacent grain directions typically at right angles.

examples.en: The diagram showed cross-laminated timber with the grain direction alternating from one layer to the next.
examples.zh: 示意图展示的「正交胶合木」中，相邻各层的木纹方向交替变化。

examples.en: We looked at the edge of the cross-laminated timber sample to count its visible layers.
examples.zh: 我们观察「正交胶合木」样品的边缘，数出可见的木层。

collocations: a wall made from cross-laminated timber

words.enDefinition: The area of a slice taken perpendicular to an object's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We found the cross-sectional area by multiplying the width and thickness of the rectangular sample.
examples.zh: 我们将矩形试样的宽度与厚度相乘，得到「横截面积」。

examples.en: The cross-sectional area of the circular specimen was given in square millimetres on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题以平方毫米给出了圆形试样的「横截面积」。

words.enDefinition: stagewise contact in which a main stream passes through successive stages and meets a separate fresh contacting stream at each stage

examples.en: The crosscurrent contact sketch shows fresh water entering separately at each contact stage in the washing model.
examples.zh: 洗涤模型的「错流接触」示意图显示，清水分别从各接触级流入。

examples.en: We identified crosscurrent contact by tracing the main stream and the separate arrows entering every stage.
examples.zh: 我们顺着主物流与通向各级的独立箭头，辨认出「错流接触」。

words.enDefinition: Aggregate produced by mechanically breaking larger pieces of rock into smaller particles.

examples.en: The crushed stone aggregate had angular faces that were visible even in the small sample photograph.
examples.zh: 在小幅样品照片上也能看出「碎石集料」带棱角的表面。

examples.en: We labeled the rough particles as crushed stone aggregate on our worksheet about concrete constituents.
examples.zh: 在混凝土组成习题中，我们把粗糙的颗粒标为「碎石集料」。

words.enDefinition: an increase in crystal size as additional material joins its ordered structure

examples.en: The crystal growth sequence shows existing sugar crystals getting larger without appearing at new positions.
examples.zh: 「晶体生长」序列显示，已有的糖晶体逐渐变大，新的位置没有出现新晶体。

examples.en: We estimated crystal growth from the change in average crystal size over the observed interval.
examples.zh: 我们根据观测时段内平均晶体尺寸的改变量估计「晶体生长」。

words.enDefinition: the initial formation of small stable crystal regions that can subsequently grow

examples.en: The animation used new bright points to indicate crystal nucleation within the modeled sugar solution.
examples.zh: 动画用新出现的亮点表示模拟糖溶液中的「晶体成核」。

examples.en: We distinguished crystal nucleation from growth by checking when new crystals first appeared in the recording.
examples.zh: 我们观察录像中新晶体首次出现的时刻，区分「晶体成核」与生长。

words.enDefinition: formation of a solid phase with an ordered crystal structure from a solution, melt or vapor

examples.en: The crystallization animation shows solid sugar appearing in the cooled solution used for the classroom example.
examples.zh: 「结晶」动画显示，在课堂示例冷却后的溶液中出现固态糖。

examples.en: We identified crystallization when the model began showing individual solid crystals growing out of the liquid.
examples.zh: 模型中开始出现从液体中生长的独立固态晶体时，我们认出了「结晶」现象。

words.enDefinition: Maintaining moisture and temperature conditions that support cement hydration and property development.

examples.en: The laboratory report described curing of concrete before presenting the strength results for the samples.
examples.zh: 实验报告先介绍「混凝土养护」，再展示各试样的强度结果。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted curing of concrete when explaining why the same mix produced different results in two groups.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释同一配合比为何在两组中结果不同，并重点说明了「混凝土养护」。

collocations: compare methods for curing of concrete

words.enDefinition: A parallel network that splits an incoming current among branches according to their conductances in a resistive case.

examples.en: The smaller resistance receives more current in the simple current divider shown on the board.
examples.zh: 白板的简单「分流电路」中，阻值较小的支路分得较多电流。

examples.en: We applied the current divider rule to the two parallel branches of the textbook network.
examples.zh: 我们对教材网络的两条并联支路应用「分流电路」的计算规则。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of an output current, or its change, to the corresponding input current or change

examples.en: We estimated the current gain from the change in collector current divided by the base current change.
examples.zh: 我们用集电极电流的变化量除以基极电流的变化量，估算「电流增益」。

examples.en: The graph shows that current gain depends on the operating point chosen for the small-signal analysis.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「电流增益」取决于小信号分析所选择的工作点。

words.enDefinition: The maximum output current a supply is configured to allow in a stated operating mode.

examples.en: The current limit is shown beneath the voltage setting in the low-voltage simulation display.
examples.zh: 在低压模拟界面上，「电流限值」显示在电压设定下方。

examples.en: We read the current limit from the provided screenshot before interpreting the change in supply mode.
examples.zh: 我们先从给定截图读取「电流限值」，再解释电源模式的变化。

words.enDefinition: The chosen direction in which a circuit current is defined as positive.

examples.en: The arrow marks the current reference direction for the middle branch of the circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 箭头标出电路图中间支路的「电流参考方向」。

examples.en: A negative result means the current flows opposite to the current reference direction in this model.
examples.zh: 结果为负，表示模型中的电流实际流向与「电流参考方向」相反。

words.enDefinition: A known low resistance used to determine current from the voltage developed across it.

examples.en: The current shunt has a small resistance in the ideal measurement circuit drawn on the board.
examples.zh: 白板上的理想测量电路图里，「电流分流器」的电阻很小。

examples.en: We calculated current from the voltage across the current shunt in the supplied model.
examples.zh: 我们根据给定模型中「电流分流器」两端的电压计算电流。

words.enDefinition: Motion with constant body orientation while its points follow curved paths

examples.en: The cabin undergoes curvilinear translation when its floor stays level along the curved path.
examples.zh: 小舱沿曲线路径移动时，地板保持水平，因此小舱做「曲线平移」。

examples.en: Our diagram illustrates curvilinear translation by showing the body's unchanged orientation at three points.
examples.zh: 示意图显示物体在三个位置的朝向保持一致，以说明「曲线平移」。

words.enDefinition: a frequency marking a filter or system's chosen response boundary, often defined by a specified gain reduction

examples.en: We located the cutoff frequency at the marked gain reduction on the frequency response plot.
examples.zh: 我们在频率响应曲线上找到标定的增益下降量，对应该处的「截止频率」。

examples.en: Raising the cutoff frequency allowed more high-frequency content through the low-pass filter in our simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，提高「截止频率」让低通滤波器通过了更多高频成分。

words.enDefinition: the region in which gate-to-source drive is insufficient to turn the MOSFET on, so its ideal drain current is zero

examples.en: The cutoff region of a MOSFET appears where our simplified model approximates the drain current as zero.
examples.zh: 简化模型把漏极电流近似为零时，对应「MOSFET 截止区」。

examples.en: We identified the cutoff region of a MOSFET before drawing its modeled switch state in the truth table.
examples.zh: 我们先判断是否在「MOSFET 截止区」，再在真值表中画出模型对应的开关状态。

collocations: identify the cutoff region of a MOSFET
model the cutoff region of a MOSFET
inspect the cutoff region of a MOSFET

words.enDefinition: A drawing line marking the location and viewing direction of an imagined cut for a section view.

examples.en: The arrows on the cutting plane line showed which way to look through the center of the block.
examples.zh: 「剖切位置线」上的箭头指出剖开方块中央后应从哪个方向看。

examples.en: We matched the letters on the cutting plane line to the label above the section view.
examples.zh: 我们把「剖切位置线」上的字母与剖视图上方的标记对应起来。

collocations: arrows on a cutting plane line

words.enDefinition: Motion after an initial disturbance with energy loss and no continuing excitation

examples.en: The peaks shrink during damped free vibration because the model loses energy each cycle.
examples.zh: 在「有阻尼自由振动」期间，模型每循环一次都会损失能量，因此峰值逐次减小。

examples.en: We identified damped free vibration after the initial release produced a sequence of smaller peaks.
examples.zh: 初次释放后出现了一连串逐渐减小的峰值，据此我们识别出「有阻尼自由振动」。

words.enDefinition: Frequency of free oscillation in a system with undercritical damping

examples.en: We estimated the damped natural frequency from the gaps between peaks after release.
examples.zh: 我们用释放后相邻峰值的时间间隔估算了「阻尼固有频率」。

examples.en: The damped natural frequency is lower than the undamped value in our linear model.
examples.zh: 在我们的线性模型中，「阻尼固有频率」低于无阻尼时的数值。

words.enDefinition: Proportionality relating opposing force magnitude to relative speed in a viscous model

examples.en: We changed the damping coefficient while keeping the spring and mass terms fixed.
examples.zh: 我们改变了「阻尼系数」，同时保持弹簧和质量项不变。

examples.en: The slope of the force versus speed plot gives the damping coefficient here.
examples.zh: 这里的力与速率关系图的斜率给出了「阻尼系数」。

words.enDefinition: Dimensionless ratio of actual viscous damping to the critical damping coefficient

examples.en: We changed the damping ratio to compare the free motion shown in each trace.
examples.zh: 我们改变「阻尼比」，比较各条曲线所显示的自由运动。

examples.en: The notes show that the damping ratio is unchanged when we switch to another unit system.
examples.zh: 讲义说明，换用另一套单位制时，「阻尼比」不变。

words.enDefinition: An ideal point, axis, plane, or other reference from which features are located or oriented.

examples.en: The exercise used the bottom plane as a datum for locating the holes in the model.
examples.zh: 练习以底部平面为「基准」，确定模型各孔的位置。

examples.en: We chose a second datum to describe how the markings were aligned across the panel.
examples.zh: 我们选了第二个「基准」，描述面板上各标记如何对齐。

collocations: refer a dimension to a datum

words.enDefinition: An actual part feature used to establish an ideal datum.

examples.en: The underside of the block was the datum feature used to establish a reference plane in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，方块底面作为「基准要素」，用来建立一个参考平面。

examples.en: We pointed to the datum feature on the classroom model after locating its mark on the drawing.
examples.zh: 在图样上找到标识后，我们在课堂模型上指出了「基准要素」。

collocations: a datum feature indicated on a drawing

words.enDefinition: An instrument input mode that passes both a signal's steady offset and its time-varying part.

examples.en: DC coupling preserves the offset between the waveform centre and the zero line in this example.
examples.zh: 「直流耦合」保留了示例中波形中心与零线之间的偏置。

examples.en: We used the screenshot labelled DC coupling to read the whole voltage relative to zero.
examples.zh: 我们从标有「直流耦合」的截图读取相对于零点的完整电压。

words.enDefinition: A condition in which voltages and currents are constant after transients have died away.

examples.en: The ideal capacitor carries no current once the example circuit reaches DC steady state.
examples.zh: 示例电路达到「直流稳态」后，理想电容器中没有电流。

examples.en: We calculated the inductor voltage at DC steady state from its unchanging current in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据恒定电流求出「直流稳态」下的电感电压。

words.enDefinition: Permanent load such as the weight of structural members and fixed components

examples.en: The ideal model labels the beam's own weight as a dead load.
examples.zh: 理想模型将梁的自重标为一项「恒载」。

examples.en: We used the same dead load in both sketches while varying the movable weights.
examples.zh: 我们改变可移动重物，但两张图采用相同的「恒载」。

words.enDefinition: A curve showing a beam's transverse displacement along its length.

examples.en: The deflection curve met the horizontal reference line at both supports in our simply supported example.
examples.zh: 在简支梁例题中，「挠曲线」在两个支座处都与水平基准线相交。

examples.en: We sketched a deflection curve after estimating which part of the model would move down most.
examples.zh: 我们估计模型哪一段下移最多，然后画出「挠曲线」。

collocations: the slope of a deflection curve

words.enDefinition: A body whose shape or dimensions can change under loads.

examples.en: We treated the soft strip as a deformable body because its length changed visibly during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，软条的长度变化清晰可见，所以我们把它视为「变形体」。

examples.en: The instructor used a deformable body to illustrate the difference between moving and changing shape.
examples.zh: 老师用「变形体」说明了物体移动与形状改变的区别。

collocations: model an object as a deformable body

words.enDefinition: A reinforcing bar with surface ribs or projections that help transfer force to surrounding concrete.

examples.en: The deformed bar in the materials display had raised ribs along the length of its surface.
examples.zh: 材料展台上的「带肋钢筋」表面沿长度方向有凸起的肋。

examples.en: We selected the deformed bar from the tray after comparing the surface textures of three samples.
examples.zh: 我们比较了三个样品的表面质地后，从托盘里认出了「带肋钢筋」。

collocations: the ribs of a deformed bar

words.enDefinition: Counting unknowns and independent equations to determine whether a process balance has enough information.

examples.en: Degree-of-freedom analysis reveals that the two unknown flows require independent equations in the example.
examples.zh: 「自由度分析」表明，示例中的两个未知流量需要独立方程才能确定。

examples.en: We performed degree-of-freedom analysis before attempting to solve the classroom mixing problem on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先做「自由度分析」，再尝试在纸上求解课堂混合问题。

words.enDefinition: Fraction of the volume of soil voids that is filled with water

examples.en: The degree of saturation increases as water replaces some of the air in the voids.
examples.zh: 水替代孔隙中的一部分空气时，「饱和度」升高。

examples.en: We calculated the degree of saturation from the water volume and the total void volume.
examples.zh: 我们用水的体积和孔隙总体积计算了「饱和度」。

collocations: degree of saturation of the soil

words.enDefinition: Number of independent unknown forces beyond those solvable using equilibrium alone

examples.en: We found the degree of static indeterminacy before deciding how many compatibility conditions were needed.
examples.zh: 我们先求出「超静定次数」，再确定需要多少个变形协调条件。

examples.en: The extra independent restraint raises the degree of static indeterminacy in the tutor's idealized example.
examples.zh: 在老师的理想化示例中，额外的独立约束提高了「超静定次数」。

collocations: determine the degree of static indeterminacy
degree of static indeterminacy of a frame

words.enDefinition: the mass per unit volume of a fluid at the specified point or state

examples.en: We measured the density of a fluid by weighing a known volume at room temperature.
examples.zh: 我们在室温下称取已知体积的液体，并求得「流体密度」。

examples.en: The density of a fluid was held constant in the water model used for the exercise.
examples.zh: 本题的水流模型中，「流体密度」保持恒定。

collocations: measure the density of a fluid
estimate the density of a fluid
variation in the density of a fluid

words.enDefinition: the region near a semiconductor junction in which mobile carriers are greatly reduced, leaving fixed ionized impurities

examples.en: The depletion region widened in the plot when the reverse bias across the junction increased.
examples.zh: 结两端的反向偏置增大时，图中的「耗尽区」变宽。

examples.en: We drew fixed charges inside the depletion region to explain the electric field near the junction.
examples.zh: 我们在「耗尽区」内画出固定电荷，以说明结附近的电场。

collocations: electric field in the depletion region

words.enDefinition: filtration that captures suspended particles within a porous medium rather than only at its face

examples.en: The sliced filter showed depth filtration because colored particles were visible well below its outer surface.
examples.zh: 剖开的过滤器中，外表面以下较深处仍可见有色颗粒，表明发生了「深层过滤」。

examples.en: The depth filtration model represents particle retention at multiple points along the flow through the medium.
examples.zh: 「深层过滤」模型用流经介质路径上的多个位置表示颗粒截留。

collocations: use depth filtration to remove suspended solids

words.enDefinition: One possible solution considered alongside others for the same design problem.

examples.en: The second design alternative used two shallow compartments instead of the larger single space shown earlier.
examples.zh: 第二个「备选设计方案」采用两个浅格，替代前一个方案中的大单格。

examples.en: We drew each design alternative on its own page so classmates could compare the layouts easily.
examples.zh: 我们把各个「备选设计方案」分别画在不同页上，方便同学比较布局。

words.enDefinition: A basis for judging or comparing possible design solutions.

examples.en: Ease of cleaning became a design criterion when we compared the sample trays during the workshop.
examples.zh: 在研讨课上比较样品托盘时，是否容易清洁成了一项「设计评判准则」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to explain why each design criterion mattered for the proposed classroom organizer.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们解释，为什么每项「设计评判准则」都与拟议的课堂收纳盒有关。

collocations: compare alternatives against a design criterion
assign weight to a design criterion

words.enDefinition: A milestone after which a design version is held fixed except for formally agreed changes.

examples.en: After design freeze, the class used the same tray drawing for every copy of the model.
examples.zh: 「设计定版」后，课堂上的每件模型都使用了同一份托盘图纸。

examples.en: We noted the design freeze date beside the final classroom drawing in our shared project folder.
examples.zh: 我们在共享项目文件夹里，把「设计定版」日期记在最后一版课堂图纸旁。

collocations: review the drawing before design freeze

words.enDefinition: The intended purpose or relationships that a design is expected to preserve.

examples.en: The center marks showed the design intent that both slots should stay aligned with the tray's middle.
examples.zh: 中心标记表达了这样的「设计意图」，两个槽都应始终与托盘中部对齐。

examples.en: We added a note about design intent so the next group understood why the compartments matched.
examples.zh: 我们补了一条「设计意图」的说明，让下一组知道各储物格为什么要做成相同规格。

words.enDefinition: An outcome a design is intended to achieve or improve.

examples.en: The main design objective was to make the labels easier for students to see from above.
examples.zh: 主要「设计目标」是让学生从上方更容易看清标签。

examples.en: We discussed a second design objective after comparing how much space the two cardboard prototypes occupied.
examples.zh: 比较两个纸板原型的占用空间后，我们讨论了第二个「设计目标」。

words.enDefinition: A variable chosen or adjusted when defining a design, such as a dimension or material property.

examples.en: The distance between dividers was a design parameter in our adjustable model of the card tray.
examples.zh: 隔板间距是可调卡片托盘模型的一项「设计参数」。

examples.en: We changed one design parameter at a time while comparing computer models of the same tray.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一托盘的几个计算机模型，每次只改一个「设计参数」。

words.enDefinition: A documented modification to a design after an earlier version has been reviewed.

examples.en: The second design revision moved the labels to the outside edge of the cardboard tray.
examples.zh: 第二次「设计修订」把标签移到了纸板托盘的外沿。

examples.en: Our log explained the design revision beside a photograph of the earlier classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们的日志在早期课堂模型的照片旁说明了这次「设计修订」。

words.enDefinition: A documented set of required design characteristics, dimensions, or performance levels.

examples.en: Our design specification gave the outer dimensions, material choice and intended capacity of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「设计规格」列出了课堂模型的外形尺寸、所选材料和预期容量。

examples.en: We compared the prototype drawing with the design specification before measuring the model itself.
examples.zh: 测量模型之前，我们先将原型图和「设计规格」作了对照。

collocations: check a design against the design specification

words.enDefinition: Checking that a design satisfies intended user needs in its expected context of use.

examples.en: For design validation, classmates tried finding index cards in the tray during a simulated study session.
examples.zh: 为进行「设计确认」，同学们在模拟自习场景中尝试从托盘里找索引卡。

examples.en: Our design validation notes described how the organizer performed when students actually used it on their desks.
examples.zh: 「设计确认」记录描述了学生在桌上实际使用收纳盒时的表现。

words.enDefinition: Checking objective evidence that the design meets specified requirements.

examples.en: We used design verification to check the tray dimensions against the values in our requirements sheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「设计验证」核对托盘尺寸是否满足需求表中的数值。

examples.en: The design verification table showed which measurements supported each stated requirement for the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「设计验证」表显示，哪些测量结果支持课堂模型的各项既定要求。

words.enDefinition: Straight diagram line linking trip origins and destinations independently of routes used

examples.en: We drew a desire line directly between two zones with many modeled trips.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中出行量较大的两个区域之间直接画出一条「出行愿望线」。

examples.en: A thicker desire line in the illustration represents a larger number of trips.
examples.zh: 示意图中较粗的「出行愿望线」表示出行次数较多。

words.enDefinition: the release of previously adsorbed material from a surface into its surroundings

examples.en: The model illustrates desorption by showing a previously retained molecule leaving the solid surface again.
examples.zh: 模型通过一个原先截留的分子从固体表面离开，展示了「解吸」。

examples.en: We compared desorption with adsorption to show how the two processes transfer molecules in opposite directions.
examples.zh: 我们对照「解吸」和吸附，说明两个过程如何沿相反方向转移分子。

words.enDefinition: An enlarged view of a selected part of a drawing that makes local features clearer.

examples.en: The detail view made the small notch visible without enlarging the rest of the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 「局部放大图」让小缺口清晰可见，其余课堂图样仍按原比例显示。

examples.en: The tutor followed a circular label to find the detail view of the tray corner.
examples.zh: 辅导老师根据圆圈标记找到了托盘转角的「局部放大图」。

words.enDefinition: the temperature or pressure at which an equilibrium liquid phase first appears from a vapor of specified composition

examples.en: During cooling at constant pressure, the modeled vapor reached its dew point as the first drop appeared.
examples.zh: 定压冷却时，模拟蒸气达到「露点」，出现了第一滴液体。

examples.en: We located the dew point of the mixture from the vapor composition curve on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们从图中的气相组成曲线上找出混合物的「露点」。

words.enDefinition: An instrument using a dial and pointer to show small displacements of a contact probe.

examples.en: The dial indicator showed a pointer moving around the marked face in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中，「指针式指示表」的指针沿刻度盘移动。

examples.en: The drawing placed the dial indicator beside the surface whose small movement we were comparing.
examples.zh: 图中，「指针式指示表」放在我们要比较微小位移的表面旁。

collocations: a dial indicator with a contact probe

words.enDefinition: an idealized compression-ignition engine cycle with constant-pressure heat addition and constant-volume heat rejection

examples.en: In the ideal Diesel cycle, the heat input is drawn along a constant-pressure branch.
examples.zh: 在理想「狄塞尔循环」图中，吸热画在定压支路上。

examples.en: We compared the Diesel cycle with the Otto model by looking at the heat addition steps.
examples.zh: 我们对照吸热步骤，比较「狄塞尔循环」和奥托模型。

words.enDefinition: the voltage at the noninverting input minus that at the inverting input of a differential amplifier

examples.en: We calculated differential input voltage by subtracting the inverting input potential from the noninverting input potential.
examples.zh: 我们用同相输入端的电位减去反相输入端的电位，计算「差分输入电压」。

examples.en: The differential input voltage stayed close to zero during normal linear operation in the feedback example.
examples.zh: 在反馈示例中，正常线性工作时，「差分输入电压」保持接近零。

words.enDefinition: A property relating diffusive flux to a concentration gradient for a specified component and medium.

examples.en: The diffusion coefficient differs for the two dissolved substances listed in the classroom data table.
examples.zh: 课堂数据表中，两种溶解物质的「扩散系数」不同。

examples.en: We used the stated diffusion coefficient to interpret the two synthetic concentration profiles.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的「扩散系数」解读两条合成浓度分布曲线。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic time for diffusion over a specified distance, scaling with distance squared divided by diffusivity.

examples.en: The diffusion time scale is longer for the wider water layer in our simplified comparison.
examples.zh: 在简化比较中，较宽的水层具有较长的「扩散时间尺度」。

examples.en: We compared two diffusion time scale estimates using the given layer widths in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂练习给出的层宽，比较两个「扩散时间尺度」估计值。

words.enDefinition: The rate of transfer of a component by diffusion per unit area relative to a specified reference velocity.

examples.en: The diffusive flux points toward lower concentration in the simple classroom model of sugar in water.
examples.zh: 在糖溶于水的简单课堂模型中，「扩散通量」指向浓度较低处。

examples.en: We compared diffusive flux at two locations with different gradients on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中梯度不同的两个位置的「扩散通量」。

words.enDefinition: A caliper that displays the distance between its measuring faces as a numerical reading.

examples.en: The photograph showed a digital caliper beside the classroom block, with its reading clearly visible.
examples.zh: 照片上，课堂方块旁放着一把「数显卡尺」，示值清晰可见。

examples.en: We identified the digital caliper from its numeric display in the illustrated list of instruments.
examples.zh: 我们根据数字显示屏，在带插图的仪器清单中认出了「数显卡尺」。

collocations: measure width with a digital caliper

words.enDefinition: A meter with a digital display and functions for measuring quantities such as voltage, current, and resistance.

examples.en: The digital multimeter display in the handout shows a value and its unit of measurement.
examples.zh: 讲义中的「数字万用表」显示屏给出数值及其计量单位。

examples.en: We distinguished the digital multimeter from the instrument that displays a changing voltage over time.
examples.zh: 我们把「数字万用表」与能显示电压随时间变化的仪器区分开。

words.enDefinition: a signal using a discrete set of values or symbols to represent information

examples.en: The digital signal uses two nominal levels to represent the recorded bits on the classroom trace.
examples.zh: 课堂曲线上的「数字信号」用两个标称电平表示记录的比特。

examples.en: We decoded the digital signal after assigning each sampled level to one of the two symbols.
examples.zh: 我们先将每个采样电平归入两个符号中的一个，再对「数字信号」解码。

words.enDefinition: a device that converts a digital code to a corresponding analog output level or waveform

examples.en: The digital-to-analog converter produced a stepped voltage trace as we supplied a sequence of increasing codes.
examples.zh: 我们输入递增的编码序列时，「数模转换器」产生阶梯形电压曲线。

examples.en: We compared the digital-to-analog converter output with the continuous reference curve in the audio demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们在音频演示中比较「数模转换器」输出与连续参考曲线。

words.enDefinition: A material balance that tracks a solute and solvent when extra solvent changes their ratio.

examples.en: The dilution balance keeps the sugar amount unchanged when the example adds only plain water.
examples.zh: 示例中只加入清水时，「稀释衡算」使糖的量保持不变。

examples.en: We used a dilution balance to explain the smaller sugar fraction shown in the second drawing.
examples.zh: 我们用「稀释衡算」解释第二张图所示糖质量分数较低的原因。

words.enDefinition: A line showing the direction and extent of a dimension, typically marked with arrowheads.

examples.en: The dimension line ran between the two arrows under the classroom drawing of the rectangular tray.
examples.zh: 「尺寸线」位于矩形托盘课堂图样下方的两个箭头之间。

examples.en: We checked whether the number above the dimension line referred to the length or the width.
examples.zh: 我们核对「尺寸线」上方的数字表示长度还是宽度。

collocations: an arrowhead on a dimension line

words.enDefinition: The requirement that comparable terms in an equation have compatible physical dimensions.

examples.en: Dimensional consistency requires both sides of the worksheet equation to represent amounts of the same kind.
examples.zh: 「量纲一致性」要求练习方程两侧代表同类物理量。

examples.en: We checked dimensional consistency before adding quantities copied from different columns of the stream table.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「量纲一致性」，再把物流数据表不同列中抄出的量相加。

words.enDefinition: The difference between a feature's measured size and a specified reference size.

examples.en: The dimensional deviation was positive because the measured length was greater than the nominal dimension.
examples.zh: 由于实测长度大于公称尺寸，「尺寸偏差」为正。

examples.en: We reported the dimensional deviation beside the original value in our classroom measurement table.
examples.zh: 在课堂测量表中，我们将「尺寸偏差」列在原始值旁边。

words.enDefinition: Examining measured dimensions to see whether a physical item meets stated dimensional requirements.

examples.en: The dimensional inspection table listed measured widths beside the model's stated limit dimensions in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「尺寸检验」表在模型的规定极限尺寸旁列出实测宽度。

examples.en: We separated dimensional inspection from the discussion of the sample's appearance in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 在课堂报告中，我们把「尺寸检验」和试样外观的讨论分开。

words.enDefinition: Sawn lumber supplied in standardized nominal widths and thicknesses.

examples.en: The dimensional lumber table listed standard cross-sectional sizes beside photos of the example pieces of wood.
examples.zh: 「规格锯材」表在示例木料的照片旁列出了常规横截面规格。

examples.en: We used the note about dimensional lumber to identify the solid wood pieces in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们根据「规格锯材」的说明识别课堂模型里的实木构件。

words.enDefinition: The permitted variation in the size of a feature.

examples.en: The dimensional tolerance defined the allowed range around the nominal width in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂题中的「尺寸公差」规定了公称宽度周围的允许范围。

examples.en: The class checked the dimensional tolerance before interpreting differences among the measurements of the model slots.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对「尺寸公差」，再解释模型各槽的实测差异。

words.enDefinition: a two-terminal device that typically conducts much more easily in one direction than the other

examples.en: The diode model predicted much greater current when the applied voltage had the forward polarity.
examples.zh: 「二极管」模型预测，外加电压为正向极性时电流会大得多。

examples.en: We plotted the diode current against voltage to compare the simulated forward and reverse behavior.
examples.zh: 我们绘出「二极管」的电流与电压关系，比较正向和反向的模拟特性。

words.enDefinition: a graph showing the relation between the voltage across a diode and the current through it

examples.en: The diode characteristic curve rose steeply in the forward direction over the range shown in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂给定的范围内，「二极管特性曲线」沿正向陡升。

examples.en: We used the diode characteristic curve to find the current at a specified forward voltage.
examples.zh: 我们用「二极管特性曲线」找出指定正向电压下的电流。

words.enDefinition: the voltage across a forward-biased diode at a stated current and temperature

examples.en: The worksheet compares diode forward voltage at the same current for three different device samples.
examples.zh: 练习比较三个不同器件样品在相同电流下的「二极管正向压降」。

examples.en: Our model picked a fixed diode forward voltage as a simple approximation for the conducting state.
examples.zh: 模型选取固定的「二极管正向压降」，对导通状态作简单近似。

collocations: diode forward voltage at a specified current

words.enDefinition: Electric current that flows in one direction when nonzero, even if its magnitude changes over time.

examples.en: The direct current in the diagram keeps the same direction throughout the recorded time interval.
examples.zh: 图中的「直流」在记录时段内始终保持同一流向。

examples.en: We compared direct current from an ideal battery with current that reverses direction periodically.
examples.zh: 我们比较了理想电池提供的「直流」和周期性反向的电流。

words.enDefinition: a transformation taking a finite sequence to complex coefficients on an equally spaced frequency grid of the same size

examples.en: We used the discrete Fourier transform to identify the largest frequency coefficient in the sampled recording.
examples.zh: 我们用「离散傅里叶变换」找出采样记录中最大的频率系数。

examples.en: At fixed sampling frequency, collecting more samples narrowed the frequency spacing of the discrete Fourier transform.
examples.zh: 采样频率固定时，采集更多样本使「离散傅里叶变换」的频率间距缩小。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of signal values indexed by separate time instants, regardless of whether its amplitudes are quantized

examples.en: The technician plotted the discrete-time signal as stems at the recorded sample numbers in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，技术员在记录的各采样编号处画出竖线，表示「离散时间信号」。

examples.en: The simulated discrete-time signal used exact real amplitudes even though each value had an integer index.
examples.zh: 模拟的「离散时间信号」为每个值赋予整数索引，幅值仍可取精确实数。

words.enDefinition: Structural analysis solving unknown displacements before recovering corresponding forces

examples.en: The displacement method starts with the unknown movements at the ideal frame joints.
examples.zh: 「位移法」从理想框架节点的未知位移入手。

examples.en: We recovered member forces after solving the joint movements with the displacement method.
examples.zh: 我们用「位移法」求出节点位移后，再由此求得杆件内力。

collocations: solve a frame by the displacement method

words.enDefinition: Variation of displacement produced by excitation or initial conditions in a model

examples.en: We plotted the displacement response after releasing the model from a small offset.
examples.zh: 我们让模型从略微偏离的位置释放，然后画出了「位移响应」。

examples.en: The displacement response shows the motion's changing size during the first several cycles.
examples.zh: 「位移响应」显示了运动幅度在最初几次循环中的变化。

words.enDefinition: a product collected from vapor that leaves a distillation unit, typically after condensation

examples.en: The liquid distillate collected in the modeled receiver contained more of the volatile component than the feed.
examples.zh: 模型接收器里的液态「馏出物」中，易挥发组分的比例比进料高。

examples.en: We distinguished the distillate leaving the modeled column from the condensed liquid returned as reflux.
examples.zh: 我们区分了离开模型塔的「馏出物」和作为回流返回的冷凝液。

words.enDefinition: equipment where rising vapor and descending liquid contact through multiple stages or along packing to separate components

examples.en: The distillation column drawing shows vapor moving upward while the liquid travels toward the bottom.
examples.zh: 「蒸馏塔」图中，蒸气向上移动，液体向塔底流动。

examples.en: We traced the feed, overhead product and bottoms stream across the distillation column boundary in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪进料、塔顶产品和塔底物流穿过「蒸馏塔」边界的位置。

words.enDefinition: a portion collected as a separate product during a particular interval of distillation

examples.en: The distillation fraction collected in the first interval contained more of the volatile component than later portions.
examples.zh: 首个时段收集的「蒸馏馏分」比后续收集的部分含有更多较易挥发的组分。

examples.en: In the simulation, we labeled each distillation fraction with the interval over which it was collected.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，我们给各「蒸馏馏分」标明其收集时段。

words.enDefinition: A load spread along a length or over an area.

examples.en: Our sketch showed a distributed load acting along just the right half of the model beam.
examples.zh: 草图显示，「分布载荷」只作用于模型梁的右半段。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the net force produced by the distributed load in the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们求图中「分布载荷」产生的合力。

collocations: find the resultant of a distributed load
a distributed load over part of the span

words.enDefinition: the ratio of a solute's equilibrium concentration in the extracting phase to its equilibrium concentration in the other phase, under a stated convention

examples.en: We reported the distribution coefficient in extraction with both phase concentrations written using the same units.
examples.zh: 报告「萃取分配系数」时，我们用相同单位写出两个相中的浓度。

examples.en: The distribution coefficient in extraction exceeded one because the modeled solute favored the solvent-rich phase.
examples.zh: 模拟溶质较倾向进入富萃取剂相，因此「萃取分配系数」大于一。

collocations: calculate the distribution coefficient in extraction
measure the distribution coefficient in extraction
report the distribution coefficient in extraction

words.enDefinition: an input other than the control command that affects the controlled process or its measured output

examples.en: The simulation represents an open window as a disturbance input that increases heat loss from the room.
examples.zh: 模拟把打开的窗户表示为会增加房间热损失的「扰动输入」。

examples.en: We added a disturbance input to check how quickly the temperature returned to its setpoint.
examples.zh: 我们加入「扰动输入」，检查温度恢复到设定值需要多长时间。

words.enDefinition: an added atom that can supply an electron to the conduction band of a semiconductor

examples.en: Our band diagram shows a donor impurity level lying close to the conduction band in silicon.
examples.zh: 硅的能带图显示，「施主杂质」的能级靠近导带。

examples.en: An ionized donor impurity leaves a fixed positive charge after its electron enters the conduction band.
examples.zh: 「施主杂质」失去电子后会成为固定的正电荷，电子进入导带。

words.enDefinition: a passage carrying liquid downward from one tray to the next in a column

examples.en: The downcomer appears at the side of the tray and carries liquid to the stage below.
examples.zh: 「降液管」位于塔板侧面，将液体送至下一级。

examples.en: We followed the liquid arrow into the downcomer before locating its outlet in the cutaway drawing.
examples.zh: 我们顺着液流箭头进入「降液管」，然后在剖视图中找到出口。

words.enDefinition: the transistor connection at one end of the channel, conventionally named in relation to the source

examples.en: The drain terminal connects to the load resistor in the amplifier schematic used by the instructor.
examples.zh: 老师所用的放大器电路图中，「漏极端」与负载电阻相连。

examples.en: We read the current entering the drain terminal from the marked trace in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟中有标记的曲线读出流入「漏极端」的电流。

collocations: measure voltage at the drain terminal

words.enDefinition: Area of land draining surface water toward a shared outlet

examples.en: The map outlines a drainage basin whose streams all lead to one outlet.
examples.zh: 地图勾出了一个「流域」，其中各条水流都通向一个出口。

examples.en: We shaded the drainage basin before identifying where the modeled runoff would leave.
examples.zh: 我们给「流域」涂上阴影，再确定模型中的径流从哪里流出。

words.enDefinition: Boundary separating land areas that drain toward different outlets

examples.en: The dashed line is a drainage divide between the two shaded areas.
examples.zh: 虚线是两个阴影区之间的「分水岭」。

examples.en: Runoff on opposite sides of the drainage divide reaches different outlets on our map.
examples.zh: 在我们的地图上，「分水岭」两侧的径流到达不同的出口。

words.enDefinition: The ratio between a length in a drawing and the corresponding actual length.

examples.en: We read the drawing scale before comparing the printed sketch with the actual size of the model.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「图样比例」，再将印出来的草图与模型实际大小比较。

examples.en: The detail used a different drawing scale so we could see the slot shape more clearly.
examples.zh: 详图采用不同的「图样比例」，使我们能更清楚地看到槽的形状。

collocations: a drawing scale in the title block

words.enDefinition: An area identifying a drawing and giving details such as its title, number, or scale.

examples.en: The drawing title block gave the sheet number and scale for the model assembly in our exercise.
examples.zh: 「图样标题栏」给出了练习中模型装配图的图号和比例。

examples.en: We checked the drawing title block to make sure both pages belonged to the same classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们核对「图样标题栏」，确认两页图样都属于同一个课堂模型。

collocations: a scale in the drawing title block
the drawing number in the drawing title block

words.enDefinition: Pulley putting the belt into motion and transmitting power into the drive

examples.en: The motor turns a small drive pulley that carries the belt around the model.
examples.zh: 电机带动一个小「主动带轮」，让皮带绕着模型运行。

examples.en: We labeled the drive pulley at the input end of the demonstration assembly.
examples.zh: 我们在演示组件的输入端标出了「主动带轮」。

words.enDefinition: Rotating member transmitting torque from a driver to another component

examples.en: The drive shaft carries rotation from the small motor to the demonstration wheel.
examples.zh: 「传动轴」将小电机的转动传递给演示用的轮子。

examples.en: We labeled the drive shaft connecting the motor and gearbox in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中标出了连接电机和齿轮箱的「传动轴」。

words.enDefinition: Gear receiving torque and rotation from the mating driver in a stage

examples.en: The driven gear turns more slowly because it has twice as many teeth here.
examples.zh: 这里的「从动齿轮」有主动轮两倍的齿数，因此转得更慢。

examples.en: We drew an arrow showing the driven gear rotating opposite the input gear.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头表示「从动齿轮」的转动方向与输入齿轮相反。

collocations: tooth count of the driven gear

words.enDefinition: Gear supplying torque and rotation to its mating gear in a stage

examples.en: The driver gear is attached to the shaft we turn in the tabletop model.
examples.zh: 「主动齿轮」固定在桌面模型中我们转动的那根轴上。

examples.en: We colored the driver gear blue to distinguish it from the receiving gear.
examples.zh: 我们将「主动齿轮」涂成蓝色，以便区分另一个接受动力的齿轮。

collocations: tooth count of the driver gear

words.enDefinition: A way to express a component amount relative to the mass of material excluding moisture.

examples.en: The dry basis expresses moisture relative to the sample's dry solids in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例按「干基」表示含水量，即用样品干固形物的质量作基准。

examples.en: We converted the illustrated moisture figure to a dry basis using the stated solids mass.
examples.zh: 我们利用给出的固形物质量，将图示含水量换算到「干基」。

collocations: moisture content on a dry basis

words.enDefinition: The mass of the nonwater portion of a material in the stated analysis.

examples.en: The dry solids mass remains unchanged when the worksheet adds plain water to the fictional mixture.
examples.zh: 向虚构混合物加入清水时，练习中的「干固形物质量」保持不变。

examples.en: We subtracted the water mass to determine the dry solids mass in the sample balance.
examples.zh: 我们减去水的质量，以求出样例衡算中的「干固形物质量」。

collocations: dry solids mass of a sample

words.enDefinition: Weight of soil solids divided by the entire volume of the sample

examples.en: The dry unit weight excludes water weight but uses the whole sample volume.
examples.zh: 「干重度」只计固体颗粒的重量，分母使用试样的总体积。

examples.en: We compared the dry unit weight for two dry samples with different packing arrangements.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份颗粒排列不同的干土试样的「干重度」。

collocations: dry unit weight of a sample

words.enDefinition: a graph describing changes in a material's moisture content or drying rate during a drying process

examples.en: The drying curve initially fell steeply when we plotted the sample's moisture content against elapsed time.
examples.zh: 我们将样品含水量对经过时间作图时，「干燥曲线」起初下降很陡。

examples.en: We compared the drying curve for two sample thicknesses using the provided data from the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们使用课堂模型给出的数据，比较两种样品厚度的「干燥曲线」。

words.enDefinition: Contraction of hardened concrete as it loses moisture to its surroundings.

examples.en: The plot showed drying shrinkage after the concrete specimens were exposed to a less humid environment.
examples.zh: 曲线展示了混凝土试样置于湿度较低的环境后发生的「干燥收缩」。

examples.en: We linked drying shrinkage in the textbook example to a gradual decrease in the specimen length.
examples.zh: 我们把教材示例中的「干燥收缩」与试样长度逐渐缩短联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the quantity equal to half the fluid density times the square of its speed

examples.en: At the same density, the dynamic pressure was four times as large after the modeled speed doubled.
examples.zh: 密度相同时，模型中的速度翻倍使「动压」变为原来的四倍。

examples.en: For the ideal incompressible flow, the difference between stagnation and static pressures equaled the dynamic pressure.
examples.zh: 对理想不可压缩流动，滞止压力与静压之差等于「动压」。

words.enDefinition: for a Newtonian fluid, the proportionality constant relating shear stress to shear rate in simple shear

examples.en: The syrup sample had a higher dynamic viscosity than water at the same measured temperature.
examples.zh: 在同样的实测温度下，糖浆样品的「动力黏度」高于水。

examples.en: We estimated dynamic viscosity from the slope of the linear shear stress versus shear rate plot.
examples.zh: 我们用剪切应力对剪切速率的直线斜率估算「动力黏度」。

words.enDefinition: Particle size at which ten percent of the sample by mass is finer

examples.en: We read the effective grain size where the curve reaches ten percent finer by mass.
examples.zh: 我们从曲线上读出「有效粒径」，小于该粒径的颗粒占试样质量的百分之十。

examples.en: The exercises compare effective grain size values for two soils with different size curves.
examples.zh: 习题比较了粒径曲线不同的两种土的「有效粒径」。

words.enDefinition: Stress carried by the soil skeleton after accounting for pore fluid pressure

examples.en: In the saturated soil model, we subtracted pore pressure to calculate effective stress.
examples.zh: 在饱和土模型中，我们减去孔隙水压力，求出了「有效应力」。

examples.en: The effective stress increased as excess water pressure dissipated under constant total stress.
examples.zh: 总应力不变时，随着超额水压消散，「有效应力」增加。

words.enDefinition: A surface deposit of soluble salts left when moisture moves through masonry or concrete and evaporates.

examples.en: The tutor labeled the white deposits on the classroom brick samples as examples of efflorescence.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把课堂砖样上的白色沉积物标为「泛碱」实例。

examples.en: The report noted efflorescence near the mortar joints after showing photographs taken during the wet period.
examples.zh: 报告展示潮湿期间拍摄的照片后，记录了灰缝附近出现的「泛碱」。

words.enDefinition: A change in shape or dimensions that disappears when the load is removed.

examples.en: The small strip showed elastic deformation and returned to its original shape when we released it.
examples.zh: 小条发生了「弹性变形」，松开后便恢复了原形。

examples.en: We used a gentle pull to demonstrate elastic deformation on the model in the teaching lab.
examples.zh: 我们在教学实验室轻拉模型，演示了「弹性变形」。

words.enDefinition: The greatest stress a material can sustain without residual deformation after unloading.

examples.en: The specimen exceeded its elastic limit, so it stayed slightly longer than its original length after the load was removed.
examples.zh: 例题中的试样超过了「弹性极限」，卸载后未恢复原有长度。

examples.en: We discussed why the elastic limit was difficult to locate using only the loading curve.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么仅凭加载曲线难以确定「弹性极限」。

words.enDefinition: The recoverable part of deformation that disappears during unloading.

examples.en: We observed elastic recovery when the loaded strip regained part of its length during unloading.
examples.zh: 卸载时，受载软条的长度有所恢复，我们由此观察到「弹性恢复」。

examples.en: The diagram showed elastic recovery as the horizontal change in strain along the unloading line.
examples.zh: 图中用卸载线上应变方向的水平变化量表示「弹性恢复」。

words.enDefinition: The rate at which a circuit element transfers or converts electrical energy.

examples.en: The electrical power absorbed by the resistor equals its voltage drop multiplied by its current.
examples.zh: 电阻器吸收的「电功率」等于其电压降乘以流过它的电流。

examples.en: We calculated the electrical power transferred by each element in the idealized circuit worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们计算了理想化电路练习中各元件传递的「电功率」。

words.enDefinition: A circuit response near the frequency where inductive and capacitive effects balance, measured through a specified response such as impedance or current.

examples.en: The electrical resonance occurs at the current peak in the simulated series circuit on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，模拟串联电路在电流峰值处出现「电谐振」。

examples.en: We explained electrical resonance by comparing the opposing reactances on the same frequency graph in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们通过比较同一频率图上作用相反的电抗，解释「电谐振」。

collocations: electrical resonance in an RLC circuit

words.enDefinition: an electron promoted to the conduction band and the associated vacancy left in the valence band

examples.en: Absorbing a photon generated an electron-hole pair in the semiconductor shown in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中的半导体吸收一个光子后，产生了一个「电子空穴对」。

examples.en: The simulation shows one electron-hole pair disappearing when the electron recombines with a hole in the sample.
examples.zh: 模拟显示，样品中的电子与空穴复合时，一组「电子空穴对」消失。

words.enDefinition: The increase in length of a specimen or member under load.

examples.en: The longer specimen showed more elongation under the same load in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，相同载荷作用下较长试样的「伸长量」更大。

examples.en: We recorded the elongation as the difference between the current and original distances between the marks.
examples.zh: 我们将两标记之间当前距离与原距离的差记为「伸长量」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of a retained component out of a chromatographic medium as the mobile phase passes through

examples.en: The classroom trace shows elution of the less strongly retained pigment before the second pigment appears.
examples.zh: 课堂曲线显示，保留作用较弱的色素先发生「洗脱」，之后才出现第二种色素。

examples.en: We marked elution for each pigment at the corresponding peak on the simulated detector record.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟检测器记录的对应峰处标明各色素的「洗脱」。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of radiation emitted by a surface to that of a blackbody at the same temperature under corresponding conditions.

examples.en: The surface with higher emissivity emits more radiation at the same temperature in the textbook model.
examples.zh: 教材模型里，温度相同时，「发射率」较高的表面发出更多辐射。

examples.en: We compared emissivity values for the two marked surfaces using the provided classroom material table.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的课堂材料表比较两个标记表面的「发射率」。

words.enDefinition: current through the emitter terminal of a bipolar junction transistor

examples.en: The calculated emitter current equaled the sum of the base and collector current magnitudes under our sign convention.
examples.zh: 按本题的符号约定，算得的「发射极电流」等于基极电流与集电极电流的大小之和。

examples.en: We checked the emitter current in the circuit table after labeling all three reference directions.
examples.zh: 我们标出三个电流的参考方向之后，核对了电路表中的「发射极电流」。

collocations: emitter current in a bipolar transistor

words.enDefinition: The change or rate of change of energy stored within the chosen boundary.

examples.en: Energy accumulation is positive while the water's stored energy increases in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，水所储存的能量增多时，「能量积累」为正。

examples.en: We identified the energy accumulation term before comparing the two heat transfer arrows in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出「能量积累」项，再比较两支表示传热的箭头。

words.enDefinition: An energy balance whose terms are all expressed as energy per unit time.

examples.en: The energy balance in rate form uses watts for each energy transfer on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习在「速率形式的能量衡算」中用瓦特表示各项能量传递速率。

examples.en: We compared the energy balance in rate form with one written over a finite interval.
examples.zh: 我们将「速率形式的能量衡算」与针对有限时段列写的衡算作了比较。

collocations: write an energy balance in rate form
apply an energy balance in rate form
solve an energy balance in rate form

words.enDefinition: Rate at which total hydraulic head decreases with distance along a flow

examples.en: The energy slope is the downward gradient of the energy line on our plot.
examples.zh: 在我们的图中，「能量坡度」是能量线向下的斜率大小。

examples.en: In the uniform flow example, the energy slope matches the slope of the bed.
examples.zh: 在均匀流示例中，「能量坡度」与渠底坡度相等。

words.enDefinition: Wood products manufactured by bonding smaller pieces, veneers, or strands into components.

examples.en: Our tutor used three engineered wood samples to show different ways of combining smaller wood elements.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用三个「工程木材」试样展示组合小木质单元的不同方式。

examples.en: The report grouped the layered panel under engineered wood and described the material between its layers.
examples.zh: 报告把这种层状板材归入「工程木材」，并说明了其层间材料。

words.enDefinition: The iterative process of defining a need, developing alternatives, and checking a proposed solution.

examples.en: The engineering design process started with a classroom problem about organizing tools on a shared desk.
examples.zh: 这次「工程设计过程」从一道课堂题开始，目标是整理共用桌上的工具。

examples.en: Our tutor used the engineering design process to explain why the team revisited its first sketch.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「工程设计过程」说明小组为何重新审视第一张草图。

collocations: a stage of the engineering design process

words.enDefinition: A technical representation that communicates an object's shape, size, or related requirements.

examples.en: The engineering drawing showed the tray from several sides so classmates could understand its shape.
examples.zh: 「工程图样」从多个方向展示托盘，方便同学理解它的形状。

examples.en: We compared the engineering drawing with the classroom model before discussing the missing dimension.
examples.zh: 讨论缺失的尺寸之前，我们先将「工程图样」与课堂模型作了比较。
