examples.en: We assumed incompressible flow in the water example because density changes were negligible under the modeled conditions.
examples.zh: 水流示例所设条件下的密度变化可忽略，因此我们假定为「不可压缩流动」。

examples.en: The incompressible flow model predicted equal volume flow rates at both ends of the steady pipe.
examples.zh: 「不可压缩流动」模型预测，稳态管流两端的体积流量相同。

words.enDefinition: A balance equation that adds a constraint beyond the other equations already listed.

examples.en: The independent balance equation adds information about the sugar amount in the classroom mixture.
examples.zh: 这条「独立衡算方程」增加了课堂混合物中糖含量的信息。

examples.en: We checked whether the total mass equation was an independent balance equation after writing both components.
examples.zh: 写完两个组分的方程后，我们核查总质量方程是否为「独立衡算方程」。

words.enDefinition: The difference obtained by subtracting a reference quantity value from an instrument's indication.

examples.en: The indication error was positive where the instrument displayed a value above the reference length.
examples.zh: 仪器显示值高于参考长度的位置，「示值误差」为正。

examples.en: We used separate columns for the displayed reading and indication error in the calibration example.
examples.zh: 在校准示例中，我们分列显示读数和「示值误差」。

collocations: the indication error at a calibration point

words.enDefinition: The proportionality between an ideal inductor's terminal voltage and the time derivative of its current, in henries.

examples.en: The larger inductance gives a larger voltage for the same current change rate in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，电流变化率相同时，较大的「电感」对应较大的电压。

examples.en: We compared inductance values before calculating the response of the circuit on paper in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先比较「电感」值，再在纸上计算电路的响应。

words.enDefinition: The positive contribution to reactance from an ideal inductor, increasing with frequency for fixed inductance.

examples.en: Inductive reactance increases as the simulated source frequency rises while inductance remains constant in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟中，电感保持恒定时，电源频率上升会使「感抗」增大。

examples.en: We compared inductive reactance at two frequencies given on the worksheet before calculating the current.
examples.zh: 计算电流之前，我们先比较练习给出两个频率下的「感抗」。

words.enDefinition: The rule that an ideal inductor's current cannot change instantaneously with finite voltage.

examples.en: Inductor current continuity gives the same value immediately before and after the simulated switching instant.
examples.zh: 根据「电感电流连续性」，模拟切换瞬间前后的电流值相同。

examples.en: We used inductor current continuity to label the initial current on the worksheet graph.
examples.zh: 我们用「电感电流连续性」在练习图上标出初始电流。

words.enDefinition: A passive circuit element that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it.

examples.en: The inductor stores more energy as the current rises in the worksheet's ideal model.
examples.zh: 练习中的理想模型里，电流升高时，「电感器」储存更多能量。

examples.en: We marked the current through the inductor before reading the simulated voltage trace in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出流过「电感器」的电流，再读模拟电压波形。

words.enDefinition: Frame where an object with zero net force keeps constant velocity

examples.en: The model treats the stationary laboratory floor as an inertial reference frame for the cart.
examples.zh: 在小车模型中，静止的实验室地板视为「惯性参考系」。

examples.en: We described the forces after choosing an inertial reference frame for our motion equations.
examples.zh: 我们先为运动方程选定「惯性参考系」，再描述各个力。

collocations: motion in an inertial reference frame

words.enDefinition: A balance term representing material entering through the boundary during the specified period or per unit time.

examples.en: The inflow term is the sum of the two incoming water streams in the classroom equation.
examples.zh: 课堂方程的「流入项」是两股流入水流的总和。

examples.en: We wrote the inflow term before accounting for the water leaving from the right side.
examples.zh: 在计入从右侧流出的水之前，我们先写出「流入项」。

words.enDefinition: Plot of a chosen structural response as a unit load moves

examples.en: The influence line shows how the selected reaction changes as the unit load moves.
examples.zh: 「影响线」显示单位荷载移动时指定支座反力怎样变化。

examples.en: We compared the influence line with a diagram for one fixed load arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们把「影响线」与一种荷载位置固定时的图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The quantity of material inside the chosen boundary at the beginning of a balance interval.

examples.en: The initial inventory identifies how much sugar solution is already inside the vessel in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「初始存量」表示容器内开始时已有多少糖溶液。

examples.en: We copied the initial inventory from the first column before calculating the net accumulated amount.
examples.zh: 我们从第一列抄下「初始存量」，再计算净积累量。

words.enDefinition: An early defined milestone in the loss of plasticity of cement paste or fresh concrete, identified by a specified test.

examples.en: The material chart marked initial set near the beginning of the interval when the paste lost plasticity.
examples.zh: 材料图在浆体开始失去塑性的区段前端标出了「初凝」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the recorded time of initial set differed between the two binder samples.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释了为什么两个胶结料样品记录的「初凝」时间不同。

words.enDefinition: A stream of material crossing a chosen boundary into a system or unit.

examples.en: The inlet stream crosses the dashed boundary where the top arrow points into the box.
examples.zh: 上方箭头指入方框处，「入口物流」穿过虚线边界。

examples.en: We counted each inlet stream before writing the water balance for the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先数清各股「入口物流」，再为课堂示意图列写水的衡算。

words.enDefinition: The voltage-to-current phasor ratio presented at a network or instrument input at a specified frequency.

examples.en: The input impedance of the model is calculated looking into the two terminals marked in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们从标记的两个端子看入模型，计算其「输入阻抗」。

examples.en: We compared instrument input impedance with the circuit impedance in the simulated measurement example.
examples.zh: 在模拟测量示例中，我们比较仪表「输入阻抗」与电路阻抗。

words.enDefinition: A specific feature or property selected for examination against an inspection requirement.

examples.en: The inspection characteristic in the first row was the width of the slot in the model.
examples.zh: 第一行的「检验特性」是模型上的槽宽。

examples.en: We linked each inspection characteristic to the relevant note on the simplified drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 我们把各项「检验特性」与课堂简化图样上的相应说明关联起来。

collocations: an inspection characteristic on a checklist

words.enDefinition: A document capturing what was examined, the observed results, and other details of an inspection.

examples.en: The inspection record showed which model was checked and which dimensions the student had measured.
examples.zh: 「检验记录」显示了检查的是哪个模型，以及学生测了哪些尺寸。

examples.en: We added the photograph number to the inspection record so another group could find the same example.
examples.zh: 我们把照片编号填入「检验记录」，方便另一组找到同一个示例。

collocations: an entry in the inspection record

words.enDefinition: A finding obtained by examining an item against specified inspection criteria.

examples.en: The inspection result identified a visible tear on the edge of the first classroom model.
examples.zh: 「检验结果」指出第一个课堂模型边缘有一处可见的撕裂。

examples.en: We discussed the second inspection result after locating the matching observation in our practice table.
examples.zh: 在练习表中找到对应的观察结果后，我们讨论了第二项「检验结果」。

words.enDefinition: Point with zero velocity at an instant in nontranslating planar rigid-body motion

examples.en: For our rolling wheel, the instantaneous center of zero velocity lies at the point touching the stationary track.
examples.zh: 对于我们研究的滚动车轮，「速度瞬心」位于接触静止轨道的点。

examples.en: We located the instantaneous center of zero velocity using perpendicular lines through two points with known velocity directions.
examples.zh: 我们通过两个速度方向已知的点作各自速度的垂线，找到了「速度瞬心」。

collocations: locate the instantaneous center of zero velocity
use the instantaneous center of zero velocity
draw the instantaneous center of zero velocity

words.enDefinition: Establishing how an instrument's indications relate to known reference values and their uncertainties.

examples.en: The instrument calibration notes compared the displayed lengths with the values listed for the reference pieces.
examples.zh: 「仪器校准」记录把仪器显示的长度与参考件标注的量值作了比较。

examples.en: We consulted the instrument calibration record before interpreting the difference between the laboratory readings.
examples.zh: 解释实验室读数之间的差异之前，我们先查阅了「仪器校准」记录。

words.enDefinition: A difference in indications for the same input depending on whether that input approached from above or below.

examples.en: The chart showed instrument hysteresis where increasing and decreasing inputs produced different readings at equal values.
examples.zh: 当增加和减小输入在相同输入值处产生不同读数时，图中显示出「仪器回程差」。

examples.en: We marked the gap between the two traces to illustrate instrument hysteresis in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们标出两条曲线之间的间距，说明课堂模型中的「仪器回程差」。

collocations: instrument hysteresis on a response plot

words.enDefinition: The smallest change in the measured quantity that produces a perceptible change in an instrument's indication.

examples.en: The instrument resolution mattered because the two classroom blocks differed in length by only a little.
examples.zh: 两个课堂方块的长度相差很小，因此「仪器分辨力」很重要。

examples.en: We compared instrument resolution before interpreting why the displays showed the same number for both samples.
examples.zh: 我们先比较「仪器分辨力」，再解释为何仪器对两件样品显示相同数字。

words.enDefinition: A material balance that compares transfers and changes in stored amounts over a finite time interval.

examples.en: The integral material balance compares the total water entering during the interval with the inventory increase.
examples.zh: 「积分式物料衡算」将时段内流入的总水量与存量增加量比较。

examples.en: We wrote an integral material balance using the start and end amounts on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习给出的起始量与结束量，写出「积分式物料衡算」。

collocations: integral material balance over an interval

words.enDefinition: a property that does not depend on the amount of material in a uniform system

examples.en: Temperature is an intensive property because dividing a uniform sample leaves both portions at the same temperature.
examples.zh: 温度是「强度性质」，因为把均匀样品分成两部分后，两部分的温度不变。

examples.en: We classified density as an intensive property for the uniform liquid in the example.
examples.zh: 我们把示例中均匀液体的密度归为「强度性质」。

collocations: classify a quantity as an intensive property

words.enDefinition: A requirement governing how two components connect, fit together, or exchange information.

examples.en: The interface requirement described how the two cardboard modules were supposed to line up in the model.
examples.zh: 「接口要求」说明了模型中的两个纸板模块应如何对齐。

examples.en: We found an interface requirement that applied to both halves of the classroom organizer.
examples.zh: 我们找到一项同时适用于课堂收纳盒两部分的「接口要求」。

words.enDefinition: The concentration of a component on a specified side of the boundary between phases or materials.

examples.en: The interfacial concentration is labelled on the liquid side of the line in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习把「界面浓度」标在分界线的液体侧。

examples.en: We compared interfacial concentration with the value in the main liquid on the class sketch.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂草图中的「界面浓度」与液体主体内的浓度。

words.enDefinition: A fit whose permitted dimensions make a mating outer feature larger than its matching opening.

examples.en: The diagram illustrated an interference fit by showing the model insert slightly wider than the opening.
examples.zh: 示意图显示模型嵌件略宽于开口，以说明「过盈配合」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which size limits represented an interference fit in the simplified classroom assembly example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在简化的课堂装配例题中，哪些尺寸极限表示「过盈配合」。

collocations: an interference fit between mating parts

words.enDefinition: energy associated with the microscopic motion and interactions of the constituents of a system

examples.en: The internal energy of the gas rose when heating increased its temperature in the sealed vessel.
examples.zh: 在密封容器中加热使气体温度升高，气体的「内能」增加。

examples.en: We separated internal energy from the energy of the cylinder's motion through the room.
examples.zh: 我们把「内能」与气缸在室内整体运动的能量分开。

words.enDefinition: A force transmitted across a section between parts of the same body.

examples.en: The internal force appeared on our drawing only after we separated one part from the other.
examples.zh: 我们把物体分为两部分后，才在图上画出了「内力」。

examples.en: The tutor drew the internal force in opposite directions on the two faces of the cut.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在切口相对的两个面上画出方向相反的「内力」。

collocations: find an internal force at a cut
resolve an internal force into components

words.enDefinition: A resistance inside a source or represented in its model that affects its terminal behaviour.

examples.en: The internal resistance causes the model battery's terminal voltage to fall as its load current rises.
examples.zh: 随着负载电流增加，「内阻」使模型电池的端电压下降。

examples.en: We estimated internal resistance using the two supplied voltage and current readings in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习提供的两组电压和电流读数估算「内阻」。

collocations: model a source with internal resistance

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor in which thermally generated electrons and holes occur in equal concentrations without appreciable impurity effects

examples.en: The intrinsic semiconductor model predicts equal concentrations of electrons and holes at the same temperature.
examples.zh: 「本征半导体」模型预测，在同一温度下电子与空穴的浓度相等。

examples.en: Our diagram starts with an intrinsic semiconductor to show what changes when donor atoms are added.
examples.zh: 图中先从「本征半导体」出发，展示加入施主原子后发生的变化。

collocations: carrier concentration in an intrinsic semiconductor

words.enDefinition: an amplifier configuration whose output varies in the opposite direction to its applied input signal

examples.en: The simulated inverting amplifier produced a positive output swing in response to a negative input swing.
examples.zh: 模拟的「反相放大器」对负向输入变化给出正向输出变化。

examples.en: We read the inverting amplifier gain from the downward slope of the output versus input plot.
examples.zh: 我们用输出对输入图像向下的斜率读出「反相放大器」的增益。

words.enDefinition: the terminal of a differential amplifier at which a higher voltage tends to lower the output

examples.en: The inverting input is labeled with a minus sign on the operational amplifier symbol in our notes.
examples.zh: 笔记里，运算放大器符号上的减号标记的是「反相输入端」。

examples.en: We increased the voltage at the inverting input and watched the open-loop output decrease in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们提高「反相输入端」电压，在模拟中看到开环输出下降。

collocations: apply a signal to the inverting input

words.enDefinition: flow modeled without the effects of fluid viscosity

examples.en: The worksheet assumed inviscid flow so students could isolate the role of pressure and elevation.
examples.zh: 为让学生单独观察压力和高度的作用，练习假定为「无黏流动」。

examples.en: We compared the inviscid flow prediction with measurements showing substantial loss along the rough pipe.
examples.zh: 我们把「无黏流动」预测与实测作比较，实测显示粗糙管道沿程损失明显。

words.enDefinition: a process in which a material releases its counterions while taking up other ions from a solution

examples.en: The classroom model uses ion exchange to replace dissolved calcium ions with sodium ions from the material.
examples.zh: 课堂模型用「离子交换」将溶液中的钙离子换成材料中的钠离子。

examples.en: We drew separate arrows for ions entering and leaving to illustrate the exchange involved in ion exchange.
examples.zh: 我们分别画出离子进出的箭头，展示「离子交换」中的互换过程。

words.enDefinition: a solid polymer containing fixed charged groups whose mobile counterions can be replaced by solution ions

examples.en: The ion-exchange resin is drawn as tiny beads in the column sketch on the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义的柱体图中，「离子交换树脂」画成细小的珠粒。

examples.en: The model shows the ion-exchange resin retaining calcium while releasing other ions into the flowing water.
examples.zh: 模型显示，「离子交换树脂」截留钙离子，同时向流动的水中释放其他离子。

words.enDefinition: a process that cannot be undone without leaving a net change in the system or its surroundings

examples.en: Mixing the warm and cool water was an irreversible process that generated entropy within the container.
examples.zh: 将温水与冷水混合是「不可逆过程」，会在容器内部产生熵。

examples.en: The irreversible process dissipated mechanical energy through friction between the two sliding surfaces in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的两个表面相互滑动，摩擦使机械能在「不可逆过程」中耗散。

collocations: entropy generation in an irreversible process

words.enDefinition: a process during which the entropy of a fixed mass, or specific entropy of a modeled stream, remains constant

examples.en: In the isentropic process, the gas changed pressure and temperature while its specific entropy stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在「等熵过程」中，气体压力和温度变化，比熵保持不变。

examples.en: We compared the measured turbine outlet state with the state predicted by an ideal isentropic process.
examples.zh: 我们将实测的涡轮出口状态与理想「等熵过程」预测的状态作比较。

words.enDefinition: To separate an object conceptually so its external forces and moments can be shown.

examples.en: We had to isolate a body from its surroundings before deciding which forces to draw.
examples.zh: 我们先「隔离物体」，再确定需要画出哪些力。

examples.en: The first question asked us to isolate a body and replace its supports with reaction arrows.
examples.zh: 第一题要求我们「隔离物体」，用反力箭头代替支座。

collocations: isolate a body from its surroundings
isolate a body in a free-body diagram

words.enDefinition: a system that exchanges neither matter nor energy with its surroundings

examples.en: We approximated the sealed, rigid and insulated classroom container as an isolated system for the first calculation.
examples.zh: 第一次计算时，我们把课堂上密封、刚性且隔热的容器近似作为「孤立系统」。

examples.en: For an isolated system, the total energy remains fixed while energy can move internally.
examples.zh: 对「孤立系统」而言，总能量保持不变，能量可以在系统内部转移。

collocations: conserve energy in an isolated system

words.enDefinition: A pictorial drawing using the same scale along three equally spaced axes.

examples.en: The isometric drawing let us see the top and two sides of the cardboard model at once.
examples.zh: 用「等轴测图」，我们可以同时看到纸板模型的顶面和两个侧面。

examples.en: Our worksheet placed the isometric drawing beside the separate front and side views of the part.
examples.zh: 习题把「等轴测图」放在部件各自的正视图和侧视图旁边。

collocations: an isometric drawing of a part

words.enDefinition: a thermodynamic process during which the system temperature remains constant

examples.en: The isothermal process kept the gas temperature fixed while its volume changed in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中的「等温过程」在改变气体体积的同时保持其温度不变。

examples.en: We recognized the isothermal process by the constant temperature marked at each state along the path.
examples.zh: 看到路径上各状态的温度标值相同，我们认出了「等温过程」。

collocations: isothermal process for an ideal gas

words.enDefinition: Traffic density corresponding to tightly packed stationary vehicles in a model

examples.en: The model's jam density occurs where the speed curve reaches zero at high density.
examples.zh: 在高密度处，速度曲线降到零时对应模型的「阻塞密度」。

examples.en: We read jam density at the far right of the modeled flow curve.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟交通流率曲线的最右端读出了「阻塞密度」。

words.enDefinition: Plain bearing supporting a rotating shaft at a cylindrical journal surface

examples.en: The drawing places a journal bearing around the cylindrical section of the drive shaft.
examples.zh: 图中在传动轴的圆柱形轴颈外设置了「轴颈轴承」。

examples.en: We traced the sideways load from the shaft into the journal bearing.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了横向载荷从轴传递到「轴颈轴承」的路径。

words.enDefinition: the absolute temperature scale using the kelvin with zero at absolute zero

examples.en: On the Kelvin scale, the freezing point of pure water at standard pressure is about 273.15 kelvins.
examples.zh: 在「开尔文温标」上，标准压力下纯水的冰点约为 273.15 开尔文。

examples.en: We labelled the vertical axis using the Kelvin scale for the gas law graph.
examples.zh: 绘制气体定律图时，我们用「开尔文温标」为纵轴标注刻度。

collocations: express temperature on the Kelvin scale

words.enDefinition: Slot in a shaft or hub that receives a torque-transmitting key

examples.en: The shaft drawing includes a keyway running along its top surface.
examples.zh: 轴的图纸上画了一个沿其顶部表面延伸的「键槽」。

examples.en: We found the keyway by looking for the recess inside the hub.
examples.zh: 我们通过查找轮毂内的凹槽找到了「键槽」。

words.enDefinition: Lumber dried in a chamber with controlled temperature and humidity.

examples.en: The materials label said kiln-dried lumber and described how the board's moisture had been reduced.
examples.zh: 材料标签注明这是「窑干木材」，并说明板材的含水量如何降低。

examples.en: We found kiln-dried lumber in the sample list beside a board described as air dried.
examples.zh: 我们在样品清单中看到「窑干木材」和旁边一块标注为自然风干的板材。

collocations: the moisture content of kiln-dried lumber

words.enDefinition: dynamic viscosity divided by fluid density, with units of area per unit time

examples.en: The worksheet divided the oil's dynamic viscosity by its density to obtain the kinematic viscosity.
examples.zh: 练习用油的动力黏度除以其密度，得到「运动黏度」。

examples.en: We used length, speed and kinematic viscosity to calculate the Reynolds number in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用长度、流速和「运动黏度」计算雷诺数。

collocations: express kinematic viscosity in square metres per second

words.enDefinition: The circuit rule that the algebraic sum of currents at a node is zero.

examples.en: Kirchhoff's current law gives the unknown outgoing current from the other labelled branch currents in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，我们用「基尔霍夫电流定律」根据其他已知支路电流求未知流出电流。

examples.en: We applied Kirchhoff's current law at the middle node of the ideal circuit on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上对理想电路的中间节点应用「基尔霍夫电流定律」。

collocations: Kirchhoff's current law at a node

words.enDefinition: The lumped-circuit rule that the algebraic sum of voltage changes around a closed loop is zero.

examples.en: Kirchhoff's voltage law balances the source rise with the resistor drops in the worksheet loop.
examples.zh: 练习回路里，「基尔霍夫电压定律」使电源带来的电压升高与各电阻器的压降相抵。

examples.en: We applied Kirchhoff's voltage law after choosing a direction around the loop on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先选择沿图中回路的绕行方向，再应用「基尔霍夫电压定律」。

collocations: Kirchhoff's voltage law around a loop

words.enDefinition: A notebook recording an investigation's setup, observations, decisions and data as the work proceeds.

examples.en: I sketched the cardboard setup in my lab notebook before recording results from the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我先在「实验记录本」里画出纸板装置，再记录课堂实验结果。

examples.en: The lab notebook showed when we switched to a second sample during the comparison.
examples.zh: 「实验记录本」显示了我们在比较中何时换用了第二件试样。

collocations: record data in a lab notebook

words.enDefinition: A sinusoidal current whose phase is behind the compared voltage at the same frequency.

examples.en: The lagging current reaches its peak after the voltage in the ideal inductor example.
examples.zh: 在理想电感器示例中，「滞后电流」晚于电压达到峰值。

examples.en: We identified the lagging current after comparing corresponding zero crossings on the two simulated waveforms.
examples.zh: 我们比较两条模拟波形对应的过零点，找出「滞后电流」。

words.enDefinition: ordered fluid motion with limited mixing between adjacent layers and no turbulent velocity fluctuations

examples.en: The dye remained in a narrow line during laminar flow through the clear demonstration tube.
examples.zh: 在透明演示管中呈现「层流」时，染料保持为一条细线。

examples.en: We compared the measured speed distribution with the parabolic profile expected for fully developed pipe laminar flow.
examples.zh: 我们将测得的速度分布与圆管内充分发展「层流」的抛物线速度分布作比较。

words.enDefinition: Engineered lumber formed by bonding thin wood veneers with most grain directions parallel.

examples.en: The cut end of the laminated veneer lumber showed several thin, tightly bonded wood layers in the photograph.
examples.zh: 照片中，「单板层积材」的端部切面露出数层紧密胶合的薄木片。

examples.en: We traced the grain direction on the laminated veneer lumber diagram while comparing it with plywood.
examples.zh: 比较「单板层积材」和胶合板时，我们在前者的示意图上描出了木纹方向。

collocations: a sample of laminated veneer lumber
the layers in laminated veneer lumber

words.enDefinition: A reinforcement connection in which bar ends overlap so that forces can transfer through surrounding material.

examples.en: The figure labeled the region where the two bars overlapped as a lap splice in the detail.
examples.zh: 详图把两根钢筋重叠的区域标为「搭接接头」。

examples.en: We compared a lap splice with a connection that used a separate sleeve between the bars.
examples.zh: 我们把「搭接接头」与两根钢筋之间使用独立套筒的连接方式作了比较。

collocations: a lap splice between reinforcing bars
the location of a lap splice

words.enDefinition: energy absorbed or released during an equilibrium phase change of a pure substance at constant pressure and temperature

examples.en: The plateau occurred because latent heat was absorbed while the solid melted at constant temperature.
examples.zh: 固体在恒温下融化时吸收「潜热」，因此曲线上出现平台。

examples.en: Our calculation included latent heat to account for the energy released when vapor condensed.
examples.zh: 我们在计算中计入「潜热」，以解释蒸气凝结时释放的能量。

words.enDefinition: heat needed per unit mass to change a substance from solid to liquid at its melting point

examples.en: We used the latent heat of fusion to estimate the energy needed to melt the ice.
examples.zh: 我们用「熔化潜热」估算冰融化需要的能量。

examples.en: The table reports a different latent heat of fusion for each material at its melting point.
examples.zh: 表中列出每种材料在其熔点处各自的「熔化潜热」。

collocations: measure the latent heat of fusion
look up the latent heat of fusion
calculate melting energy from the latent heat of fusion

words.enDefinition: heat needed per unit mass to change saturated liquid into saturated vapor at a specified pressure

examples.en: We estimated the latent heat of vaporization from the energy supplied and the mass of water boiled away.
examples.zh: 我们用输入的能量和沸腾蒸发掉的水的质量估算「汽化潜热」。

examples.en: The steam table lists the latent heat of vaporization at several pressures along the saturation curve.
examples.zh: 蒸汽表列出饱和曲线上几个压力对应的「汽化潜热」。

collocations: measure the latent heat of vaporization
look up the latent heat of vaporization
dependence of latent heat of vaporization on pressure

words.enDefinition: The fractional dimensional change perpendicular to the direction of a uniaxial load.

examples.en: We recorded negative lateral strain when the sample became narrower during the classroom tension test.
examples.zh: 课堂拉伸试验中，试样变窄时，我们记录到负的「横向应变」。

examples.en: The tutor compared lateral strain across the width with axial strain along the length of the strip.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了软条宽度方向的「横向应变」和长度方向的轴向应变。

words.enDefinition: A line connecting a note, symbol, or dimension to the feature it describes.

examples.en: The leader line pointed from the written note to the small notch in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 「引出线」从文字说明指向课堂图样中的小缺口。

examples.en: The tutor moved the label but kept the end of its leader line on the same edge.
examples.zh: 辅导老师移动了标签，「引出线」末端仍指在同一条边上。

collocations: a leader line pointing to a feature
attach a note with a leader line

words.enDefinition: A sinusoidal current whose phase is ahead of the compared voltage at the same frequency.

examples.en: The leading current reaches its peak before the voltage in the ideal capacitor trace shown.
examples.zh: 在所示理想电容器图线上，「超前电流」早于电压达到峰值。

examples.en: We labelled the leading current in the phase comparison for the simulated capacitive branch.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟电容支路的相位比较图上标出「超前电流」。

words.enDefinition: a diode that emits light as electrons recombine with holes under forward operation

examples.en: The display lights up because each light-emitting diode converts part of its electrical input into visible light.
examples.zh: 显示屏会亮起，因为每个「发光二极管」都将一部分输入电能转化为可见光。

examples.en: The drawing uses arrows pointing out of the symbol to represent a light-emitting diode.
examples.zh: 图中用从符号向外的箭头来表示「发光二极管」。

words.enDefinition: Concrete with lower density than conventional concrete, often made with lightweight aggregate or additional voids.

examples.en: The lightweight concrete sample had a lower mass than the other specimen of the same size.
examples.zh: 体积相同的两个试样中，「轻质混凝土」样品的质量较小。

examples.en: Our lecture notes linked lightweight concrete to the porous aggregate shown on the materials tray.
examples.zh: 课堂笔记将「轻质混凝土」与材料托盘上展示的多孔集料联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Finely ground limestone used as a filler or fine constituent in a cementitious mixture.

examples.en: The mix table identified limestone filler as a finely ground powder in the classroom concrete example.
examples.zh: 配合比表注明，课堂混凝土示例中的「石灰石填料」是一种细磨粉料。

examples.en: The tutor compared the grain sizes of limestone filler and the visibly coarser limestone aggregate sample.
examples.zh: 辅导老师比较了「石灰石填料」与明显更粗的石灰石集料样品的粒径。

words.enDefinition: The stated largest and smallest permissible sizes for a feature.

examples.en: The worksheet gave two limit dimensions for the slot instead of one size with a tolerance.
examples.zh: 习题直接给出槽的两个「极限尺寸」。

examples.en: We compared the measured width with both limit dimensions shown on the sample drawing in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将实测宽度与示例图样上的两个「极限尺寸」比较。

words.enDefinition: The straight line through the application point in the direction of the force.

examples.en: The line of action passed through the pivot, so the force had no moment about it.
examples.zh: 这条「力的作用线」穿过支点，因此该力对支点的力矩为零。

examples.en: We extended the line of action of the angled force before measuring the perpendicular distance.
examples.zh: 我们延长了斜向力的「作用线」，再测量垂直距离。

collocations: a perpendicular distance to the line of action

words.enDefinition: a spectrum consisting of contributions at isolated frequencies, as for an ideal periodic signal

examples.en: The line spectrum had marks only at the fundamental and several of its multiples in the sketch.
examples.zh: 示意图中的「线状频谱」只在基频及其若干整数倍处有标记。

examples.en: We drew the line spectrum after calculating the nonzero Fourier series coefficients for the repeated waveform.
examples.zh: 我们算出重复波形的非零傅里叶级数系数后，画出「线状频谱」。

collocations: line spectrum of a periodic signal

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose response satisfies scaling and addition with respect to its inputs under fixed conditions.

examples.en: The linear circuit doubles its predicted current when we double the model's only source voltage.
examples.zh: 将模型唯一的电源电压加倍时，「线性电路」的预测电流也加倍。

examples.en: We checked the linear circuit assumptions before adding the separate responses in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「线性电路」的假设，再把练习中的各项响应相加。

words.enDefinition: The range in which stress is proportional to strain and deformation is recoverable.

examples.en: The sample stayed in the linear elastic range, so its original length returned when we removed the load.
examples.zh: 试样处于「线弹性范围」内，因此卸载后恢复原长度。

examples.en: We fitted a straight line using only points from the linear elastic range of the plotted test data.
examples.zh: 拟合直线时，我们只使用了测试图中位于「线弹性范围」内的点。

collocations: stay within the linear elastic range
the slope in the linear elastic range
load within the linear elastic range

words.enDefinition: Time integral of a force, giving its accumulated effect over an interval

examples.en: We calculated linear impulse from the area under the force curve in our example.
examples.zh: 我们用示例中力曲线下方的带符号面积求出「线冲量」。

examples.en: The same linear impulse can result from different force histories in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，力随时间的不同变化过程可以产生相同的「线冲量」。

collocations: linear impulse delivered by a force

words.enDefinition: Rule equating net external force impulse to the change in linear momentum

examples.en: The linear impulse-momentum principle relates the impulse during the push to the cart's momentum change.
examples.zh: 「线冲量动量原理」把推动时的冲量与小车动量的变化联系起来。

examples.en: We used the linear impulse-momentum principle to calculate the cart's change in velocity after a brief push.
examples.zh: 我们用「线冲量动量原理」计算短暂推动后小车速度的变化。

words.enDefinition: Vector obtained by multiplying an object's mass by its velocity

examples.en: The two carts have equal linear momentum values when their masses and velocities match.
examples.zh: 两辆小车的质量和速度分别相同时，它们的「线动量」相等。

examples.en: We drew an arrow for the cart's linear momentum along its velocity direction.
examples.zh: 我们沿小车的速度方向画出箭头来表示它的「线动量」。

words.enDefinition: Spring modeled with force proportional to extension or compression over its range

examples.en: A linear spring produces twice the force magnitude when its extension is doubled.
examples.zh: 「线性弹簧」的伸长量加倍时，力的大小也加倍。

examples.en: The worksheet represents the linear spring with a straight force versus displacement line.
examples.zh: 习题用一条力随位移变化的直线表示「线性弹簧」。

words.enDefinition: a system satisfying superposition whose response to a delayed input is the same response delayed by that amount

examples.en: A linear time-invariant system produced the same waveform later when we delayed the input in simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中延迟输入后，「线性时不变系统」以同样的延迟输出了相同波形。

examples.en: We checked superposition and time-shift behavior before treating the model as a linear time-invariant system in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先检查叠加和时移特性，再把模型看作「线性时不变系统」。

collocations: response of a linear time-invariant system

words.enDefinition: A distributed load whose intensity changes linearly with position.

examples.en: The arrows for the linearly varying load grew steadily longer from left to right in our sketch.
examples.zh: 在草图中，表示「线性变化载荷」的箭头从左向右均匀变长。

examples.en: We calculated the resultant of a linearly varying load by finding the area below its intensity line.
examples.zh: 我们求出强度线下方的面积，从而得到「线性变化载荷」的合力。

collocations: find the resultant of a linearly varying load

words.enDefinition: Water content marking the conventional boundary between plastic and liquid soil states

examples.en: We marked the liquid limit where the model transitions from plastic to liquid behavior.
examples.zh: 我们在模型由塑性状态转为液态的位置标出了「液限」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the liquid limit values of two hypothetical fine soil samples.
examples.zh: 老师比较了两个假想细粒土试样的「液限」。

words.enDefinition: separation in which a solute partitions between two contacting liquid phases with limited mutual solubility

examples.en: The liquid-liquid extraction diagram shows the model food color moving preferentially into one of two layers.
examples.zh: 「液液萃取」图显示，模拟的食用色素优先转入两层液体中的一层。

examples.en: We used two different colors on the liquid-liquid extraction flowchart to distinguish the outlet phases.
examples.zh: 我们在「液液萃取」流程图中使用两种不同颜色区分出口相。

words.enDefinition: the proportions of components present in a mixture's liquid phase on a stated basis

examples.en: The liquid-phase composition was read from the lower curve on the worksheet's constant-pressure equilibrium chart.
examples.zh: 在练习给定的定压平衡图上，从较低的曲线读取「液相组成」。

examples.en: We expressed liquid-phase composition in mole fractions to match the values listed for the vapor.
examples.zh: 我们用摩尔分数表达「液相组成」，与列出的气相数值采用同一基准。

words.enDefinition: Water content above the plastic limit divided by the plasticity index

examples.en: We used the liquidity index to locate the sample within its plastic range.
examples.zh: 我们用「液性指数」确定试样位于塑性范围的什么位置。

examples.en: The liquidity index is zero when the water content equals the plastic limit.
examples.zh: 含水率等于塑限时，「液性指数」为零。

words.enDefinition: Variable loading due to use or occupancy, such as people or movable objects

examples.en: The moving figures represent live load in our classroom model of a floor.
examples.zh: 在课堂楼板模型中，移动的人形代表「活载」。

examples.en: We drew the live load separately from the fixed weight of the floor.
examples.zh: 我们把「活载」和楼板固定不变的重量分开画。

words.enDefinition: The amount of distributed force per unit length or area at a location.

examples.en: We labelled the load intensity in newtons per metre on the vertical axis of our plot.
examples.zh: 我们在图的纵轴上标注了「载荷强度」，单位是牛顿每米。

examples.en: The triangle showed zero load intensity at one end and its largest value at the other.
examples.zh: 三角形图示的一端「载荷强度」为零，另一端为最大值。

words.enDefinition: Route by which forces pass through structural members toward their supports

examples.en: We drew arrows along the load path from the model floor to its supports.
examples.zh: 我们画出箭头，表示从模型楼板到其支座的「传力路径」。

examples.en: The diagram compares the load path for vertical and horizontal actions in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图比较了竖向作用和水平作用各自的「传力路径」。

words.enDefinition: The resistance presented by the component or network receiving power from a source.

examples.en: The load resistance determines how much current the given equivalent source supplies in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，「负载电阻」决定给定等效电源提供多少电流。

examples.en: We changed the load resistance in the simulation and observed a different terminal voltage.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中改变「负载电阻」，看到端电压发生变化。

collocations: load resistance seen by a source

words.enDefinition: A diagram indicating the positions, directions, and sizes of loads applied to a member.

examples.en: The loading diagram showed where the downward arrows began and ended along the small model beam.
examples.zh: 「载荷图」显示了小型梁模型上向下的箭头从哪里开始、到哪里结束。

examples.en: We used the loading diagram to check whether the second force was closer to the right support.
examples.zh: 我们用「载荷图」核对第二个力是否更靠近右支座。

collocations: read load values from a loading diagram

words.enDefinition: a logarithmic average of two terminal temperature differences used as an effective heat transfer driving difference in ideal exchanger models

examples.en: We found the log mean temperature difference from the two positive terminal differences in the counterflow example.
examples.zh: 我们根据逆流示例中两端的两个正温差，求出「对数平均温差」。

examples.en: When both terminal differences were equal, the log mean temperature difference reduced to their common value.
examples.zh: 当两端温差相等时，「对数平均温差」等于这一共同值。

collocations: calculate the log mean temperature difference
use the log mean temperature difference

words.enDefinition: Natural logarithm of the ratio of successive same-direction free-decay peak amplitudes

examples.en: We found the logarithmic decrement from two successive positive peaks in the decay curve.
examples.zh: 我们用衰减曲线上相邻的两个正峰求出了「对数减量」。

examples.en: The tutor used the logarithmic decrement to estimate damping from the model's recorded motion.
examples.zh: 老师用「对数减量」从模型的运动记录中估算阻尼。

collocations: estimate damping using the logarithmic decrement
logarithmic decrement of a decay trace

words.enDefinition: a filter passing frequencies below a chosen band edge while attenuating higher frequencies

examples.en: The low-pass filter removed much of the rapid fluctuation from the simulated temperature signal in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「低通滤波器」减少了模拟温度信号中大部分的快速波动。

examples.en: We compared audio before and after the low-pass filter reduced the brighter high-frequency components of the sound.
examples.zh: 「低通滤波器」减弱了声音中较明亮的高频成分，我们比较了滤波前后的音频。

words.enDefinition: A heat transfer model that treats a body as having one uniform, time-varying temperature.

examples.en: The lumped-capacitance model assigns one temperature to the entire piece at each time in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「集总热容模型」在每一时刻用同一个温度描述整个物体。

examples.en: We discussed whether the lumped-capacitance model was appropriate for the illustrated temperature profiles in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论「集总热容模型」是否适用于图示的温度分布。

words.enDefinition: Individual component serving a distinct mechanical role in a larger assembly

examples.en: We chose a machine element from the diagram and described what it does.
examples.zh: 我们从图中选了一个「机械元件」，并描述了它的作用。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which machine element transfers the rotation between the two assemblies.
examples.zh: 习题问哪个「机械元件」在两个组件之间传递转动。

words.enDefinition: the magnitude of a system's frequency response, giving the amplitude ratio at each frequency

examples.en: The magnitude response stayed close to one for low-frequency inputs in the idealized filter model.
examples.zh: 在理想化滤波器模型中，低频输入对应的「幅频响应」接近一。

examples.en: We read the magnitude response first to determine which of the two tones would be weaker.
examples.zh: 为判断哪种音调会变得更弱，我们先读取「幅频响应」。

words.enDefinition: the mobile charge carrier type with the higher concentration in a semiconductor region

examples.en: The electron is the majority carrier in the donor-doped region marked on the band diagram.
examples.zh: 在能带图标出的施主掺杂区域，电子是「多数载流子」。

examples.en: We identified the majority carrier by comparing the hole and electron concentrations in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们通过比较练习中的空穴和电子浓度，判断何者是「多数载流子」。

words.enDefinition: Empirical coefficient representing flow resistance in the Manning relationship

examples.en: The Manning roughness coefficient differs between two ideal surfaces in our comparison.
examples.zh: 在我们的对比中，两种理想表面的「曼宁糙率系数」不同。

examples.en: We varied only the Manning roughness coefficient to see how the model predictions changed.
examples.zh: 我们仅改变「曼宁糙率系数」，观察模型预测怎样变化。

collocations: Manning roughness coefficient for a model
sensitivity to the Manning roughness coefficient

words.enDefinition: Empirical relation linking uniform open-channel flow speed with section, slope, and roughness

examples.en: The tutor used Manning's equation to compare two hypothetical reaches with different roughness.
examples.zh: 老师用「曼宁公式」比较了两个糙率不同的假想渠段。

examples.en: We labeled the variables in Manning's equation on a simplified classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的课堂示意图中标出了「曼宁公式」的变量。

collocations: apply Manning's equation in a model

words.enDefinition: an instrument using a liquid column height difference to measure a pressure difference

examples.en: The two columns of the manometer settled at different heights when the inlet pressure changed.
examples.zh: 入口压力改变后，「液柱压力计」的两侧液柱在不同高度稳定下来。

examples.en: We read the liquid levels from the manometer and calculated the pressure difference in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们从「液柱压力计」读出液面高度，并计算压力差。

words.enDefinition: A single row or layer of brick, block, or stone units in masonry.

examples.en: The mason's drawing showed one masonry course above the upper edge of the opening in the model.
examples.zh: 砌筑图纸显示，模型洞口上缘上方有「一皮砌体」。

examples.en: We outlined each masonry course on the elevation to check where the pattern began repeating.
examples.zh: 我们在立面图上标出「每一皮砌体」，检查砌筑图案从哪里开始重复。

words.enDefinition: A flowable cementitious mixture that fills masonry cells or spaces, sometimes around reinforcement.

examples.en: The cutaway displayed masonry grout inside the block cells and mortar between the units in the example.
examples.zh: 剖开示意图展示了砌块孔内的「砌体灌浆料」和砌块间的砂浆。

examples.en: We matched masonry grout to the shaded material in the center of the sample block.
examples.zh: 我们把标注的「砌体灌浆料」与试样砌块中央着色的材料对应起来。

words.enDefinition: An individual brick, block, or stone used as a component of masonry.

examples.en: We chose one masonry unit from the tray and found its matching outline in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们从托盘里选取一个「砌体单元」，在图纸上找出相应的轮廓。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the larger masonry unit when comparing the two wall models in class.
examples.zh: 课堂比较两个墙体模型时，辅导老师指向较大的「砌体单元」。

collocations: the face of a masonry unit

words.enDefinition: A facing layer of masonry units tied or bonded to a backing wall.

examples.en: The model section showed a thin masonry veneer on the outer side of the wall assembly.
examples.zh: 模型剖面在墙体构造的外侧画了一层薄薄的「砌体饰面」。

examples.en: We highlighted the masonry veneer in the elevation and located its backing on the next sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在立面图上高亮了「砌体饰面」，在下一张图上找到了它的背衬。

collocations: the backing behind a masonry veneer

words.enDefinition: A calculation basis expressing amounts or fractions in terms of mass.

examples.en: The mass basis keeps every ingredient amount in grams for the worksheet's simple mixing example.
examples.zh: 按「质量基准」，练习的简单混合示例将各食材用量统一用克表示。

examples.en: We compared the sugar fractions on a mass basis before reading the corresponding mole fractions.
examples.zh: 我们先按「质量基准」比较糖的分数，再读取相应的摩尔分数。

words.enDefinition: The mass of a component divided by the volume of the mixture.

examples.en: The mass concentration gives sugar mass per unit of solution volume in our classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表里的「质量浓度」表示每单位溶液体积所含的糖质量。

examples.en: We checked the units of mass concentration before using the number in the water balance.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「质量浓度」的单位，再把该数值用于水溶液衡算。

words.enDefinition: the mass of fluid crossing a surface per unit time

examples.en: We found the mass flow rate by dividing the collected water's mass by the collection time.
examples.zh: 我们用收集到的水的质量除以收集时间，求得「质量流量」。

examples.en: The steady model used equal mass flow rate at both ends of the unbranched pipe.
examples.zh: 稳态模型中，这段无分支管道两端的「质量流量」相同。

words.enDefinition: The mass crossing unit area per unit time, for a specified component or the entire mixture.

examples.en: The mass flux gives the water amount crossing the marked surface per unit area and time.
examples.zh: 「质量通量」表示单位时间内穿过标记表面单位面积的水的质量。

examples.en: We distinguished mass flux from the total mass flow rate across the whole area in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「质量通量」与穿过整个面积的总质量流率。

words.enDefinition: The mass of a component divided by the total mass of the mixture.

examples.en: We found the mass fraction of sugar by dividing the sugar mass by the total mass.
examples.zh: 我们用糖的质量除以总质量，求得糖的「质量分数」。

examples.en: The mass fraction stays the same when the entire classroom mixture is scaled by one factor.
examples.zh: 整个课堂混合物按同一倍数缩放时，「质量分数」保持不变。

words.enDefinition: Measure of rotational inertia calculated by weighting mass by squared axis distance

examples.en: The mass moment of inertia increases when more of the same mass lies farther from the axis.
examples.zh: 当相同总质量中有更多质量位于远离轴线的位置时，「转动惯量」增大。

examples.en: We specified the axis before finding the plate's mass moment of inertia in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在习题中求平板的「转动惯量」之前，我们先指定了轴线。

collocations: calculate the mass moment of inertia
mass moment of inertia about an axis

words.enDefinition: A component's mass fraction expressed as a percentage.

examples.en: The mass percent of sugar is printed beside the ingredient label in our fictional exercise.
examples.zh: 虚构练习中的食材标签旁印着糖的「质量百分数」。

examples.en: We converted the given mass fraction into mass percent before filling in the worksheet table.
examples.zh: 我们将给定的质量分数换算成「质量百分数」，再填入练习表格。

words.enDefinition: Distance where concentrating total mass would give the same rotational inertia

examples.en: We found the mass radius of gyration from the body's mass and its moment of inertia.
examples.zh: 我们用物体的质量及其转动惯量求出了「质量回转半径」。

examples.en: The mass radius of gyration changes when we choose a different axis for the same plate.
examples.zh: 对同一块平板选择不同轴线时，「质量回转半径」会变化。

collocations: calculate the mass radius of gyration
mass radius of gyration about an axis
interpret the mass radius of gyration

words.enDefinition: Mechanical model combining inertia, spring restoring force, and a damping element

examples.en: The mass-spring-damper system includes a damper that makes its free motion gradually die away.
examples.zh: 「质量弹簧阻尼系统」有一个阻尼器，使自由运动逐渐消退。

examples.en: We identified the separate force terms in the mass-spring-damper system shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们识别出习题中「质量弹簧阻尼系统」里的各项力。

words.zhGloss: 质量到物质的量的换算
words.enDefinition: Expressing a mass as an amount of substance by dividing by the relevant molar mass.
acceptedZhAnswers: 质量到物质的量的换算

examples.en: The mass-to-mole conversion changes the units used for the same quantity of sugar in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「质量到物质的量的换算」改变了表达同一份糖所用的计量单位。

examples.en: We applied mass-to-mole conversion before comparing water and dissolved sugar in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先做「质量到物质的量的换算」，再比较课堂练习中的水和溶解糖。

words.enDefinition: The movement of a component between regions or phases by diffusion, fluid motion, or both.

examples.en: Mass transfer moves dissolved sugar between neighbouring regions of water in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图中，溶解糖借「传质」在相邻水区间移动。

examples.en: We discussed mass transfer separately from the simultaneous movement of thermal energy in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「传质」与同时发生的热量传递分别讨论。

words.enDefinition: A coefficient relating mass transfer flux to a stated concentration difference under the chosen model.

examples.en: The mass transfer coefficient links the modelled sugar flux to the concentration difference in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习里的「传质系数」把模拟的糖通量与浓度差联系起来。

examples.en: We read the given mass transfer coefficient before identifying its driving force in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先读出给定「传质系数」，再指出课堂示意图中的相应推动力。

collocations: units of a mass transfer coefficient

words.enDefinition: The difference that drives mass transfer in a model, often expressed through a concentration difference.

examples.en: The mass transfer driving force is represented by the difference between two marked sugar concentrations.
examples.zh: 这里用两个标记的糖浓度之差来表示「传质推动力」。

examples.en: We checked the sign of the mass transfer driving force on the classroom water diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂水相示意图上核对「传质推动力」的正负号。

collocations: identify a mass transfer driving force
sign of the mass transfer driving force

words.enDefinition: An accounting equation relating material inflow and outflow, accumulation, and any internal generation or consumption of the specified material.

examples.en: The material balance accounts for each water stream crossing the boundary on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 「物料衡算」计入课堂练习纸上穿过边界的每股水流。

examples.en: We wrote the material balance before substituting the amounts listed beside the arrows in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先写出「物料衡算」，再代入各箭头旁列出的物料量。

words.enDefinition: Loss of a material's ability to serve its intended function because of damage or deformation.

examples.en: The classroom example showed material failure when a paper tab tore and could no longer hold its shape.
examples.zh: 纸板凸舌撕裂、无法保持形状时，课堂例题将其记为「材料失效」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the visible bend counted as material failure for this particular model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，就这个模型而言，可见的弯折是否算作「材料失效」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of material present within a process unit or selected region at a given time.

examples.en: The material holdup equals the amount of liquid currently inside the drawn bowl in class.
examples.zh: 课堂中，「物料持有量」等于图示容器当前所装的液体量。

examples.en: We read the material holdup from the state shown halfway through the simulated mixing exercise.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟混合练习进行一半时的状态读取「物料持有量」。

words.enDefinition: A rule that maximizes power delivered to a resistive load when its resistance equals the positive equivalent resistance of a DC source network.

examples.en: The maximum power transfer theorem predicts the highest load power at equal resistances in our DC model.
examples.zh: 在直流模型中，「最大功率传输定理」预测两处电阻相等时负载功率最高。

examples.en: We used the maximum power transfer theorem to interpret the peak of the simulated power curve.
examples.zh: 我们用「最大功率传输定理」解读模拟功率曲线的峰值。

collocations: apply the maximum power transfer theorem
verify the maximum power transfer theorem
resistive case of the maximum power transfer theorem

words.enDefinition: a graph for estimating stage counts in binary distillation using equilibrium and operating lines under the constant molar overflow assumption

examples.en: We counted the staircase steps on the McCabe-Thiele diagram to estimate the required equilibrium stages.
examples.zh: 我们数出「麦凯布–蒂勒图」上的阶梯步数，估算所需平衡级数。

examples.en: The McCabe-Thiele diagram plots liquid mole fraction horizontally and vapor mole fraction vertically in the binary example.
examples.zh: 在二元示例中，「麦凯布–蒂勒图」以液相摩尔分数为横坐标，以气相摩尔分数为纵坐标。

collocations: count stages on a McCabe-Thiele diagram

words.enDefinition: The particular quantity intended to be measured.

examples.en: The measurand was the slot's width at the center of the classroom sample's marked face.
examples.zh: 「被测量」是课堂样品标记面中央处的槽宽。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to define the measurand before choosing which readings belonged in the table.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们先说清楚「被测量」，再决定哪些读数写入表中。

words.enDefinition: How closely a measured value agrees with the true value of the quantity being measured.

examples.en: The tutor discussed measurement accuracy after comparing the readings with the documented reference length in class.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在课上将读数与记录的参考长度作比较后，讨论了「测量准确度」。

examples.en: We considered measurement accuracy when one ruler consistently gave values farther from the model's reference length.
examples.zh: 一把尺的读数始终偏离模型参考长度更远，我们因此考虑了「测量准确度」。

words.enDefinition: An estimate of the systematic part of the difference between measured values and a reference.

examples.en: The readings clustered above the reference value, suggesting positive measurement bias in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 课堂数据中的读数集中在参考量值之上，提示存在正的「测量偏倚」。

examples.en: We estimated measurement bias from the average difference between repeated readings and their shared reference value.
examples.zh: 我们根据重复读数与共同参考量值的平均差估算「测量偏倚」。

words.enDefinition: The measured value minus a reference value for the quantity being measured.

examples.en: The measurement error was negative because the displayed reading fell below the reference value in the table.
examples.zh: 显示读数低于表中的参考量值，因此「测量误差」为负。

examples.en: We kept units beside the measurement error so readers could interpret each value in context.
examples.zh: 我们在「测量误差」旁保留单位，方便读者结合上下文理解各个值。

collocations: identify a source of measurement error

words.enDefinition: A restriction on what a measurement can represent, distinguish, or establish.

examples.en: The measurement limitation arose because the camera could only show the front of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 相机只能拍到课堂模型的正面，带来了「测量局限」。

examples.en: We explained a measurement limitation after noticing that two close lengths produced the same displayed value.
examples.zh: 发现两个相近的长度显示为同一数值后，我们说明了这项「测量局限」。

collocations: a measurement limitation in the report

words.enDefinition: A change in the quantity being measured caused by the measuring instrument interacting with the circuit.

examples.en: Measurement loading lowers the voltage seen in the simulated divider because the meter draws some current.
examples.zh: 在模拟分压电路中，仪表分走一部分电流，因「测量负载效应」而使读到的电压降低。

examples.en: We used the ideal and nonideal meter models to illustrate measurement loading in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用理想与非理想仪表模型说明练习中的「测量负载效应」。

words.enDefinition: A chronological record of measurements, often including times, units, and sample identifiers.

examples.en: The measurement log let us match each classroom reading to the student and sample listed beside it.
examples.zh: 通过「测量日志」，我们能将课堂读数与旁边列出的学生和样品一一对应。

examples.en: We found the first reading in the measurement log before comparing results from the two sessions.
examples.zh: 比较两次实验课的结果之前，我们先在「测量日志」中找到了首个读数。

words.enDefinition: The agreement among repeated measurements made under specified conditions.

examples.en: The closely grouped readings showed good measurement precision under the repeated conditions used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂采用的重复测量条件下，读数聚得很紧，表明「测量精密度」较高。

examples.en: We compared measurement precision by plotting the spread of readings from both groups of students.
examples.zh: 我们画出两组学生读数的分散程度，以比较「测量精密度」。

words.enDefinition: The span of quantity values an instrument can measure under stated conditions.

examples.en: We checked the measurement range before choosing an instrument for the longest sample on the tray.
examples.zh: 给托盘上最长的样品选择仪器之前，我们先核对「测量范围」。

examples.en: The report marked readings outside the measurement range so students could interpret the table correctly.
examples.zh: 报告标出了超出「测量范围」的读数，方便学生正确解读表格。

collocations: the upper limit of the measurement range

words.enDefinition: Measurement precision under the same procedure, equipment, observer, and similar short-term conditions.

examples.en: We assessed measurement repeatability from readings taken by the same student with the same classroom instrument.
examples.zh: 我们根据同一学生用同一课堂仪器取得的读数，评估「测量重复性」。

examples.en: The tutor kept the procedure and setup fixed while the group discussed measurement repeatability in class.
examples.zh: 小组在课上讨论「测量重复性」时，辅导老师保持方法和装置不变。

words.enDefinition: Measurement precision under stated changes in conditions, such as location, observer, or equipment.

examples.en: The class discussed measurement reproducibility after examining readings from students using different instruments and rooms.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看学生在不同房间用不同仪器取得的读数后，讨论了「测量复现性」。

examples.en: We described the changed conditions before comparing measurement reproducibility across the two classroom groups.
examples.zh: 比较两个课堂小组的「测量复现性」之前，我们先说明哪些条件发生了改变。

words.enDefinition: The change in an instrument's indication divided by the corresponding change in the measured quantity.

examples.en: We compared measurement sensitivity by examining the slopes of the two curves in the response plot.
examples.zh: 我们查看响应图中两条曲线的斜率，以比较「测量灵敏度」。

examples.en: The tutor explained measurement sensitivity using examples where equal input changes produced different changes in indication.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用等量输入变化产生不同示值变化的例子说明「测量灵敏度」。

collocations: measurement sensitivity from a response curve

words.enDefinition: A material measure, instrument, or system realizing a reference quantity value with known uncertainty.

examples.en: The tutor used a measurement standard with a documented length to check the classroom instrument.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用长度有记录的「计量标准」检查课堂仪器。

examples.en: We traced the value of the measurement standard to the reference named on the sample certificate.
examples.zh: 我们把「计量标准」的量值追溯到证书样例所注明的参考来源。

collocations: compare an instrument with a measurement standard

words.enDefinition: How closely the average of many repeated measurements agrees with a reference value.

examples.en: We discussed measurement trueness by comparing the average of repeated readings with the stated reference length.
examples.zh: 我们将重复读数的平均值与所给参考长度比较，讨论了「测量正确度」。

examples.en: The example showed lower measurement trueness when the readings clustered around a value above the reference.
examples.zh: 例题中的读数集中在高于参考量值的位置，说明「测量正确度」较低。

words.enDefinition: Shaped open-channel section that relates water level to the flow rate

examples.en: The measuring flume in our example has a narrowed section on the drawing.
examples.zh: 示例中的「量水槽」在图上有一段较窄的渠段。

examples.en: The lesson uses a measuring flume to link water level with discharge.
examples.zh: 课堂用「量水槽」将水位与流量联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the condition where a resting fluid has force balance, including pressure forces and body forces

examples.en: The pressure gradient balanced gravity in the example showing mechanical equilibrium of a fluid.
examples.zh: 在展示「流体的力学平衡」的示例中，压力梯度产生的力与重力相平衡。

examples.en: We used mechanical equilibrium of a fluid to explain the pressure variation in stationary water.
examples.zh: 我们用「流体的力学平衡」解释静水中的压力变化。

collocations: assume mechanical equilibrium of a fluid
analyze mechanical equilibrium of a fluid
describe mechanical equilibrium of a fluid

words.enDefinition: separation that relies on physical forces or size differences to divide materials, without requiring a phase change

examples.en: The screen illustrates mechanical separation because the dry grains pass or remain according to their size.
examples.zh: 筛网按干颗粒大小决定其通过还是留下，展示了「机械分离」。

examples.en: We used a settling diagram to explain a second example of mechanical separation for particles in water.
examples.zh: 我们用沉降图说明水中颗粒进行「机械分离」的第二个例子。

words.enDefinition: A connection transferring force between reinforcing bars through a mechanical joining device.

examples.en: The mechanical splice appeared as a short sleeve connecting two bars in the cutaway photograph.
examples.zh: 剖面照片中，「机械连接接头」表现为连接两根钢筋的短套筒。

examples.en: We searched the drawing legend for the symbol used to identify a mechanical splice in the model.
examples.zh: 我们查阅图例，找出模型中表示「机械连接接头」的符号。

collocations: a detail showing a mechanical splice

words.enDefinition: Oscillating motion of a physical system about a reference position

examples.en: The sensor records mechanical vibration as the tabletop model moves above and below its rest position.
examples.zh: 桌面模型在静止位置上下往复运动时，传感器记录其「机械振动」。

examples.en: We compared mechanical vibration in two models that used different springs and equal masses.
examples.zh: 我们比较了采用不同弹簧、质量相同的两个模型中的「机械振动」。

words.enDefinition: The study of stresses, strains, and deformation in loaded bodies.

examples.en: Our mechanics of materials course began by measuring how a small sample stretched under a pull.
examples.zh: 「材料力学」课程一开始就测量一个小试样在拉力作用下如何伸长。

examples.en: The mechanics of materials exercise asked why two bars elongated differently under the same axial load.
examples.zh: 这道「材料力学」练习要求解释，为什么相同轴向载荷下两根杆伸长量不同。

words.enDefinition: the amount, mass or volume of a specified substance passing through unit membrane area per unit time

examples.en: We calculated membrane flux by dividing the collected water volume by membrane area and collection time.
examples.zh: 我们将收集到的水体积除以膜面积和收集时间，算出「膜通量」。

examples.en: The worksheet reports a smaller membrane flux when less water crosses the same area each minute.
examples.zh: 练习中，每分钟穿过同一面积的水减少时，报告的「膜通量」也较小。

words.enDefinition: accumulation of material on a membrane surface or within its pores that reduces its performance

examples.en: The model attributed the decrease in water flow to membrane fouling by suspended food solids.
examples.zh: 模型把水流量下降归因于悬浮的食品固体造成的「膜污染」。

examples.en: We compared the clean membrane image with a second picture showing visible membrane fouling.
examples.zh: 我们将洁净的膜图像与另一张显示出可见「膜污染」的图片进行比较。

words.enDefinition: a measure of solute exclusion, commonly one minus the ratio of permeate concentration to feed concentration

examples.en: Membrane rejection was high because the permeate salt concentration was much lower than the feed concentration.
examples.zh: 渗透液的盐浓度远低于进料，因此「膜截留率」较高。

examples.en: We compared membrane rejection for two solutes using their feed and permeate concentrations from the table.
examples.zh: 我们用表中两种溶质在进料和渗透液中的浓度，对照各自的「膜截留率」。

words.enDefinition: separation in which a selective barrier allows some substances to pass more readily than others

examples.en: The membrane separation model shows water crossing a barrier while most dissolved salt stays behind.
examples.zh: 「膜分离」模型显示，水穿过一道屏障，大部分溶解盐留在后面。

examples.en: We distinguished membrane separation from settling by identifying the barrier in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 通过找出课堂图中的屏障，我们区分了「膜分离」和沉降。

words.enDefinition: A method for planar circuits that uses loop voltage equations to solve for mesh currents.

examples.en: Mesh analysis gives two equations for the connected loops in our idealized resistor network on paper.
examples.zh: 在纸上的理想化电阻网络中，「网孔电流法」为两个相连的回路给出两个方程。

examples.en: We chose mesh analysis because the circuit drawing contains only two simple meshes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图只有两个简单网孔，所以我们选择了「网孔电流法」。

words.enDefinition: An assumed loop current used to express branch currents in mesh analysis.

examples.en: The mesh current in the left loop is shown by a clockwise arrow on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图用顺时针箭头表示左侧回路的「网孔电流」。

examples.en: We subtracted one mesh current from the other because their arrows oppose each other on the branch.
examples.zh: 两条「网孔电流」的箭头在该支路上方向相反，所以我们用一个减另一个。

words.enDefinition: A socket on a meter that accepts a test lead for a specified measurement function.

examples.en: The meter input jack has a printed label that identifies its measurement function on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「仪表输入插孔」旁印有标签，指明其测量功能。

examples.en: We matched each meter input jack to the label shown in the illustrated instrument manual.
examples.zh: 我们按图示仪器手册，把每个「仪表输入插孔」与所示标签对应起来。

words.enDefinition: Analysis solving member forces from force equilibrium at individual truss joints

examples.en: We used the method of joints to find forces in the bars meeting at one corner.
examples.zh: 我们用「节点法」求出汇接于一个角点的各根杆件的力。

examples.en: The method of joints proceeds from one joint to another once enough forces are known.
examples.zh: 当已知力足够时，「节点法」可以从一个节点推进到下一个节点。

collocations: solve a truss by the method of joints

words.enDefinition: Analysis using force and moment equilibrium on one side of an imaginary cut

examples.en: We used the method of sections to find forces in a few selected truss members.
examples.zh: 我们用「截面法」求出几根指定桁架杆件的内力。

examples.en: For the method of sections, our sketch isolates one side of the imaginary cut.
examples.zh: 使用「截面法」时，我们的草图单独画出假想截面的一侧。

collocations: solve a truss by the method of sections
choose a cut for the method of sections

words.enDefinition: A measurement result's documented link to a reference through an unbroken calibration chain with associated uncertainties.

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated metrological traceability by linking the classroom result to successive references and calibration records.
examples.zh: 习题将课堂测量结果与逐级参考量值及校准记录关联起来，说明「计量溯源性」。

examples.en: We discussed metrological traceability after noticing that the sample certificate named a reference and an uncertainty.
examples.zh: 我们注意到证书样例注明了参考来源及不确定度，随后讨论了「计量溯源性」。

words.enDefinition: A measuring tool whose precision screw moves one face to measure a small dimension.

examples.en: The classroom diagram of the micrometer screw gauge labeled the spindle next to the sample.
examples.zh: 课堂「螺旋测微器」示意图在样品旁标出了测微螺杆。

examples.en: We identified the micrometer screw gauge in the photo by its frame and round thimble.
examples.zh: 我们根据尺架和圆形微分筒，从照片中认出了「螺旋测微器」。

collocations: measure thickness with a micrometer screw gauge

words.enDefinition: the fewest equilibrium stages needed for the specified distillation separation, reached in the total reflux limit

examples.en: The exercise found the minimum number of stages by counting equilibrium steps under the total reflux assumption.
examples.zh: 练习在全回流假设下数出平衡阶梯步数，求得「最少理论级数」。

examples.en: We compared the minimum number of stages for two target pairs using the same equilibrium curve.
examples.zh: 我们用同一条平衡曲线，对照两组产品目标对应的「最少理论级数」。

collocations: calculate the minimum number of stages
estimate the minimum number of stages
minimum number of stages at total reflux

words.enDefinition: the limiting reflux ratio for a specified separation at which an ideal model requires indefinitely many equilibrium stages

examples.en: At the minimum reflux ratio, the model's stage steps crowd toward a point without crossing it.
examples.zh: 在「最小回流比」下，模型里的逐级阶梯靠近一点，却无法越过该点。

examples.en: We marked the minimum reflux ratio on the chart as a limiting value for the specified products.
examples.zh: 我们在图中标出「最小回流比」，作为得到指定产品的一个极限值。

collocations: limit at the minimum reflux ratio

words.enDefinition: the mobile charge carrier type with the lower concentration in a semiconductor region

examples.en: The hole is the minority carrier on the donor-doped side of the junction in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的结模型中，空穴是施主掺杂一侧的「少数载流子」。

examples.en: The simulated minority carrier concentration increased locally when light struck the sample during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，光照到样品时，模拟的「少数载流子」浓度在局部上升。

words.enDefinition: A balance relating the amounts and compositions entering a mixing point to those of the combined stream.

examples.en: The mixing balance combines the water and sugar contributions from both arrows on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「混合衡算」将练习图中两支箭头上水和糖的贡献相加。

examples.en: We solved the mixing balance to find the composition labelled beside the outgoing arrow.
examples.zh: 我们求解「混合衡算」，找出出箭头旁所标的组成。

words.enDefinition: A location in a process diagram where two or more streams join into a single stream.

examples.en: The mixing point joins the plain water stream and the sugar solution in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，清水流和糖溶液在「汇合点」汇合。

examples.en: We assigned one label to the stream leaving the mixing point in our classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们给课堂图中离开「汇合点」的物流加了一个标签。

words.enDefinition: the liquid or gas that moves through a chromatographic system and carries sample components with it

examples.en: The solvent moves up the paper as the mobile phase in the demonstration with washable ink.
examples.zh: 在可洗墨水的演示中，溶剂作为「流动相」沿纸向上移动。

examples.en: We followed the boundary of the mobile phase to compare its travel with that of each pigment.
examples.zh: 我们追踪「流动相」前沿，用其移动的距离对照各色素的移动距离。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of trips made by one travel mode within the specified group

examples.en: We calculated the mode share for walking in the class's fictional travel survey.
examples.zh: 我们计算了课堂虚构出行调查中步行的「出行方式分担率」。

examples.en: The chart shows mode share separately for bus, cycling, and trips by car.
examples.zh: 图表分别显示公交、骑行和乘车出行的「出行方式分担率」。

words.enDefinition: The mass of water in wood expressed relative to the wood's dry mass.

examples.en: We read the moisture content of wood as a percentage in the classroom material comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂材料比较表中读取以百分比表示的「木材含水率」。

examples.en: The report recorded the moisture content of wood before comparing changes in the dimensions of both samples.
examples.zh: 报告在比较两个试样的尺寸变化之前，记录了各自的「木材含水率」。

collocations: measure the moisture content of wood
report the moisture content of wood
compare the moisture content of wood samples

words.enDefinition: The amount in moles of a component divided by the volume of the mixture.

examples.en: The molar concentration reports the amount of dissolved sugar per unit volume in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「摩尔浓度」表示每单位体积所含溶解糖的摩尔数。

examples.en: We converted sugar mass to moles before calculating molar concentration from the given solution volume.
examples.zh: 我们先把糖的质量换算为摩尔数，再根据给定溶液体积求「摩尔浓度」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of substance carried by a stream per unit time, expressed in moles per time.

examples.en: The molar flow rate is shown below the stream arrow in the example table of units.
examples.zh: 示例单位表把「摩尔流率」列在物流箭头下方。

examples.en: We converted a given mass flow into a molar flow rate for the water stream.
examples.zh: 我们把给定质量流率换算为这股水流的「摩尔流率」。

collocations: molar flow rate of a component

words.enDefinition: The amount in moles of a specified substance crossing unit area per unit time.

examples.en: The molar flux reports the dissolved sugar crossing the marked area per unit time in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「摩尔通量」用摩尔数表示溶解糖每单位时间通过单位面积的量。

examples.en: We checked the molar flux units before comparing quantities across the two classroom columns.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「摩尔通量」的单位，再比较课堂表两列的量。

words.enDefinition: A calculation basis expressing amounts or fractions in moles.

examples.en: The mole basis reports the amounts of water and dissolved sugar in moles in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习按「摩尔基准」，用摩尔表示水和溶解糖的量。

examples.en: We converted the stated masses to a mole basis before comparing the two component fractions.
examples.zh: 我们先把给定质量换算到「摩尔基准」，再比较两个组分的分数。

words.enDefinition: The number of moles of one component divided by the total number of moles in the mixture.

examples.en: The mole fraction uses amount in moles for both the component and the complete mixture.
examples.zh: 「摩尔分数」的分子和分母分别用组分与整个混合物的摩尔数。

examples.en: We checked that the mole fraction of each component contributes to a total of one.
examples.zh: 我们核对各组分的「摩尔分数」之和是否为一。

words.enDefinition: A component's mole fraction expressed as a percentage.

examples.en: The mole percent in the table comes from the mole fraction of the same component.
examples.zh: 表中的「摩尔百分数」由同一组分的摩尔分数得出。

examples.en: We converted mole percent to a fraction before writing the component amount in the balance.
examples.zh: 我们将「摩尔百分数」换算为分数，再在衡算中写出组分量。

words.enDefinition: Transport arising from random molecular motion, producing net movement when concentration is nonuniform.

examples.en: Molecular diffusion gradually evens out the sugar concentration in the still water model shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂静水模型里，「分子扩散」使糖浓度逐渐变得均匀。

examples.en: We drew the changing concentration profile to illustrate molecular diffusion in the fictional water layer.
examples.zh: 我们绘出变化的浓度分布，用于说明虚构水层中的「分子扩散」。

words.enDefinition: The moment measured with respect to a chosen point.

examples.en: We found the moment about a point where the hinge met the tabletop model in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们求了「对点的力矩」，取的是图中铰链与桌面模型的连接点。

examples.en: The instructor used a different reference location to show why a moment about a point can change.
examples.zh: 老师换了一个参考点，说明「对点的力矩」为何会发生变化。

collocations: calculate a moment about a point
find the direction of a moment about a point

words.enDefinition: The signed component of a force moment along a specified axis.

examples.en: The worksheet asked for the moment about an axis drawn through the center of the circular model.
examples.zh: 习题要求计算「对轴的力矩」，这根轴穿过圆形模型的中心。

examples.en: We found the moment about an axis by projecting the moment vector onto that axis.
examples.zh: 我们将力矩向量投影到指定轴上，求出「对该轴的力矩」。

collocations: calculate a moment about an axis
resolve a moment about an axis
find a moment about an axis

words.enDefinition: The perpendicular distance from a chosen point to a force's line of action.

examples.en: I marked the moment arm at a right angle to the rope's line in our sketch.
examples.zh: 我在草图中垂直于绳子的作用线画出「力臂」。

examples.en: The same pull produced a larger moment when we gave it a longer moment arm.
examples.zh: 使用更长的「力臂」后，同样大小的拉力产生了更大的力矩。

words.enDefinition: The condition in which moments sum to zero about a common reference point or axis.

examples.en: We wrote a moment balance about the hinge to find the unknown force farther along the model.
examples.zh: 我们以铰链为参考点列出「力矩平衡」方程，求出模型远端的未知力。

examples.en: Our tutor checked moment balance after we corrected the sign of the curved arrow on the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们修正草图中弧形箭头的符号后，辅导老师核对了「力矩平衡」。

words.enDefinition: The turning effect of a force about a specified point or axis.

examples.en: We found the moment of a force by multiplying its magnitude by the perpendicular distance.
examples.zh: 我们将力的大小乘以垂直距离，求出「力矩」。

examples.en: The moment of a force changed when we moved the reference point farther from its line of action.
examples.zh: 将参考点移到离该力作用线更远的位置后，「力矩」发生了变化。

collocations: calculate the moment of a force
the moment of a force about a point
find the direction of the moment of a force

words.enDefinition: The mortar-filled space between adjacent masonry units.

examples.en: The photo showed a pale mortar joint separating the darker bricks in the sample panel.
examples.zh: 照片里的样板中，一道较浅的「灰缝」隔开了颜色较深的砖。

examples.en: We traced each mortar joint in the drawing to see how the arrangement repeated across the wall.
examples.zh: 我们逐一描出图中的「灰缝」，看这种排列如何在整面墙上重复。

collocations: the profile of a mortar joint

words.zhGloss: 金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管
words.enDefinition: a type of field-effect transistor with an oxide or other insulating layer separating its gate from the channel
acceptedZhAnswers: 金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管

examples.en: The model uses a MOSFET to show how an insulated gate controls the current through a channel.
examples.zh: 模型用「金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管」展示绝缘栅极怎样控制通过沟道的电流。

examples.en: The gate terminal of the ideal MOSFET drew no steady current in the circuit simulation.
examples.zh: 在电路模拟中，理想的「金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管」栅极端不吸收稳态电流。

words.enDefinition: the liquid left after crystallization, containing dissolved material that has not crystallized

examples.en: The mother liquor still contained dissolved sugar after the model separated the solid crystals.
examples.zh: 模型分离出固态晶体后，「母液」中仍含有溶解的糖。

examples.en: We listed the solute in the mother liquor separately from the recovered crystal mass in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们分别列出「母液」中的溶质和回收的晶体质量。

collocations: solute remaining in the mother liquor

words.enDefinition: evaporation in connected vessels, where vapor from one effect supplies heat to a following lower-pressure effect

examples.en: The diagram for multiple-effect evaporation shows one vessel's vapor feeding the next vessel's heating surface.
examples.zh: 「多效蒸发」图显示，前一容器的蒸气供给后一容器的加热面。

examples.en: We compared multiple-effect evaporation with a single vessel representation to explain how heat can be reused.
examples.zh: 我们将「多效蒸发」与单一容器的示意进行比较，解释热量如何再次利用。

words.enDefinition: a semiconductor in which electrons are the majority mobile charge carriers

examples.en: Electrons carry most of the current through the n-type semiconductor in this simplified conductivity calculation.
examples.zh: 在这一简化的电导率计算中，电子承担了「n 型半导体」中的大部分电流。

examples.en: We labeled the donor-doped side an n-type semiconductor because it had more electrons than holes.
examples.zh: 我们把施主掺杂的一侧标成「n 型半导体」，因为这一侧的电子多于空穴。

words.enDefinition: Fluid motion produced by buoyancy from density differences, contributing to transfer of heat or mass.

examples.en: Natural convection appears in the diagram as gently rising air next to the warm container.
examples.zh: 图里暖容器旁缓慢上升的空气表示「自然对流」。

examples.en: We explained natural convection by comparing the densities of cooler and warmer fluid in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上比较较冷与较暖流体的密度，解释「自然对流」。

words.enDefinition: A naturally sourced siliceous or aluminous material that reacts with calcium hydroxide and water to form binding compounds.

examples.en: The label identified the volcanic powder as a natural pozzolan in the binder comparison display.
examples.zh: 胶结料比较展板的标签注明，这种火山粉料属于「天然火山灰质材料」。

examples.en: We compared a natural pozzolan from volcanic rock with an industrial byproduct in the materials lecture.
examples.zh: 材料课上，我们将取自火山岩的「天然火山灰质材料」与一种工业副产物作了比较。

collocations: a blend with a natural pozzolan

words.enDefinition: The response resulting from initially stored energy when the independent external inputs are zero.

examples.en: The natural response of a circuit in this worksheet comes from the capacitor's initially stored energy.
examples.zh: 练习中，「电路的自然响应」来自电容器初始储存的能量。

examples.en: We graphed the natural response of a circuit after setting its independent source to zero on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上将独立电源置零后，绘出「电路的自然响应」。

collocations: find the natural response of a circuit
natural response of a circuit with a capacitor
analyse the natural response of a circuit

words.enDefinition: a feedback connection in which the returned signal acts to oppose a deviation from a reference or operating condition

examples.en: The negative feedback loop raised the modeled heater output when the measured temperature fell below its setpoint.
examples.zh: 实测温度低于设定值时，「负反馈回路」提高了模型中的加热功率。

examples.en: We identified the negative feedback loop by following the measured output back to the subtracting input.
examples.zh: 我们顺着实测输出追踪到相减端，找出了「负反馈回路」。

collocations: stability of a negative feedback loop

words.enDefinition: work delivered minus work received by a system over a full thermodynamic cycle, under the stated sign convention

examples.en: We calculated net cycle work by subtracting the pump's input from the modeled turbine's output.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟涡轮的输出功减去泵的输入功，求得「循环净功」。

examples.en: The loop area on the reversible pressure-volume plot gave the magnitude of net cycle work.
examples.zh: 可逆过程压力体积图中闭合线围出的面积给出「循环净功」的大小。

collocations: estimate net cycle work from a diagram
compare net cycle work across cycles

words.enDefinition: The heat added to a system minus the heat leaving it over the same interval.

examples.en: Net heat input is positive when more heat enters than leaves the modelled container.
examples.zh: 进入模型容器的热量大于离开的热量时，「净输入热量」为正。

examples.en: We calculated net heat input by comparing the two heat arrows in the classroom balance.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂衡算图中的两支热量箭头，计算「净输入热量」。

collocations: net heat input over an interval

words.enDefinition: The difference between radiation energy transfers in opposite directions for the specified system or surfaces.

examples.en: The net radiative exchange is zero in the ideal two-surface enclosure when both temperatures are equal.
examples.zh: 在仅有两个表面的理想封闭空间内，两表面同温时，「净辐射换热」为零。

examples.en: We considered both emission and absorption when interpreting the net radiative exchange on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 解读练习中的「净辐射换热」时，我们同时考虑发射和吸收。

words.enDefinition: The line in a bent beam cross-section along which longitudinal bending strain is zero.

examples.en: We drew the neutral axis through the center of the rectangular section in the pure bending example.
examples.zh: 在纯弯曲例题中，我们让「中性轴」穿过矩形截面的中心。

examples.en: The tutor marked the neutral axis where the longitudinal strain changed from tension to compression.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在纵向应变由拉应变变为压应变的位置标出了「中性轴」。

collocations: the distance from the neutral axis

words.enDefinition: The surface along a bent beam on which longitudinal bending strain is zero.
