examples.en: The total reactance vanishes when the capacitive and inductive contributions cancel in the idealized series circuit.
examples.zh: 理想化串联电路中，容性和感性贡献相互抵消时，总「电抗」为零。

examples.en: We labelled the reactance separately from the resistance in the complex impedance calculation on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上用复数计算阻抗时，分别标出「电抗」与电阻。

words.enDefinition: A force a support or other constraint exerts on a body.

examples.en: A positive answer showed that the reaction force pointed in the direction we had drawn.
examples.zh: 结果为正，说明「约束反力」指向我们画出的方向。

examples.en: The tutor added the reaction force from the wall where the small block touched it.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在小滑块与墙面的接触处补画了墙施加的「约束反力」。

collocations: the direction of a reaction force

words.enDefinition: A moment exerted by a support that restrains rotation.

examples.en: We drew the reaction moment at the clamp as a curved arrow in the free-body diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在受力图中用弧形箭头表示夹具处的「支座反力矩」。

examples.en: The instructor asked whether the ideal hinge in the problem could exert a reaction moment.
examples.zh: 老师问，题中的理想铰链能否施加「支座反力矩」。

collocations: a reaction moment at a clamp

words.enDefinition: The imaginary part of complex power, representing alternating energy exchange in sinusoidal circuit analysis.

examples.en: The reactive power indicates reversible energy exchange in the ideal inductive example shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所示理想电感示例中，「无功功率」表示可逆的能量交换。

examples.en: We compared the signs of reactive power for the ideal capacitor and inductor in the simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，我们比较理想电容器与电感器「无功功率」的正负号。

collocations: reactive power of an inductive element

words.enDefinition: Concrete produced for delivery to a project as a fresh mixture.

examples.en: The sample ticket identified the material as ready-mixed concrete delivered from a plant to the project.
examples.zh: 示例票据将这种材料标为由搅拌站运到项目现场的「预拌混凝土」。

examples.en: We found ready-mixed concrete on the delivery schedule alongside the area named in the classroom case study.
examples.zh: 我们在供货进度表上找到了「预拌混凝土」，旁边标出了课堂案例提到的区域。

words.enDefinition: A three-dimensional assembly of reinforcing bars arranged to be embedded in concrete.

examples.en: The rebar cage in the photo stood beside the small column form in the case study.
examples.zh: 案例照片中的「钢筋笼」立在小型柱模旁。

examples.en: We counted the vertical bars visible in the model rebar cage before locating them on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们数出模型「钢筋笼」中看得见的竖向钢筋，再在图纸上找出它们的位置。

collocations: a rebar cage for a column
label the parts of a rebar cage

words.enDefinition: A device placed between reinforcement and a form to maintain the intended concrete cover.

examples.en: The rebar spacer was shown between the rod and the form wall in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸把「钢筋垫块」画在钢筋与模板内壁之间。

examples.en: The materials tray contained a rebar spacer that the tutor identified from its position in the model.
examples.zh: 材料托盘里有一个「钢筋垫块」，辅导老师根据它在模型中的位置认出了它。

collocations: the position of a rebar spacer

words.enDefinition: a heat transfer unit that vaporizes some liquid from a column base and returns vapor to the column

examples.en: The reboiler vapor arrow points back into the bottom of the modeled column on our handout.
examples.zh: 讲义中的「再沸器」蒸气箭头指向模型塔的底部，表示蒸气返回塔内。

examples.en: We marked the heat input next to the reboiler at the base of the distillation diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在蒸馏图底部的「再沸器」旁标出了热量输入。

words.enDefinition: the rate of heat supplied to a reboiler under specified conditions

examples.en: The simulator reports reboiler duty as a power because it measures supplied heat per unit time.
examples.zh: 模拟器把「再沸器热负荷」报告为功率，因为它衡量单位时间内输入的热量。

examples.en: We compared reboiler duty for the two idealized cases after checking that their time units matched.
examples.zh: 我们确认两种理想化情形的时间单位相同后，比较其「再沸器热负荷」。

words.enDefinition: conversion of an alternating signal into one with a single polarity or direction

examples.en: The two traces show rectification changing a symmetric input into a pulsating output of one polarity.
examples.zh: 两条曲线显示，「整流」将对称输入变成了单一极性的脉动输出。

examples.en: We described rectification and smoothing as separate stages when interpreting the simulated power supply waveforms.
examples.zh: 我们在解读模拟的电源波形时，将「整流」和平滑视为不同的阶段。

words.enDefinition: the part of a distillation column above the feed stage that enriches the rising vapor in more volatile components

examples.en: We shaded the rectifying section above the feed tray when labeling the ideal column in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们为理想塔标注时，把进料板以上的「精馏段」涂上阴影。

examples.en: The chart shows the more volatile component increasing in the rising vapor through the rectifying section.
examples.zh: 图表显示，气相上升通过「精馏段」时，其中较易挥发组分所占比例增加。

words.enDefinition: Motion with constant body orientation and parallel straight-line paths for all points

examples.en: We used rectilinear translation for the display panel that slides along a straight rail.
examples.zh: 我们用「直线平移」描述沿直轨滑动的展板。

examples.en: The body maintains its orientation throughout the rectilinear translation shown in the figure.
examples.zh: 在图示的整个「直线平移」中，物体的朝向保持不变。

words.enDefinition: The connected path carrying material downstream and then back to an earlier process point.

examples.en: The recycle loop is entirely inside the broad boundary drawn around our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型外围画的大边界完全包住「回流回路」。

examples.en: We traced the recycle loop through the boxes before identifying the flows that leave the system.
examples.zh: 我们先沿各方框追踪「回流回路」，再找出离开系统的各股物流。

words.enDefinition: A ratio expressing recycle flow relative to a stated reference flow, commonly fresh feed.

examples.en: The recycle ratio compares the returning water with the fresh feed in this worksheet convention.
examples.zh: 按练习纸的定义，「回流比」将回流的水与新鲜进料作比较。

examples.en: We read the denominator beside the recycle ratio because the example specifies its own reference stream.
examples.zh: 由于示例自行指定了参考物流，我们查看「回流比」旁标出的分母。

collocations: recycle ratio on a mass basis

words.enDefinition: A process stream directed back to an earlier stage of the same system.

examples.en: The recycle stream bends back toward the first box in the classroom water loop diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂水循环图中，「回流物流」折回第一个方框。

examples.en: We did not count the recycle stream as an external input to the whole process.
examples.zh: 对整个工艺衡算时，我们只把「回流物流」当作内部流动。

words.enDefinition: A balance equation that follows from others and adds no new constraint to the system.

examples.en: The redundant balance equation follows by adding the two component equations on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「冗余衡算方程」可以由两个组分方程相加得到。

examples.en: We kept the redundant balance equation as a check on copying the values correctly.
examples.zh: 我们保留「冗余衡算方程」，用来核查抄入的数值。

words.enDefinition: Support force selected as an extra unknown in a force-method analysis

examples.en: The force method treats the middle support force as a redundant reaction in this exercise.
examples.zh: 在这道题中，力法将中间支座的力视为一个「多余支座反力」。

examples.en: We computed the redundant reaction after imposing the original displacement restriction in the model.
examples.zh: 我们给模型恢复原先的位移约束条件后，算出了「多余支座反力」。

collocations: remove a redundant reaction in the model

words.enDefinition: An informational dimension, often derived from other dimensions, that sets no separate requirement.

examples.en: The reference dimension helped us understand the drawing even though it did not add a separate requirement.
examples.zh: 「参考尺寸」帮助我们理解图样，而且不会增加独立的要求。

examples.en: We found the reference dimension by adding the two shorter distances shown in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂草图里的两段较短距离相加，得到「参考尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: A circuit node chosen to have zero potential so other node voltages can be measured relative to it.

examples.en: The reference node is assigned zero volts in the circuit diagram on the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义的电路图把「参考节点」设为零伏。

examples.en: We chose one reference node and expressed all other node voltages relative to it.
examples.zh: 我们选定一个「参考节点」，其余节点电压都相对于它表示。

collocations: voltage relative to the reference node

words.enDefinition: A quantity value used as a basis for comparison with another value.

examples.en: We placed the reference value beside each measured value to make the comparison easier to read.
examples.zh: 我们把「参考量值」写在各个测量值旁边，让对照更容易读懂。

examples.en: The reference value in the example came from the label supplied with the classroom gauge block.
examples.zh: 例题中的「参考量值」来自课堂量块附带的标签。

collocations: compare a reading with a reference value

words.enDefinition: the flow rate of reflux liquid returned to the column divided by the flow rate of overhead distillate on the same basis

examples.en: We calculated the reflux ratio by dividing the return flow by the withdrawn liquid product flow.
examples.zh: 我们将回流流量除以取出的液体产品流量，算出「回流比」。

examples.en: Both flow rates used the same units before we compared the reflux ratio for two simulations.
examples.zh: 两个流量先统一单位，我们再比较两次模拟的「回流比」。

words.enDefinition: liquid condensed from column overhead vapor and returned to the upper part of the column

examples.en: The reflux stream is the branch that returns to the top after the overhead vapor condenses.
examples.zh: 塔顶蒸气冷凝后，返回塔顶的那股支流是「回流液流」。

examples.en: We colored the reflux stream separately from the liquid product to show where their paths diverge.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色区分「回流液流」与液体产品，标明两股流在何处分开。

collocations: split the condensate into a product and reflux stream

words.enDefinition: a sequence of processes that uses energy input to remove heat from a low-temperature space

examples.en: The refrigeration cycle takes heat from the chilled compartment and releases it to the surrounding room.
examples.zh: 「制冷循环」从冷藏室吸热，向周围房间放热。

examples.en: We traced the refrigeration cycle from the evaporator outlet back to its inlet on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿「制冷循环」从蒸发器出口一路追踪到其入口。

words.enDefinition: Concrete with embedded steel bars or wires that act with it to resist loads.

examples.en: The photograph showed the steel bars visible at the cut end of the reinforced concrete specimen.
examples.zh: 照片显示，「钢筋混凝土」试样切开的端部露出了钢筋。

examples.en: The tutor used a small reinforced concrete model to identify the two main materials in the member.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用小型「钢筋混凝土」模型指出构件中的两种主要材料。

words.enDefinition: The interaction that transfers force between embedded reinforcing steel and the surrounding concrete.

examples.en: The lecturer discussed reinforcement bond when explaining how force passed from the bar into the surrounding concrete.
examples.zh: 老师讲到力如何从钢筋传递到周围混凝土时，介绍了「钢筋与混凝土的黏结」。

examples.en: The second sketch showed how the surface ribs contributed to reinforcement bond in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 第二幅草图展示了例题中表面肋纹如何影响「钢筋与混凝土的黏结」。

collocations: the effect of ribs on reinforcement bond

words.enDefinition: Chemical or electrochemical degradation of steel reinforcement embedded in a construction material.

examples.en: The condition report listed reinforcement corrosion as one possible explanation for the rust stains in the photograph.
examples.zh: 状况报告将「钢筋锈蚀」列为照片中锈迹的一个可能原因。

examples.en: Our lecturer used the diagram to connect reinforcement corrosion with cracks running along the bars.
examples.zh: 老师用示意图说明「钢筋锈蚀」与沿钢筋延伸的裂缝之间的关系。

words.enDefinition: A mechanical device that joins the ends of two reinforcing bars.

examples.en: The tutor passed around a reinforcement coupler so we could recognize the part shown on the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师传看一个「钢筋连接套筒」，让我们认出图纸中的对应零件。

examples.en: The reinforcement coupler appeared as a thicker component where the two model bars met in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中两根模型钢筋相接处画了一个较粗的零件，就是「钢筋连接套筒」。

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing the positions and identification marks of reinforcement in a construction element.

examples.en: We found the upper steel layer on the reinforcement drawing before locating it in the section photograph.
examples.zh: 我们先在「钢筋布置图」上找出上层钢筋，再到剖面照片里找相应位置。

examples.en: The reinforcement drawing used reference numbers that matched the entries in the bar bending schedule for our exercise.
examples.zh: 「钢筋布置图」所用的编号与练习里的钢筋加工明细表条目相对应。

collocations: a bar mark on a reinforcement drawing
a section on a reinforcement drawing

words.enDefinition: A flat grid of reinforcing bars or wires placed within a concrete element.

examples.en: The section sketch showed a reinforcement mat near each face of the teaching slab model.
examples.zh: 教学板模型的剖面草图在两个表面附近各画出一层「钢筋网片」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the flat reinforcement mat before showing a model of a column cage.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先指出平面的「钢筋网片」，再展示一个柱钢筋笼模型。

collocations: the orientation of a reinforcement mat

words.enDefinition: A steel bar embedded in concrete or masonry to carry forces with the surrounding material.

examples.en: We spotted a reinforcing bar in the cut section where the outer concrete had been removed.
examples.zh: 外层混凝土已去除，我们在切开的截面中看见一根「钢筋」。

examples.en: The instructor matched the reinforcing bar in the display to a line on the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 老师把展台中的「钢筋」与课堂图纸上的一条线对应起来。

collocations: the diameter of a reinforcing bar

words.enDefinition: Equation linking point accelerations on a rigid body through its rotation

examples.en: The relative acceleration equation includes terms for angular acceleration and the square of angular speed.
examples.zh: 「相对加速度方程」包含与角加速度和角速率平方有关的项。

examples.en: We used the relative acceleration equation after finding the acceleration of the reference point.
examples.zh: 求出参考点的加速度后，我们使用了「相对加速度方程」。

words.enDefinition: A balance residual expressed relative to a stated reference amount, often as a percentage.

examples.en: The relative closure error uses the total incoming water as its reference in this exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「相对闭合误差」采用总流入水量作基准。

examples.en: We reported the denominator used for the relative closure error in the classroom balance table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂衡算表里注明「相对闭合误差」所用的分母。

words.enDefinition: Equation relating two rigid-body point velocities through the body's angular velocity

examples.en: We used the relative velocity equation to find the velocity at the second marked point.
examples.zh: 我们用「相对速度方程」求出第二个标记点的速度。

examples.en: The relative velocity equation combines the known point velocity with a term from rotation.
examples.zh: 「相对速度方程」将已知点的速度和旋转产生的一项结合起来。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of the vapor-liquid equilibrium ratios of two components at the same state

examples.en: The larger relative volatility gave a wider separation between the diagonal and equilibrium curve in the example.
examples.zh: 在该示例中，「相对挥发度」越大，平衡曲线越偏离对角线。

examples.en: We obtained relative volatility by dividing the equilibrium ratios of the two components in the table.
examples.zh: 我们将表中两种组分的平衡比相除，得到「相对挥发度」。

words.enDefinition: A separately obtained reading of the same quantity under stated measurement conditions.

examples.en: We took a replicate reading of the same marked slot without copying the value already in the table.
examples.zh: 我们对同一标记槽重新测量，得到一项「重复测量读数」。

examples.en: The next replicate reading went in a separate column so we could compare it with the first.
examples.zh: 下一项「重复测量读数」填入另一列，方便和第一次比较。

words.enDefinition: A separate specimen prepared under matching conditions to repeat a test comparison.

examples.en: The tutor supplied a replicate specimen from the same batch for the second classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 辅导老师从同一批次中提供了一件「平行试件」，用于第二次课堂比较。

examples.en: We labeled each replicate specimen separately even though all three came from one prepared sheet.
examples.zh: 三件试样虽取自同一张制备好的板材，我们仍分别标记了每件「平行试件」。

words.enDefinition: The ability to follow links between requirements, their sources, and the evidence that addresses them.

examples.en: Our worksheet showed requirement traceability by linking each classroom model feature to the need behind it.
examples.zh: 我们的习题把课堂模型的各项特征与相应需求关联起来，展示了「需求可追踪性」。

examples.en: The tutor checked requirement traceability by following a numbered requirement through to its supporting test result.
examples.zh: 辅导老师从一项编号要求追踪到相应的试验结果，以检查「需求可追踪性」。

words.enDefinition: A table linking individual requirements to related design features, checks, or supporting evidence.

examples.en: The requirements matrix had one row per requirement and a separate column for the classroom check.
examples.zh: 「需求对应表」中，每项需求独占一行，另有一列填写课堂检查方式。

examples.en: Our group used the requirements matrix to find which objective still lacked a corresponding observation.
examples.zh: 我们小组用「需求对应表」找出哪项目标还缺少相应的观察结果。

words.enDefinition: A measure of how much an element opposes electric current, expressed in ohms.

examples.en: The resistance is greater for the longer wire when both wires have the same thickness and material.
examples.zh: 两段导线的粗细和材料相同时，较长导线的「电阻」更大。

examples.en: We used the stated resistance to calculate the current in the low-voltage example.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的「电阻」计算低压示例中的电流。

words.enDefinition: The interval of resistance values a meter can display using a particular measurement setting.

examples.en: The resistance range in the handout covers the nominal value of the modelled resistor.
examples.zh: 讲义列出的「电阻量程」覆盖所示电阻器的标称阻值。

examples.en: We compared the resolution shown for each resistance range in the instrument's example specification table.
examples.zh: 我们比较仪表规格示例表中各「电阻量程」所列的分辨率。

words.enDefinition: A passive circuit component designed to provide a specified electrical resistance.

examples.en: The resistor in the example converts electrical energy to heat at the rate calculated on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 示例中的「电阻器」按练习纸计算的速率将电能转化为热。

examples.en: We labelled each resistor with its resistance value before solving the circuit on paper.
examples.zh: 我们给各个「电阻器」标出阻值，再在纸上求解电路。

words.enDefinition: A set of coloured bands indicating a resistor's nominal value and usually its tolerance.

examples.en: The resistor colour code in the example matches the nominal value printed beside the drawing.
examples.zh: 示例中的「电阻色环码」与图旁印出的标称阻值相符。

examples.en: We used the resistor colour code chart to interpret the illustrated bands in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「电阻色环码」表解读课堂练习中所画的各条色环。

words.enDefinition: To express a force as components in specified directions.

examples.en: We learned to resolve a force into horizontal and vertical components before writing the two equations.
examples.zh: 我们先学会将「力分解」为水平和竖直分量，再列出两个方程。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to resolve a force along the ramp and perpendicular to its surface.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们沿斜面方向和垂直斜面的方向「分解一个力」。

collocations: resolve a force along the axes
resolve a force in two directions

words.enDefinition: Enhanced response when periodic excitation lies near a system's characteristic frequency

examples.en: The desktop spring model shows resonance as the forcing frequency approaches a response peak.
examples.zh: 激励频率接近响应曲线的峰值频率时，桌面弹簧模型呈现「共振」。

examples.en: We discussed resonance by comparing response amplitudes at several forcing frequencies.
examples.zh: 我们比较若干激励频率下的响应振幅，讨论了「共振」。

words.enDefinition: Excitation frequency giving a peak in the specified steady-state response

examples.en: We marked the resonant frequency at the peak of the displacement response curve.
examples.zh: 我们在位移响应曲线的峰值处标出了「共振频率」。

examples.en: The resonant frequency can differ from the undamped frequency when damping is present.
examples.zh: 存在阻尼时，「共振频率」可能不同于无阻尼固有频率。

words.enDefinition: Force component tending to move a displaced system back toward equilibrium

examples.en: The arrow for the restoring force points toward equilibrium when the spring is stretched.
examples.zh: 弹簧被拉伸时，表示「回复力」的箭头指向平衡位置。

examples.en: We drew the restoring force for displacements on both sides of the rest position.
examples.zh: 我们分别画出了静止位置两侧的位移所对应的「回复力」。

words.enDefinition: The vector sum of the forces in a system.

examples.en: We found the resultant force by adding the horizontal components and then the vertical components.
examples.zh: 我们分别将水平分量和竖直分量相加，求出了「合力」。

examples.en: Two equal arrows pointed in opposite directions, leaving zero resultant force on the model plate.
examples.zh: 两个等大的力方向相反，因此模型板所受「合力」为零。

words.enDefinition: The sum of moments from all forces and couples about a chosen point or axis.

examples.en: We added the signed contributions to find the resultant moment of the forces about the marked point.
examples.zh: 我们把各项带符号相加，求出这些力对标记点的「合力矩」。

examples.en: The class found a nonzero resultant moment even though the two applied forces cancelled in the sum.
examples.zh: 虽然两个外加力在求和时抵消，我们得到的「合力矩」仍不为零。

collocations: find the resultant moment about a point

words.enDefinition: Ring fitting a groove to restrict movement along a shaft or bore

examples.en: The retaining ring sits in a groove next to the sliding ring in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「挡圈」位于滑环旁边的一道凹槽内。

examples.en: We labeled the retaining ring that keeps the spacer from sliding off the shaft.
examples.zh: 我们标出了防止隔套滑出轴端的「挡圈」。

collocations: axial stop provided by a retaining ring

words.enDefinition: in liquid separation, the stream that remains on the feed side after part of the feed passes through a membrane

examples.en: The retentate carried most of the dissolved salt out of the simulated membrane unit.
examples.zh: 「截留液」把大部分溶解盐带出模拟膜单元。

examples.en: We compared the retentate volume with the smaller stream drawn on the other side of the membrane.
examples.zh: 我们把「截留液」体积与图中膜另一侧那股较小的物流作比较。

words.enDefinition: the elapsed time between sample injection and the detection of a component's peak in chromatography

examples.en: We read the retention time of each component by finding its peak maximum on the example graph.
examples.zh: 我们找出示例图上各个峰的顶点，读出每个组分的「保留时间」。

examples.en: The first compound appeared earlier and therefore had a shorter retention time in the simulated trace.
examples.zh: 在模拟曲线上，第一个化合物较早出现，因此「保留时间」较短。

words.enDefinition: an applied voltage that raises a junction's potential barrier and normally limits current before breakdown

examples.en: In the simulation, reverse bias made the depletion region wider than it was at equilibrium.
examples.zh: 模拟中，「反向偏置」使耗尽区比平衡时更宽。

examples.en: The ideal model predicted zero current under reverse bias, while the measured current was small but detectable.
examples.zh: 理想模型预测「反向偏置」下的电流为零，实测电流虽小但可测得。

collocations: operate a diode under reverse bias

words.enDefinition: the small reverse current through a biased device before it reaches breakdown

examples.en: The recorded reverse leakage current remained small over the voltage range shown on the classroom graph.
examples.zh: 课堂图所示电压范围内，记录的「反向漏电流」一直很小。

examples.en: We compared the reverse leakage current at two temperatures using the component data provided in class.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂给出的元件数据比较两个温度下的「反向漏电流」。

collocations: reverse leakage current at room temperature

words.enDefinition: separation in which applied pressure drives solvent through a membrane against the direction of natural osmosis

examples.en: The reverse osmosis diagram shows water moving toward the side with lower dissolved salt concentration.
examples.zh: 「反渗透」图显示，水流向溶解盐浓度较低的一侧。

examples.en: We identified the lower-salt outlet in the reverse osmosis model by following the permeate arrow.
examples.zh: 我们顺着渗透液箭头，在「反渗透」模型中找到盐含量较低的出口。

words.enDefinition: an ideal process that can be reversed with no net change to either the system or its surroundings

examples.en: The model called the expansion a reversible process because it assumed equilibrium throughout and excluded friction.
examples.zh: 模型假定全过程接近平衡且无摩擦，因而将膨胀视为「可逆过程」。

examples.en: We used a reversible process as the benchmark for the work obtainable from the expanding gas.
examples.zh: 我们以「可逆过程」为基准，比较气体膨胀所能提供的功。

collocations: use a reversible process as a benchmark

words.enDefinition: A drawing table that records changes along with identifiers such as revision labels or dates.

examples.en: We looked at the revision block to see which drawing version moved the slot in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们查看「修订栏」，找出哪一版图样更改了课堂模型上槽的位置。

examples.en: The tutor found the change description and its date in the same revision block row.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在「修订栏」的同一行找到了变更说明和日期。

collocations: an entry in the revision block

words.enDefinition: Unit counting complete rotations during one minute at a specified rate

examples.en: The display reports the wheel's rotation in revolutions per minute during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示时，显示屏以「转每分钟」为单位报告轮子的转速。

examples.en: We converted revolutions per minute before comparing the wheel with the angular speed calculation.
examples.zh: 我们将读数从「转每分钟」换算成所需单位，再与车轮角速率的计算值作比较。

words.enDefinition: a dimensionless ratio of inertial effects to viscous effects for a flow at a chosen length and speed

examples.en: We estimated the Reynolds number from the tube diameter, average water speed and kinematic viscosity.
examples.zh: 我们用管径、水的平均流速和运动黏度估算「雷诺数」。

examples.en: The smaller Reynolds number indicated a greater relative influence of viscosity in the second model.
examples.zh: 较小的「雷诺数」表明第二个模型中黏性作用的相对影响较大。

words.enDefinition: An idealized body whose points remain fixed distances apart under load.

examples.en: We treated the small plate as a rigid body when drawing its forces on the board.
examples.zh: 在黑板上画作用于小板的力时，我们把小板视为「刚体」。

examples.en: The rigid body in the drawing could rotate even though its shape remained unchanged throughout the example.
examples.zh: 图中的「刚体」可以转动，在整个例题中形状保持不变。

collocations: model an object as a rigid body

words.enDefinition: Description of rigid-body motion through position, orientation, velocity, and acceleration

examples.en: We used rigid-body kinematics to compare velocities at two points on the same plate.
examples.zh: 我们用「刚体运动学」比较同一平板上两点的速度。

examples.en: The rigid-body kinematics exercise specifies the disk's motion before asking about a marked point.
examples.zh: 「刚体运动学」练习先给出圆盘的运动，再询问其中一个标记点的运动。

words.enDefinition: Study linking forces and moments to the motion of rigid bodies

examples.en: In rigid-body kinetics, the same moment can produce different angular accelerations in disks with different inertia.
examples.zh: 在「刚体动力学」中，相同的力矩作用于质量分布不同的圆盘，可以产生不同的角加速度。

examples.en: Our rigid-body kinetics exercise relates the forces on a sliding plate to its acceleration.
examples.zh: 我们的「刚体动力学」练习把滑动平板所受的力与其加速度联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Shaft connection that maintains fixed alignment with essentially no intentional flexibility

examples.en: The rigid coupling in our model connects two shafts on the same centerline.
examples.zh: 我们模型中的「刚性联轴器」连接位于同一中心线上的两根轴。

examples.en: We drew a rigid coupling to show how aligned shafts rotate together.
examples.zh: 我们画出一个「刚性联轴器」，演示已对中的轴如何一起转动。

words.enDefinition: Frame with connections maintaining the angles between joined members in the model

examples.en: The rigid-jointed frame keeps the corner angles fixed in our idealized drawing.
examples.zh: 在我们的理想化示意图中，「刚接框架」的角部夹角保持固定。

examples.en: We used a rigid-jointed frame to illustrate how moments pass through the connections.
examples.zh: 我们用「刚接框架」说明力矩如何通过连接部位传递。

words.enDefinition: Outer internally toothed gear surrounding the planets in a planetary assembly

examples.en: The ring gear surrounds the smaller gears and has teeth facing inward.
examples.zh: 「齿圈」包围着较小的齿轮，其齿朝内。

examples.en: We held the ring gear stationary when comparing the motions in our model.
examples.zh: 我们在比较模型中的运动时，保持「齿圈」静止。

words.enDefinition: the residual periodic voltage variation superimposed on the average output of a nominally direct-current supply

examples.en: A small ripple voltage remained visible above the nearly steady level on the simulated output trace.
examples.zh: 模拟输出曲线在近似恒定的电平附近仍可看到少量「纹波电压」。

examples.en: We compared ripple voltage by reading the separation between adjacent peaks and troughs on both traces.
examples.zh: 我们读取两条曲线中相邻波峰与波谷的差值，比较「纹波电压」。

words.enDefinition: the time for a step response to move between two specified levels, commonly ten and ninety percent of its total change

examples.en: We measured rise time from the two threshold crossings marked on the simulated step response plot.
examples.zh: 我们用阶跃响应模拟图中标出的两个交越点测量「上升时间」。

examples.en: Both responses crossed the lower threshold together, so reaching the upper threshold sooner meant shorter rise time.
examples.zh: 两条响应同时穿过下阈值，较早达到上阈值的响应具有较短的「上升时间」。

collocations: rise time of a step response

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose relevant response is governed by resistance and inductance.

examples.en: The RL circuit in the worksheet contains a resistor in series with one ideal inductor.
examples.zh: 练习的「RL 电路」含一个电阻器与一个理想电感器串联。

examples.en: We read the current curve for the RL circuit after the simulated source changed on screen.
examples.zh: 我们在屏幕上的模拟电源发生变化后，读取「RL 电路」的电流曲线。

words.enDefinition: The characteristic response time of a first-order resistive-inductive circuit, equal to inductance divided by the relevant resistance.

examples.en: The RL time constant decreases when the simulation increases resistance while holding the inductance fixed.
examples.zh: 模拟保持电感不变而提高电阻时，「RL 时间常数」缩短。

examples.en: We read the RL time constant from the current curve provided on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂练习给出的电流曲线读取「RL 时间常数」。

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose relevant response involves resistance, inductance, and capacitance.

examples.en: The RLC circuit displays a current peak at one frequency in the simulated series configuration.
examples.zh: 在模拟的串联方式下，「RLC 电路」的电流在某个频率处达到峰值。

examples.en: We identified three passive components in the RLC circuit drawn on the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂讲义画出的「RLC 电路」里找出三种无源元件。

words.enDefinition: The decay of an RLC circuit's natural response due to energy dissipation, commonly from resistance.

examples.en: The worksheet shows stronger RLC damping when the simulated series resistance is increased in this example.
examples.zh: 练习示例中，模拟串联电阻增大时，「RLC 电路阻尼」增强。

examples.en: We compared RLC damping across three model curves with different resistance values in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们比较三个阻值不同的模型曲线所体现的「RLC 电路阻尼」。

words.enDefinition: The square root of the mean of squared current values over the stated interval.

examples.en: The RMS current gives the same resistor heating as an equal constant current in this model.
examples.zh: 这个模型中，大小等于「电流有效值」的恒定电流会产生同等的电阻发热。

examples.en: We found RMS current from the simulated periodic waveform in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂问题的模拟周期波形求出「电流有效值」。

words.enDefinition: The square root of the mean of squared voltage values over the stated interval.

examples.en: The RMS voltage of the sine wave is smaller than its peak voltage in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，正弦波的「电压有效值」小于其峰值电压。

examples.en: We compared RMS voltage and peak voltage for the simulated sinusoidal input on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中模拟正弦输入的「电压有效值」和峰值电压。

words.enDefinition: Rolling-element bearing using rollers as the components that carry load

examples.en: The roller bearing in our sketch uses cylindrical rolling elements to carry the load.
examples.zh: 我们草图中的「滚子轴承」采用圆柱形滚动元件承受载荷。

examples.en: We compared the shape of each rolling component in the roller bearing.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「滚子轴承」中各滚动元件的形状。

words.enDefinition: An ideal support acting perpendicular to its surface and allowing sliding and rotation in a plane.

examples.en: The reaction at the roller support pointed perpendicular to the smooth surface in the sketch.
examples.zh: 草图中，「滚动支座」处的反力垂直于光滑的支承面。

examples.en: We drew only one reaction arrow for the ideal roller support in our plane equilibrium problem.
examples.zh: 在这道平面平衡题中，我们只给理想「滚动支座」画了一个反力箭头。

collocations: the reaction at a roller support
a roller support on an inclined surface

words.enDefinition: Bearing carrying loads through balls or rollers moving between race surfaces

examples.en: The rolling-element bearing in the cutaway uses small balls between two rings.
examples.zh: 剖开示意图中的「滚动轴承」在两个套圈之间使用小滚珠。

examples.en: We sketched the rolling-element bearing before identifying its rolling and stationary components.
examples.zh: 我们先画了「滚动轴承」的草图，再识别滚动和固定的元件。

words.enDefinition: Rolling in which the contacting bodies have zero relative velocity at their point of contact.

examples.en: In rolling without slipping, the wheel center's speed equals its radius times its angular speed.
examples.zh: 在「纯滚动」中，轮心速率等于车轮半径与角速率的乘积。

examples.en: We assumed rolling without slipping before using the wheel's rotation to calculate distance along the track.
examples.zh: 我们先假定「纯滚动」，再用车轮的转动量计算沿轨道移动的距离。

words.enDefinition: a plot of possible closed-loop pole locations as a specified gain varies

examples.en: The root locus showed how the modeled poles moved as we increased the classroom controller gain.
examples.zh: 「根轨迹」显示，在课堂控制器的增益增大时，模型极点如何移动。

examples.en: We used the root locus to see whether the poles crossed into the right half of the plane.
examples.zh: 我们用「根轨迹」查看极点是否越入复平面的右半边。

words.enDefinition: Motion energy associated with a body's rotation about the selected axis

examples.en: Increasing the disk's angular speed increases its rotational kinetic energy when the inertia is unchanged.
examples.zh: 当质量惯性矩不变时，提高圆盘的角速率会增加它的「转动动能」。

examples.en: We calculated rotational kinetic energy about the disk's center before adding the translational term.
examples.zh: 我们先算出圆盘绕其中心的「转动动能」，再加上平动项。

words.enDefinition: Rate of work equal to the dot product of torque and angular velocity

examples.en: We found rotational power by multiplying the shaft torque by its angular velocity.
examples.zh: 我们将轴上的力矩乘以其角速度，求出了「转动功率」。

examples.en: The model's rotational power rises as the speed increases under the same torque.
examples.zh: 力矩不变时，随着转速增大，模型的「转动功率」升高。

words.enDefinition: A masonry pattern in which vertical joints are offset in successive courses.

examples.en: The tutor recognized running bond because the vertical joints shifted from one row to the next.
examples.zh: 各皮砖之间的竖缝相互错开，因此辅导老师认出这是「错缝砌筑」。

examples.en: We compared the running bond sketch with another drawing whose joints lined up vertically across courses.
examples.zh: 我们将「错缝砌筑」草图与另一幅各皮砖竖缝对齐的图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Graph showing runoff discharge at a location as time passes

examples.en: We read the runoff hydrograph to see when discharge was greatest in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们读取「径流过程线」，确定仿真中流量何时最大。

examples.en: The synthetic runoff hydrograph shows a rise followed by a gradual decline.
examples.zh: 合成的「径流过程线」先上升，随后逐渐下降。

words.enDefinition: A bending moment that curves a horizontal beam concave up with its lower fibers in tension.

examples.en: The tutor drew a sagging moment and shaded the lower fibers to show they were in tension.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画出「下挠弯矩」，并用阴影表示下部纤维受拉。

examples.en: In the sketch, the sagging moment made the small horizontal model curve upward like a bowl.
examples.zh: 草图中的「下挠弯矩」使小型水平模型弯成碗形，凹面朝上。

words.enDefinition: a circuit that captures an input value at a sampling instant and holds it for a subsequent interval

examples.en: The sample-and-hold circuit kept the input value constant during conversion in the classroom block diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂方框图里，「采样保持电路」在转换期间保持输入值恒定。

examples.en: We drew the sample-and-hold circuit output as a series of levels that change at each sampling instant.
examples.zh: 我们将「采样保持电路」的输出画成一系列在各采样时刻改变的电平。

words.enDefinition: the number of equally spaced samples taken per unit time

examples.en: We doubled the sampling frequency and obtained twice as many readings during the same recorded interval.
examples.zh: 我们将「采样频率」翻倍，在同一段记录时间内取得了两倍的读数。

examples.en: The report gives the sampling frequency in hertz beside the description of the acquisition setup.
examples.zh: 报告在说明采集装置的同时，以赫兹列出「采样频率」。

words.enDefinition: the time interval between successive samples in uniform sampling

examples.en: The sampling period was shorter when the system recorded more values in the same observation window.
examples.zh: 系统在同一观测时段内记录更多数值时，「采样周期」更短。

examples.en: We found the sampling period by taking the reciprocal of the sampling frequency on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们取练习中采样频率的倒数，求出「采样周期」。

words.enDefinition: liquid at the temperature and pressure where it is in equilibrium with, or about to form, vapor

examples.en: We chose the saturated liquid column because the heating path was just about to produce vapor.
examples.zh: 加热路径刚要产生蒸气，所以我们选取了「饱和液体」列。

examples.en: At the same pressure, saturated liquid had lower specific enthalpy than saturated vapor in the table.
examples.zh: 表中同一压力下，「饱和液体」的比焓小于饱和蒸气。

words.enDefinition: liquid and vapor of the same substance coexisting in equilibrium

examples.en: The sketch marks the region for a saturated mixture between the liquid and vapor saturation lines.
examples.zh: 示意图在饱和液线与饱和蒸气线之间标出「饱和两相混合物」的区域。

examples.en: We found the specific enthalpy of the saturated mixture by weighting both phase values by their mass fractions.
examples.zh: 我们用两相各自的质量分数加权其比焓值，求得「饱和两相混合物」的比焓。

words.enDefinition: An aggregate condition with water-filled permeable pores and no surface water film.

examples.en: The saturated surface-dry condition meant the pores held water while each particle's outer surface showed no film.
examples.zh: 「饱和面干状态」指颗粒孔隙中有水，而颗粒表面没有水膜。

examples.en: The report listed dry aggregate mass separately from mass in saturated surface-dry condition for the same sample.
examples.zh: 报告将同一集料样品的干质量与「饱和面干状态」下的质量分开列出。

collocations: report mass in saturated surface-dry condition

words.enDefinition: Total weight per volume when water completely fills the soil voids

examples.en: The saturated unit weight includes the weight of both solids and water in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「饱和重度」同时计入固体颗粒和水的重量。

examples.en: We used saturated unit weight after the phase diagram showed that no air remained.
examples.zh: 三相图显示已无孔隙气体后，我们使用了「饱和重度」。

collocations: saturated unit weight of a soil

words.enDefinition: vapor at the temperature and pressure where it is in equilibrium with, or about to form, liquid

examples.en: The endpoint represents saturated vapor, where further cooling at constant pressure would begin to form liquid.
examples.zh: 终点代表「饱和蒸气」，在定压下继续冷却就会开始产生液体。

examples.en: We read the specific volume of saturated vapor from the right-hand column of the steam table.
examples.zh: 我们从蒸汽表的右列读取「饱和蒸气」的比体积。

words.enDefinition: pressure at which liquid and vapor can coexist in equilibrium at a given temperature

examples.en: We read the saturation pressure of water directly from the table at the given temperature.
examples.zh: 我们按给定温度直接从物性表中读取水的「饱和压力」。

examples.en: In the comparison, saturation pressure increased as we selected higher temperatures along the phase boundary.
examples.zh: 在比较中，沿相边界选取的温度越高，相应的「饱和压力」也越高。

collocations: saturation pressure at a given temperature

words.enDefinition: the conducting region where drain current is governed primarily by gate-source voltage and depends relatively weakly on drain-source voltage

examples.en: The modeled curve flattened as it entered the saturation region of a MOSFET for the selected gate voltage.
examples.zh: 给定栅极电压时，模型曲线进入「MOSFET 饱和区」后变平。

examples.en: The instructor chose the saturation region of a MOSFET to introduce small variations around an amplifier operating point.
examples.zh: 老师选择在「MOSFET 饱和区」介绍放大器工作点附近的小变化。

collocations: identify the saturation region of a MOSFET
model the saturation region of a MOSFET
bias into the saturation region of a MOSFET

words.enDefinition: temperature at which liquid and vapor can coexist in equilibrium at a given pressure

examples.en: The saturation temperature of water in the exercise was lower at the lower ambient pressure.
examples.zh: 练习中，环境压力越低，水的「饱和温度」也越低。

examples.en: We compared the thermometer reading with the saturation temperature to identify the state of the steam.
examples.zh: 我们将温度计读数与「饱和温度」比较，以判断蒸汽的状态。

collocations: saturation temperature at a stated pressure

words.enDefinition: Solid wood cut from logs into boards or other rectangular pieces.

examples.en: The sawn lumber sample showed continuous grain lines across its broad face in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂展台上的「锯材」样品宽面上有连贯的木纹。

examples.en: We compared sawn lumber with the layered wood product shown on the next materials card.
examples.zh: 我们将「锯材」与下一张材料卡上的层状木制品作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The interval between neighboring marks on an instrument's marked scale.

examples.en: Each scale division on the pictured ruler represented the same length in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中，图中尺子的每一「标尺分度」都对应相同的长度。

examples.en: We checked the value of one scale division before recording the reading shown in the photograph.
examples.zh: 记录照片所示读数前，我们先核对一个「标尺分度」所代表的值。

collocations: the value of one scale division

words.enDefinition: Flaking or peeling away of the near-surface mortar of hardened concrete.

examples.en: The picture caption identified scaling of concrete where thin flakes had broken away from the surface.
examples.zh: 图片说明指出，表面有薄片脱落的位置出现了「混凝土表面剥蚀」。

examples.en: We used the closeup to distinguish scaling of concrete from the deeper loss shown in another panel.
examples.zh: 我们借助近景区分「混凝土表面剥蚀」与另一栏图片所示的较深剥落。

collocations: a photo showing the scaling of concrete
the extent of scaling of concrete

words.enDefinition: a switching circuit that uses different input thresholds for transitions in opposite directions

examples.en: The Schmitt trigger changed state at different input levels on the rising and falling portions of the trace.
examples.zh: 在曲线上升段和下降段，「施密特触发器」在不同的输入电平切换状态。

examples.en: The Schmitt trigger model prevented small input fluctuations from causing repeated switches near the nominal threshold.
examples.zh: 「施密特触发器」模型避免了输入在标称阈值附近小幅波动时反复切换。

words.enDefinition: the opening size in a screen or sieve through which material can pass

examples.en: The screen aperture was smaller on the second sieve, so it retained finer particles in the illustration.
examples.zh: 第二个筛子的「筛孔尺寸」更小，所以图中它能截留较细的颗粒。

examples.en: We compared screen aperture with grain dimensions to explain the sorting shown in the classroom photo.
examples.zh: 我们把「筛孔尺寸」和颗粒大小比较，解释课堂照片中的分选现象。

words.enDefinition: Count of trips or vehicles crossing an imaginary line at selected crossings

examples.en: We used a screenline count to combine crossings of one imaginary boundary line.
examples.zh: 我们进行「截线交通量调查」，汇总穿过同一条假想边界线的交通量。

examples.en: The example adds observations from several crossings to form a screenline count.
examples.zh: 示例把多个过线点的观测值相加，得到一次「截线交通量调查」的总量。

words.enDefinition: the principle that total entropy of an isolated system cannot decrease

examples.en: The second law of thermodynamics explains why heat flows spontaneously from a warmer block to a cooler one.
examples.zh: 「热力学第二定律」解释了热量为何自发地从较热的块体传向较冷的块体。

examples.en: We used the second law of thermodynamics to rule out the proposed perfect heat engine.
examples.zh: 我们用「热力学第二定律」排除了所设想的百分之百效率热机。

collocations: apply the second law of thermodynamics
state the second law of thermodynamics
test consistency with the second law of thermodynamics

words.enDefinition: The integral of squared perpendicular distance from a chosen axis over an area.

examples.en: Turning the rectangle changed its second moment of area about the horizontal axis in our sketch.
examples.zh: 在草图中转动矩形之后，它对水平轴的「面积二次矩」发生了变化。

examples.en: The tutor used the second moment of area to compare two sections with the same total area.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「面积二次矩」比较两个总面积相同的截面。

collocations: calculate the second moment of area
the second moment of area about an axis
a larger second moment of area

words.enDefinition: Continued gradual deformation after primary consolidation under roughly constant effective stress

examples.en: The later part of the sketch shows secondary compression after excess pressure has dissipated.
examples.zh: 示意图的后段显示了超额水压消散后的「次压缩」。

examples.en: We examined secondary compression by plotting the later compression against logarithmic time.
examples.zh: 我们把后期压缩量画在对数时间轴上，以考察「次压缩」。

words.enDefinition: An imaginary cut exposing the internal forces and moments on a chosen section.

examples.en: We drew a section cut between the two point loads before sketching the exposed face.
examples.zh: 我们在两个集中载荷之间画出「假想截面」的位置，再勾画露出的断面。

examples.en: The tutor moved the section cut to a different location and asked us to redraw the internal arrows.
examples.zh: 辅导老师改变了「假想截面」的位置，让我们重画内力箭头。

collocations: a section cut through a beam

words.enDefinition: Repeated lines or patterns marking solid material intersected by an imagined cutting plane.

examples.en: The section hatching marked the solid material around the slot in the block's imagined cut.
examples.zh: 「剖面线」标出了假想切开方块后槽周围的实体部分。

examples.en: We removed the section hatching from the empty space after comparing the drawing with the classroom model.
examples.zh: 将图样与课堂模型比较后，我们删去了空白区域中的「剖面线」。

words.enDefinition: The second moment of area divided by the distance from the neutral axis to an extreme fiber.

examples.en: We used the section modulus to compare the extreme fiber stresses for two beams under the same moment.
examples.zh: 我们用「截面模量」比较两根梁在相同弯矩下边缘纤维的应力。

examples.en: The tutor showed that an asymmetric section could have a different section modulus on each side.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，不对称截面两侧的「截面模量」可能不同。

words.enDefinition: A view showing internal features revealed by an imagined cut through an object.

examples.en: The section view revealed the slot hidden inside the small block in our classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸上的「剖视图」显出了小方块里原先看不见的槽。

examples.en: We checked the section view to see where the two layers of the sample touched.
examples.zh: 我们查看「剖视图」，确认样品的两层在哪里接触。

collocations: a section view through the center

words.enDefinition: separation in which suspended particles settle under gravity so the liquid above them becomes clearer

examples.en: The sedimentation diagram shows particles settling to the bottom of the still water during the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 「沉降分离」图显示颗粒在课堂演示中沉到静水底部。

examples.en: We observed sedimentation in a classroom jar by noting the clearer layer above the settled solids.
examples.zh: 我们根据已沉固体上方更清澈的液层，观察课堂罐中的「沉降分离」。

words.enDefinition: Flowable concrete designed to fill forms and surround reinforcement without mechanical consolidation.

examples.en: The class saw a model showing self-consolidating concrete flowing into narrow spaces around the reinforcing bars.
examples.zh: 课堂模型展示了「自密实混凝土」流入钢筋周围狭窄空隙的情形。

examples.en: The worksheet associated self-consolidating concrete with a spread measurement from its fresh mixture test.
examples.zh: 习题将「自密实混凝土」与新拌混合料试验中的扩展度数据联系起来。

collocations: compare self-consolidating concrete with a conventional mix

words.enDefinition: A process handling a discrete batch while at least one material crosses its boundary during the run.

examples.en: The semibatch process example adds a water stream while the mixture stays in the vessel.
examples.zh: 「半间歇过程」示例中，混合物留在容器里，同时有一股水流加入。

examples.en: We identified the arrow that enters during the run in the semibatch process diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在「半间歇过程」图上找出了运行期间进入的箭头。

collocations: material balance for a semibatch process

words.enDefinition: a material whose electrical conductivity can be varied substantially by factors such as temperature, light or impurity content

examples.en: The examples show how light can change the conductivity of a semiconductor used in a detector.
examples.zh: 示例表明，光照能够改变探测器中「半导体」的导电性。

examples.en: We compared a silicon semiconductor with a metal to understand why their conductivities respond differently to temperature.
examples.zh: 我们比较硅「半导体」与金属，以理解两者的电导率对温度的响应为何不同。

words.enDefinition: a barrier that allows certain molecules or ions to pass while restricting others

examples.en: The semipermeable membrane allowed water to cross more readily than dissolved salt in the simple model.
examples.zh: 在简单模型中，相比溶解的盐，水更容易穿过「半透膜」。

examples.en: The teacher placed a dashed line on the sketch to represent the semipermeable membrane.
examples.zh: 老师在示意图上用虚线表示「半透膜」。

words.enDefinition: Cooling that lowers temperature without a phase change.

examples.en: The sensible cooling example shows liquid water losing heat while remaining in the same phase.
examples.zh: 「显热冷却」示例显示液态水放热，同时保持相态不变。

examples.en: We calculated the heat removed during sensible cooling using the classroom property table for water.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂水物性表，计算「显热冷却」期间移出的热量。

words.enDefinition: energy transferred as heat that changes temperature without changing the phase

examples.en: The first part of the curve represents sensible heat that warmed the water before boiling began.
examples.zh: 曲线的第一段代表使水在开始沸腾前升温的「显热」。

examples.en: We estimated sensible heat from the liquid's mass, specific heat capacity and measured temperature change.
examples.zh: 我们用液体的质量、比热容和测得的温度变化估算「显热」。

collocations: separate sensible heat from latent heat

words.enDefinition: Heating that raises temperature without a phase change.

examples.en: The sensible heating example follows water that stays liquid throughout the illustrated temperature change.
examples.zh: 「显热加热」示例中的水在整个图示温度变化期间都保持液态。

examples.en: We identified the sensible heating portion of the temperature plot before interpreting the energy balance.
examples.zh: 我们先找出温度图中对应「显热加热」的一段，再解读能量衡算。

words.enDefinition: a ratio comparing how two components partition between separated phases or streams under a specified convention

examples.en: The separation factor was near one because the two modeled components partitioned almost identically between phases.
examples.zh: 两种模拟组分在两相间的分配几乎相同，因此「分离因子」接近一。

examples.en: We specified the component order before calculating the separation factor from the two phase compositions.
examples.zh: 从两个相的组成计算「分离因子」前，我们先指明组分的顺序。

words.enDefinition: an operation or sequence of operations that divides a mixture into portions with different compositions

examples.en: The separation process produced clear water and a wetter solid residue in the simulated system.
examples.zh: 模拟系统中的「分离过程」得到了清水和含水量较高的固体残渣。

examples.en: We compared two versions of the separation process using the compositions shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习表列出的组成对照两个版本的「分离过程」。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of interconnected units that separate a feed into product and residual streams

examples.en: The separation train sketch shows a screen upstream of two different filters for the juice model.
examples.zh: 果汁模型的「串联分离流程」示意图显示，两个不同的过滤器前设有一台筛分装置。

examples.en: We followed the product streams across the separation train to find where the unwanted solids left.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「串联分离流程」追踪产品物流，找出不需要的固体从哪里离开。

collocations: sequence units in a separation train

words.enDefinition: An arrangement in which elements share one path and carry the same current.

examples.en: The series connection makes the same current pass through both resistors in the simplified circuit.
examples.zh: 由于采用「串联连接」，简化电路中两个电阻器通过相同电流。

examples.en: We recognised the series connection because no other branch meets the node between the two elements.
examples.zh: 我们认出这是「串联连接」，因为两个元件之间的节点没有接入其他支路。

words.enDefinition: The frequency at which the inductive and capacitive reactances of an ideal series RLC circuit cancel.

examples.en: The series resonant frequency occurs where the two reactance magnitudes are equal in the example graph.
examples.zh: 示例图中，两种电抗的绝对值相等时所对应的频率就是「串联谐振频率」。

examples.en: We calculated the series resonant frequency using the two energy storage components in the simulated circuit.
examples.zh: 我们根据模拟电路中两个储能元件计算「串联谐振频率」。

collocations: response near the series resonant frequency
series resonant frequency of an RLC circuit

words.enDefinition: The sum of thermal resistances for successive steps carrying the same steady heat transfer rate.

examples.en: The series thermal resistance adds the resistances of both wall layers in the worksheet model.
examples.zh: 练习模型中，两层壁面的热阻相加得到「串联总热阻」。

examples.en: We checked the constant transfer rate through the layers before finding the series thermal resistance.
examples.zh: 我们确认各段传热速率相同后，求出「串联总热阻」。

words.enDefinition: An admixture that speeds the setting of cement paste, mortar, or concrete.

examples.en: The example containing a set accelerator reached the marked setting point sooner on the classroom graph.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，加入「促凝剂」的示例更早到达标记的凝结点。

examples.en: We compared the manufacturer's stated purpose of a set accelerator with the purpose of a retarder.
examples.zh: 我们对比厂家说明的「促凝剂」用途与缓凝剂的用途。

collocations: a concrete mix with a set accelerator
the effect of a set accelerator

words.enDefinition: An admixture that delays the setting of cement paste, mortar, or concrete.

examples.en: The case study mentioned a set retarder when explaining why one batch remained workable for longer.
examples.zh: 案例提到一种「缓凝剂」，用以解释为什么其中一批混合料保持和易性的时间更长。

examples.en: We matched the set retarder label to the graph showing a later start of setting.
examples.zh: 我们把「缓凝剂」标签与显示开始凝结较晚的曲线对应起来。

collocations: a concrete mix with a set retarder
the effect of a set retarder

words.enDefinition: the desired value that a control system attempts to maintain or track

examples.en: The simulated room began warming after we raised the temperature setpoint by a small amount.
examples.zh: 我们略微提高温度「设定值」后，模拟房间开始升温。

examples.en: We plotted the measured output and the setpoint together to show how closely the model tracked it.
examples.zh: 我们同时绘出实测输出与「设定值」，展示模型跟随目标的程度。

words.enDefinition: the elapsed time after an input change until the output enters and stays within a stated tolerance of its final value

examples.en: We marked the settling time at the last entry into the shaded tolerance band on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们在图上将最后一次进入阴影容差带的时刻标为「调节时间」。

examples.en: Two models rose equally quickly, but one had a longer settling time because its oscillations persisted.
examples.zh: 两个模型上升同样快，其中一个的振荡持续较久，所以「调节时间」较长。

collocations: settling time within a stated tolerance

words.enDefinition: the downward speed of a particle relative to the surrounding fluid during gravitational settling

examples.en: We estimated settling velocity by tracking one particle over several frames after its speed became nearly constant.
examples.zh: 颗粒速度接近恒定后，我们在连续图像中追踪它，估算「沉降速度」。

examples.en: The finer particles had a lower settling velocity than coarser particles of the same material in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，材料相同的较细颗粒比粗颗粒的「沉降速度」低。

words.enDefinition: Ring fastened around a shaft to locate another part or limit movement

examples.en: The shaft collar in the drawing limits how far the wheel can slide.
examples.zh: 图中的「轴环」限制了车轮可沿轴滑动的距离。

examples.en: We marked a shaft collar next to the spacer on the tabletop model.
examples.zh: 我们在桌面模型的隔套旁标出了一个「轴环」。

collocations: locate a part with a shaft collar

words.enDefinition: Component joining two shafts so that torque can pass between them

examples.en: The diagram places a shaft coupling between the motor and the test shaft.
examples.zh: 图中在电机和试验轴之间设置了一个「联轴器」。

examples.en: We marked the shaft coupling where the two shaft ends join in the model.
examples.zh: 我们标出了模型中连接两个轴端的「联轴器」。

words.enDefinition: Small piece fitting shaft and hub slots to transmit torque between them

examples.en: The diagram shows a shaft key connecting the wheel hub and its shaft.
examples.zh: 图中显示一枚「轴键」连接轮毂与其轴。

examples.en: We shaded the shaft key to show which part prevents relative rotation here.
examples.zh: 我们给「轴键」涂上阴影，表示此处是哪个零件限制相对转动。

collocations: fit a shaft key into a slot

words.enDefinition: mechanical energy transferred across a boundary by a shaft transmitting torque while rotating

examples.en: The arrows on the turbine diagram show shaft work leaving the control volume through its axle.
examples.zh: 涡轮图中的箭头表明，「轴功」通过转轴离开控制体。

examples.en: We added shaft work to the energy balance because the paddle is driven from outside.
examples.zh: 搅拌桨由外部驱动，所以我们在能量平衡中加入「轴功」。

words.enDefinition: An internal force component transverse to a member's longitudinal axis.

examples.en: We calculated the shear force just to the left of the downward load in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们计算了图中向下载荷紧邻左侧截面处的「剪力」。

examples.en: The tutor corrected the shear force arrow after checking the face shown by the section cut.
examples.zh: 辅导老师核对切口露出的是哪一面后，修正了「剪力」箭头的方向。

collocations: the shear force at a section

words.enDefinition: A graph of internal shear force against position along a member.

examples.en: The shear force diagram had a jump at the position of the concentrated load in our exercise.
examples.zh: 例题的「剪力图」在集中载荷所在位置发生跳变。

examples.en: We read the shear force diagram just to the right of the support in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在「剪力图」上读取课堂模型支座紧邻右侧的剪力。

collocations: a jump in the shear force diagram

words.enDefinition: The ratio of shear stress to shear strain in the linear elastic range.

examples.en: The two samples had different shear modulus values even though their classroom drawings looked identical.
examples.zh: 两个试样的课堂示意图看起来相同，但它们的「剪切模量」不同。

examples.en: We identified the shear modulus as the slope of the initial linear segment in the shear test plot.
examples.zh: 我们把剪切试验图上初始直线段的斜率确定为「剪切模量」。

collocations: a material with a high shear modulus

words.enDefinition: In engineering usage, the angular change between material lines initially at right angles.

examples.en: We estimated shear strain from the change in angle between two originally perpendicular marked lines.
examples.zh: 我们根据原来互相垂直的两条标线之间的夹角变化估算了「剪应变」。

examples.en: The tutor sketched a tilted square to show what a positive shear strain meant in the example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师画了一个倾斜的方形，说明例题中正的「剪应变」表示什么。

words.enDefinition: Force per unit area acting tangentially to the surface under consideration.

examples.en: The small element illustrated shear stress with arrows parallel to each of the relevant faces.
examples.zh: 小单元图中用平行于各个相关面的箭头表示「剪应力」。

examples.en: We found that the shear stress in the circular shaft varied across its cross-section.
examples.zh: 我们发现，圆轴的「剪应力」在横截面上随位置变化。

words.enDefinition: an exchanger in which one stream flows through a bundle of tubes while the other flows through the enclosing shell

examples.en: The shell-and-tube heat exchanger sketch shows a bundle of tubes inside the large cylindrical shell.
examples.zh: 「管壳式换热器」示意图显示，大圆柱壳体内装有一束管子。

examples.en: We traced both paths in the shell-and-tube heat exchanger to see where they exchange heat without mixing.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「管壳式换热器」内两条流路，观察它们在哪里传热且不发生混合。

collocations: flow in a shell-and-tube heat exchanger

words.enDefinition: Temporary supports, such as props or braces, placed to support construction loads or stabilize an existing structure.

examples.en: The case photograph identified shoring as the temporary upright supports beneath the unfinished deck in the model.
examples.zh: 案例照片将模型中未完工的板件下方的临时立柱标为「临时支撑」。

examples.en: We marked shoring in a different color from the permanent columns in the construction section drawing.
examples.zh: 施工剖面中，我们用不同于永久柱的颜色标出「临时支撑」。

words.enDefinition: The current predicted between two terminals in a circuit model when their potential difference is zero.

examples.en: In the worksheet, the short-circuit current is a calculated value from an ideal equivalent circuit.
examples.zh: 练习中的「短路电流」是根据理想等效电路算出的数值。

examples.en: We compared the short-circuit current reported by the simulator with the value on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把模拟器报告的「短路电流」与练习纸上的数值作了比较。

collocations: short-circuit current of an equivalent circuit

words.enDefinition: A connection with zero or very low resistance between points, idealized as having no voltage drop.

examples.en: The ideal short circuit in the simulation has zero voltage across its two marked terminals.
examples.zh: 模拟中的理想「短路」在两个标记端子之间的电压为零。

examples.en: We identified the short circuit where an ideal wire directly joined the two labelled terminals.
examples.zh: 我们看到理想导线直接连通两个标记端子，在图上识别出「短路」。

words.enDefinition: A crack that forms when material contraction is restrained or uneven.

examples.en: The caption identified a shrinkage crack in the photograph and described the restraint in the example.
examples.zh: 图片说明指出照片中的一道「收缩裂缝」，并描述了示例中的约束情况。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the thin line we marked was a shrinkage crack or a construction joint.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，我们标出来的细线是「收缩裂缝」还是施工缝。

words.enDefinition: Water content below which further drying causes essentially no volume reduction

examples.en: The volume curve levels off below the shrinkage limit in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，含水率低于「缩限」后，体积曲线趋平。

examples.en: We read the shrinkage limit at the transition to constant volume on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图过渡到体积不变的位置读出了「缩限」。

words.enDefinition: the process of estimating or recovering a continuous-time signal from its samples

examples.en: The example uses signal reconstruction to turn the stored sample values back into a continuous waveform.
examples.zh: 示例用「信号重构」把存储的采样值重新转成连续波形。

examples.en: We compared signal reconstruction with linear interpolation against the ideal result for the bandlimited example.
examples.zh: 我们把线性插值所得的「信号重构」结果与带限示例的理想结果比较。

words.enDefinition: An ultrafine silica-rich powder collected from silicon or ferrosilicon production.

examples.en: The tutor showed silica fume beside the other powders so we could compare the labeled samples.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把「硅灰」放在其他粉料旁，让我们比较这些带标签的样品。

examples.en: Our notes listed silica fume as a reactive binder ingredient obtained during silicon alloy production.
examples.zh: 笔记把「硅灰」列为硅合金生产中获得的一种活性胶结料组分。

words.enDefinition: Sinusoidal motion whose acceleration is proportional and opposite to displacement from equilibrium

examples.en: The ideal slider shows simple harmonic motion when the model ignores damping and outside forcing.
examples.zh: 模型忽略阻尼和外部激励时，理想滑块做「简谐运动」。

examples.en: We drew simple harmonic motion as a repeating sine curve centered on its rest position.
examples.zh: 我们把「简谐运动」画成以静止位置为中心的重复正弦曲线。

words.enDefinition: A beam on two simple supports that allow end rotation and exert no reaction moment.

examples.en: We drew a simply supported beam with a pin on one side and a roller on the other.
examples.zh: 我们画了一根「简支梁」，一端是铰支座，另一端是滚动支座。

examples.en: The simply supported beam in our exercise carried a single downward load at the middle.
examples.zh: 练习中的「简支梁」在中央受到一个向下的集中载荷。

collocations: a point load on a simply supported beam
reactions of a simply supported beam

words.enDefinition: Model whose configuration can be described by one independent coordinate

examples.en: The slider forms a single-degree-of-freedom system because only its horizontal position can change.
examples.zh: 滑块构成「单自由度系统」，因为只有它的水平位置可以变化。

examples.en: We represented the single-degree-of-freedom system using displacement along the guide as its only coordinate.
examples.zh: 我们用沿导轨的位移作为唯一坐标来表示这个「单自由度系统」。

words.enDefinition: The continuing sinusoidal response of a linear circuit to sinusoidal forcing at the same frequency after transients decay.

examples.en: The voltage and current share one frequency in the sinusoidal steady state of our ideal circuit.
examples.zh: 理想电路达到「正弦稳态」时，电压和电流具有同一频率。

examples.en: We used a phasor diagram after assuming sinusoidal steady state in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂问题中，我们假定达到「正弦稳态」，然后使用相量图。

words.enDefinition: A plan showing how access, material movement, and temporary site use are organized during construction.

examples.en: The site logistics plan in our case study marked separate areas for deliveries and material storage.
examples.zh: 案例中的「施工现场物流布置图」分别标出了收货区和材料堆放区。

examples.en: We consulted the site logistics plan to interpret the arrows showing vehicle movements on the model site.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「施工现场物流布置图」，读懂模型现场表示车辆行进方向的箭头。

collocations: a delivery area on a site logistics plan
the access routes on a site logistics plan

words.enDefinition: separation of solid particles into groups according to size or an equivalent size measure

examples.en: The diagram illustrates size classification by grouping the dry grains into coarse, medium and fine fractions.
examples.zh: 图中将干颗粒分成粗、中、细三组，展示了「粒度分级」。

examples.en: We compared the fractions after size classification using the size ranges displayed in the table.
examples.zh: 我们用表中标出的尺寸范围，比较「粒度分级」所得的各级颗粒。

words.enDefinition: the maximum rate at which an amplifier's output voltage can change, commonly given in volts per microsecond

examples.en: The output edge was a ramp because the circuit model included a finite slew rate.
examples.zh: 电路模型设定了有限的「转换速率」，所以输出边沿是一段斜坡。

examples.en: We estimated the slew rate from the steepest part of the output voltage trace in simulation.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟输出电压曲线中最陡的一段估算「转换速率」。

words.enDefinition: The slope of the tangent to the deflection curve at a specified position.

examples.en: The slope of a beam was zero at the point where the plotted deflection reached its smooth maximum.
examples.zh: 图中的挠度在平滑极大点处取最大值，该处的「梁挠曲线斜率」为零。

examples.en: We used the slope of a beam to compare the tangent directions near its two supports.
examples.zh: 我们用「梁挠曲线斜率」比较两个支座附近的切线方向。

collocations: calculate the slope of a beam
find the slope of a beam at a support
the maximum slope of a beam

words.enDefinition: The horizontal spread diameter of a highly flowable fresh concrete sample in a specified test.

examples.en: The report described slump flow as the width of the spread once the concrete stopped moving.
examples.zh: 报告用混凝土停止流动后铺开的宽度表示「坍落扩展度」。

examples.en: The tutor marked the horizontal distance used for slump flow on the classroom sketch of the sample.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在试样课堂草图中标出用于表示「坍落扩展度」的水平距离。

words.enDefinition: A test that uses a fresh concrete sample's vertical drop as an indicator of consistency.

examples.en: The instructor used a diagram of the slump test to explain the vertical dimension in our table.
examples.zh: 老师用「坍落度试验」示意图解释了我们表格里的竖向尺寸。

examples.en: The notes assigned a separate page to the slump test and described its result as a length.
examples.zh: 笔记用单独一页介绍「坍落度试验」，并说明其结果用长度表示。

collocations: the result of a slump test

words.enDefinition: a linear approximation describing a nonlinear device's response to small changes around a chosen operating point

examples.en: The small-signal model matched the simulated gain closely only for inputs near the chosen bias point.
examples.zh: 只有输入接近所选偏置点时，「小信号模型」才与模拟增益十分接近。

examples.en: We replaced the nonlinear device equation with a small-signal model to estimate the slope near equilibrium.
examples.zh: 我们用「小信号模型」代替非线性器件方程，以估计平衡点附近的斜率。

words.enDefinition: An idealized contact transmitting a normal force and no frictional force.

examples.en: The problem assumed smooth contact, so we drew a single force perpendicular to the surface.
examples.zh: 题目假定为「光滑接触」，因此我们只画了一个垂直于接触面的力。

examples.en: The tutor marked smooth contact where the small sphere touched the inclined plane in the drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在图中标出小球与斜面接触处的「光滑接触」条件。

collocations: model smooth contact between two bodies

words.enDefinition: Time-dependent decrease in soil volume under sustained loading, often involving drainage

examples.en: The model illustrates soil consolidation as excess water pressure dissipates after a load change.
examples.zh: 载荷变化后，模型通过超额水压消散的过程说明了「土的固结」。

examples.en: We read the soil consolidation curve to see how quickly compression developed.
examples.zh: 我们读「土的固结」曲线，了解压缩发展有多快。

words.enDefinition: Study of how soils behave under loads and changing water conditions

examples.en: We used soil mechanics to explain why two samples compressed by different amounts.
examples.zh: 我们用「土力学」解释为什么两个试样的压缩量不同。

examples.en: The soil mechanics exercise separates the soil's solid grains from its water and air.
examples.zh: 「土力学」习题将土中的固体颗粒、水和空气分开表示。

words.enDefinition: Diagram grouping the solids, water, and air within a soil sample

examples.en: We labeled the volumes of air and water on the soil phase diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在「土的三相图」中标出了空气和水的体积。

examples.en: The soil phase diagram helped us distinguish the volume of solids from the total volume.
examples.zh: 「土的三相图」帮助我们区分固体颗粒体积与总体积。

words.enDefinition: Fraction of a soil sample's total volume occupied by voids

examples.en: We calculated soil porosity by dividing the volume of voids by the total volume.
examples.zh: 我们用孔隙体积除以总体积，求出了「土的孔隙率」。

examples.en: The two samples have different soil porosity values despite containing the same solid material.
examples.zh: 尽管两个土样由相同的固体材料组成，它们的「土的孔隙率」不同。

words.enDefinition: Solid particles forming the material framework of a soil sample

examples.en: The soil solids occupy the shaded portion at the bottom of the diagram.
examples.zh: 「土中固体颗粒」占据了图底部带阴影的部分。

examples.en: We held the mass of soil solids fixed while changing the modeled water content.
examples.zh: 我们保持「土中固体颗粒」的质量不变，只改变模型中的含水率。

words.enDefinition: A reusable board with groups of connected contacts that can hold components without soldering.

examples.en: The solderless breadboard diagram uses shading to show which holes share the same electrical connection.
examples.zh: 「免焊面包板」图用阴影显示哪些孔彼此电气相通。

examples.en: We compared the solderless breadboard drawing with the symbolic low-voltage circuit diagram on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上将「免焊面包板」示意图与低压电路符号图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the field-effect transistor connection from which carriers are supplied to the channel in normal operation

examples.en: The example measures the gate potential relative to the source terminal rather than relative to ground.
examples.zh: 示例中的栅极电位以「源极端」为基准，地并非这里的基准。

examples.en: The source terminal of the transistor was connected to the common reference in our classroom schematic.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图中，晶体管的「源极端」连接到公共参考点。

collocations: measure voltage at the source terminal
connect a resistor to the source terminal

words.enDefinition: Replacing a voltage source and series impedance with an equivalent current source and parallel impedance, or the reverse.

examples.en: The source transformation leaves the voltage and current relation at the marked terminals unchanged in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「电源等效变换」保持标记端子处的电压与电流关系不变。

examples.en: We performed a source transformation on paper before calculating the load current from the equivalent diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先在纸上做「电源等效变换」，再根据等效图算负载电流。

words.enDefinition: Distance between successive vehicles' fronts measured at the same instant

examples.en: The diagram shows space headway from the front of one vehicle to the next.
examples.zh: 图中由一辆车的前端量到相邻车辆前端，表示「车头间距」。

examples.en: We read space headway from a single snapshot of the simulated road segment.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟路段的一张快照中读出「车头间距」。

words.enDefinition: The mean speed of vehicles present along a road section. Under steady traffic it is estimated by section length divided by mean travel time for that section.

examples.en: We estimated space mean speed by dividing the common segment length by the average travel time.
examples.zh: 我们用共同行驶路段的长度除以平均行程时间，估算了「空间平均速度」。

examples.en: The table compares space mean speed with the arithmetic mean measured at a point.
examples.zh: 表格把「空间平均速度」与同一点测得速度的算术平均作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Mechanical energy per unit weight relative to the local channel bed, including flow depth and velocity head under the usual shallow-flow assumptions.

examples.en: We plotted specific energy in open-channel flow against depth at a fixed discharge.
examples.zh: 在流量固定时，我们画出了「明渠水流比能」随水深变化的关系图。

examples.en: The exercise uses specific energy in open-channel flow to compare two depths at one section.
examples.zh: 习题用「明渠水流比能」比较同一断面上的两种水深。

collocations: plot specific energy in open-channel flow
compare specific energy in open-channel flow
minimum specific energy in open-channel flow

words.enDefinition: enthalpy divided by mass, often used to express energy conveyed by flowing matter

examples.en: The inlet stream had a larger specific enthalpy than the cooled liquid leaving the chamber.
examples.zh: 入口流体的「比焓」高于离开腔室的冷却后液体。

examples.en: We read specific enthalpy from the table at the stated pressure and temperature of the vapor.
examples.zh: 我们按蒸气的给定压力和温度，从表中读取「比焓」。

words.enDefinition: the entropy of a substance per unit mass

examples.en: We compared the specific entropy of the two steam states to check the isentropic assumption.
examples.zh: 我们比较了蒸汽两种状态下的「比熵」，检验等熵假设。

examples.en: The table gives specific entropy in kilojoules per kilogram per kelvin for each listed state.
examples.zh: 表中给出各列出状态的「比熵」，单位为千焦每千克每开尔文。

collocations: calculate a change in specific entropy

words.enDefinition: the universal molar gas constant divided by the molar mass of a particular gas

examples.en: The air calculation used the specific gas constant with density in kilograms per cubic metre.
examples.zh: 空气的计算用「比气体常数」，密度采用千克每立方米。

examples.en: We obtained the specific gas constant for helium by dividing the molar constant by helium's molar mass.
examples.zh: 我们把摩尔气体常数除以氦的摩尔质量，得到氦的「比气体常数」。

collocations: look up a specific gas constant
use the specific gas constant for air

words.enDefinition: a dimensionless ratio of a substance's density to that of a specified reference material under stated conditions

examples.en: We reported the liquid's specific gravity relative to water at the temperature specified on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们按练习表指定温度，以水为参照报告该液体的「相对密度」。

examples.en: The two liquids had different masses at equal volume, reflecting their different values of specific gravity.
examples.zh: 两种液体体积相同而质量不同，反映了各自的「相对密度」不同。

words.enDefinition: Density of solid soil particles divided by the reference density of water

examples.en: The specific gravity of soil solids can differ when the two samples contain different minerals.
examples.zh: 两个土样所含的矿物不同时，「土粒比重」也可能不同。

examples.en: We used the specific gravity of soil solids to relate the solid mass to its volume.
examples.zh: 我们用「土粒比重」将固体颗粒的质量和体积联系起来。

collocations: calculate the specific gravity of soil solids
assumed specific gravity of soil solids
measure the specific gravity of soil solids

words.enDefinition: the heat needed per unit mass and per unit temperature increase under stated constraints

examples.en: Water's large specific heat capacity helped explain why the cup warmed slowly during our comparison.
examples.zh: 水的「比热容」较大，有助于解释为什么实验中这杯水升温缓慢。

examples.en: The report states the specific heat capacity in joules per kilogram per kelvin for each sample.
examples.zh: 报告以焦耳每千克每开尔文为单位，列出各样品的「比热容」。

collocations: calculate heat from specific heat capacity

words.enDefinition: the ratio of constant-pressure specific heat to constant-volume specific heat for the same substance and state

examples.en: We used the specific heat ratio to sketch a reversible adiabatic path for the ideal gas.
examples.zh: 我们用「比热比」在图中绘出理想气体的可逆绝热路径。

examples.en: The worksheet calculated the specific heat ratio from two heat capacities in the same units.
examples.zh: 练习表使用单位相同的两个比热容求出「比热比」。

collocations: assume a constant specific heat ratio
use the specific heat ratio for dry air

words.enDefinition: the internal energy of a substance per unit mass

examples.en: We multiplied the steam's specific internal energy by its mass to obtain the total internal energy.
examples.zh: 我们用蒸汽的「比内能」乘以质量，求得总内能。

examples.en: The specific internal energy appears in the table in kilojoules per kilogram at each temperature.
examples.zh: 表中列出各温度下的「比内能」，单位是千焦每千克。

collocations: calculate a change in specific internal energy

words.enDefinition: a thermodynamic property expressed per unit mass

examples.en: The table listed volume as a specific property, with cubic metres per kilogram as the unit.
examples.zh: 表格用立方米每千克表示「比性质」形式的体积。

examples.en: We obtained the specific property by dividing the total enthalpy by the sample mass.
examples.zh: 我们用总焓除以样品质量，求得该「比性质」。

collocations: express a specific property per unit mass

words.enDefinition: volume per unit mass, equal to the inverse of density for a uniform substance

examples.en: We multiplied the specific volume by the mass to find how much space the vapor occupied.
examples.zh: 我们用「比体积」乘以质量，求蒸气占据的空间。

examples.en: The specific volume of saturated vapor was much greater than that of saturated liquid at the same pressure.
examples.zh: 同一压力下，饱和蒸气的「比体积」远大于饱和液体。

words.enDefinition: a contribution to a signal associated with a particular frequency or narrow frequency range

examples.en: The largest spectral component in our recording matched the tuning fork's nominal frequency printed on its handle.
examples.zh: 录音中最大的「频谱分量」与音叉柄上印的标称频率一致。

examples.en: We traced the unexpected spectral component to a second tone included in the simulated recording.
examples.zh: 我们发现，意外出现的「频谱分量」来自模拟录音中加入的第二个音调。

words.enDefinition: The portion of an incoming stream's flow directed into a specified outlet of a splitter.

examples.en: The split fraction identifies which share of the entering water follows the lower arrow in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「分流分数」表明流入水量中沿下方箭头分走的份额。

examples.en: We checked that the worksheet's two outlet values for split fraction add up to one.
examples.zh: 我们核对练习纸上两个出口的「分流分数」之和等于一。

words.enDefinition: A location where one stream divides into two or more outlet streams.

examples.en: The split point is shown as a junction with one incoming arrow and two outgoing arrows.
examples.zh: 「分流点」画成一个有一支入箭头和两支出箭头的交点。

examples.en: We compared the material entering and leaving the split point in the water diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在水流程图上比较了进出「分流点」的物料。

words.enDefinition: A balance for dividing one stream into multiple exits, with equal compositions for an ideal simple splitter.

examples.en: The splitter balance gives the same salt fraction for both outgoing streams in the ideal drawing.
examples.zh: 对于图中的理想分流，「分流衡算」给出两股出口物流相同的盐分数。

examples.en: We checked the splitter balance using the total water shown at each branch on paper.
examples.zh: 我们用纸面上各支路标出的总水量核查「分流衡算」。

words.enDefinition: A test that estimates tensile strength from a specimen's resistance to splitting under compression.

examples.en: The splitting tensile test photograph showed a crack crossing the circular face of the concrete cylinder.
examples.zh: 「劈裂抗拉试验」照片显示，混凝土圆柱的圆形端面上有一道贯穿的裂缝。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the splitting tensile test was presented as an indirect measure of tensile strength.
examples.zh: 辅导老师说明了为什么「劈裂抗拉试验」被归为间接测量抗拉强度的方法。

collocations: results from a splitting tensile test

words.enDefinition: Speed of a vehicle measured at a particular point on a route

examples.en: The example records spot speed as each simulated vehicle crosses the reference point.
examples.zh: 示例记录各模拟车辆经过基准点时的「地点车速」。

examples.en: We plotted spot speed readings from the detector as a simple frequency distribution.
examples.zh: 我们把检测点的「地点车速」读数画成简单的频数分布。

words.enDefinition: Mechanical model pairing a moving mass with a spring providing restoring force

examples.en: The spring-mass system on the worksheet uses one mass moving along a guide.
examples.zh: 习题中的「弹簧质量系统」由一个沿导轨运动的质量块组成。

examples.en: We released the spring-mass system from an offset and plotted its idealized motion.
examples.zh: 我们把「弹簧质量系统」从偏离位置释放，并画出了它的理想化运动。

collocations: natural frequency of a spring-mass system

words.enDefinition: Change in spring force magnitude per unit deflection in the linear model

examples.en: We estimated spring stiffness from the slope of the force versus extension graph.
examples.zh: 我们根据力与伸长量关系图的斜率估算了「弹簧刚度」。

examples.en: Greater spring stiffness gives a larger restoring force for the same displacement here.
examples.zh: 在这个模型中，「弹簧刚度」更大时，相同位移对应的回复力更大。

words.enDefinition: Toothed wheel that engages a chain and transmits its motion

examples.en: The sprocket teeth engage the spaces between links in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中「链轮」的齿与链节之间的空隙啮合。

examples.en: We counted the teeth on the sprocket before comparing the two rotation rates.
examples.zh: 我们先数出「链轮」的齿数，再比较两种转速。

collocations: drive a chain with a sprocket

words.enDefinition: Cylindrical gear with straight teeth parallel to its axis of rotation

examples.en: The spur gear has straight teeth aligned with the shaft in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在我们图中，「直齿圆柱齿轮」的齿是直的，且与轴线平行。

examples.en: We used a spur gear pair on parallel shafts in the demonstration model.
