examples.en: The velocity head rose when the modeled flow accelerated through the narrow section of the pipe.
examples.zh: 模拟水流通过管道窄截面加速时，「流速水头」增大。

examples.en: We expressed the velocity head in metres before adding it to the other terms in the equation.
examples.zh: 我们先用米表示「流速水头」，再与方程中的其他项相加。

words.enDefinition: A caliper with a sliding auxiliary scale for reading fractions of a main scale division.

examples.en: We used the diagram to identify the sliding scale of the vernier caliper in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用示意图找到「游标卡尺」的滑动标尺。

examples.en: The tutor placed a vernier caliper next to a plain ruler so we could compare their scales.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把一把「游标卡尺」放在普通尺旁，让我们比较两者的刻度。

collocations: measure a diameter with a vernier caliper

words.enDefinition: The signal value represented by each vertical division on an oscilloscope display.

examples.en: The vertical scale gives the voltage represented by each square on the printed oscilloscope grid.
examples.zh: 「垂直标度」给出印制的示波器网格上每个竖向格距对应的电压。

examples.en: We used the vertical scale to convert the height of the curve into a voltage reading.
examples.zh: 我们利用「垂直标度」，将曲线高度换算成电压读数。

collocations: vertical scale in volts per division

words.enDefinition: Maximum displacement magnitude from the reference position during the oscillation considered

examples.en: On this symmetric trace, the vibration amplitude is the distance from center line to peak.
examples.zh: 对这条对称曲线，中心线到波峰的距离就是「振幅」。

examples.en: We compared the vibration amplitude across cycles as the motion gradually became smaller.
examples.zh: 随着运动幅度逐渐缩小，我们比较了各循环的「振幅」。

words.enDefinition: One complete repetition of oscillatory motion returning to the same phase

examples.en: We counted one vibration cycle when the slider returned to the same position and direction.
examples.zh: 滑块回到同一位置并朝同一方向运动时，我们计为「一次完整振动」。

examples.en: We marked the start and end of a vibration cycle on the repeating trace.
examples.zh: 我们在重复的曲线上标出了「一次完整振动」的起点和终点。

words.enDefinition: Curve bounding the amplitudes of a decaying oscillation over time

examples.en: We drew the vibration decay envelope around the shrinking swings in the motion trace.
examples.zh: 我们沿运动曲线逐渐缩小的摆动外缘画出「振动衰减包络线」。

examples.en: The vibration decay envelope falls more quickly in the model with stronger undercritical damping.
examples.zh: 在仍属欠阻尼但阻尼较强的模型中，「振动衰减包络线」下降得更快。

collocations: shape of the vibration decay envelope

words.enDefinition: Reduction of vibration transmitted between a vibrating object and its surroundings

examples.en: We discussed vibration isolation using two tabletop platforms with different support materials.
examples.zh: 我们用采用不同支撑材料的两个桌面平台来讨论「隔振」。

examples.en: The vibration isolation demonstration compares motion on the model's two sides using plotted traces.
examples.zh: 「隔振」演示通过绘制的曲线比较模型两侧的运动。

collocations: vibration isolation in a tabletop model

words.enDefinition: a node held near the reference ground potential by feedback without a direct physical connection to ground

examples.en: The virtual ground stayed near zero volts in our amplifier model while the input signal changed.
examples.zh: 在放大器模型中，输入信号变化时，「虚地」仍保持接近零伏。

examples.en: We distinguished virtual ground from the grounded terminal by tracing the connections on the schematic.
examples.zh: 我们沿电路图追查连线，区分「虚地」和实际接地的端子。

words.enDefinition: A digital representation used to explore a design's geometry or behavior before making a physical version.

examples.en: We rotated the virtual prototype on screen to see whether the labels were visible from above.
examples.zh: 我们在屏幕上转动「虚拟原型」，查看从上方能否看见标签。

examples.en: The virtual prototype helped us compare how two layouts would fit on the same classroom desk.
examples.zh: 「虚拟原型」帮助我们比较两种布局放在同一张课桌上的效果。

collocations: test the fit in a virtual prototype

words.enDefinition: Device modeled as exerting an opposing force proportional to relative velocity

examples.en: Our model uses a viscous damper to represent energy lost during each cycle.
examples.zh: 我们的模型用「黏性阻尼器」表示每个循环中损失的能量。

examples.en: The viscous damper exerts no force when both ends have the same velocity.
examples.zh: 「黏性阻尼器」两端速度相同时，它不产生阻尼力。

words.enDefinition: Damping modeled by a resisting force proportional to the relative velocity

examples.en: The model uses viscous damping, with a larger opposing force at higher speed.
examples.zh: 模型使用「黏性阻尼」，运动速率较高时，阻力更大。

examples.en: We used viscous damping to explain why the free motion gradually lost energy.
examples.zh: 我们用「黏性阻尼」解释了自由运动的机械能为何逐渐减少。

words.enDefinition: Examining an item by sight to check its visible features or condition.

examples.en: The visual inspection identified a torn edge on the paper model shown in the classroom photograph.
examples.zh: 「目视检验」发现课堂照片里的纸模型有一处边缘撕裂。

examples.en: We used visual inspection to compare the appearance of the two samples under the same lighting.
examples.zh: 我们采用「目视检验」，在相同光照下比较两个试样的外观。

words.enDefinition: Volume of voids divided by the volume occupied by soil solids

examples.en: We calculated the void ratio from the void space and solid volumes shown.
examples.zh: 我们根据图中的孔隙体积和固体颗粒体积求出了「孔隙比」。

examples.en: The void ratio exceeds one when the voids occupy more volume than the solids.
examples.zh: 孔隙体积超过固体颗粒体积时，「孔隙比」大于一。

words.enDefinition: The SI unit of electric potential difference, equal to one joule per coulomb.

examples.en: One volt corresponds to one joule per coulomb in the energy calculation on our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸的能量计算中，一「伏特」对应每库仑一焦耳。

examples.en: The model predicts a difference of one volt between the two marked circuit nodes.
examples.zh: 模型预测两个标记电路节点之间的电位差为一「伏特」。

collocations: express a potential difference in volts

words.enDefinition: The difference in electric potential between two points, measured in volts.

examples.en: The voltage between the labelled points is two volts in the classroom circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图中，两个标记点之间的「电压」为两伏。

examples.en: We compared voltage at two nodes using the same reference point in both readings.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个参考点比较两个节点的「电压」。

words.enDefinition: A series network that produces an output voltage equal to part of the input voltage.

examples.en: The voltage divider gives half the source voltage when the resistors are equal and unloaded.
examples.zh: 两个电阻器等值且输出未接负载时，「分压电路」给出电源电压的一半。

examples.en: We calculated the voltage divider output for two given resistances in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中计算给定两个阻值时「分压电路」的输出。

words.enDefinition: A decrease in electric potential measured across an element in a stated direction.

examples.en: The voltage drop across the larger resistor is greater because both resistors carry the same current.
examples.zh: 两个电阻器通过相同电流，阻值较大的那个「电压降」更大。

examples.en: We compared the voltage drop across each resistor with the rise provided by the source.
examples.zh: 我们将各电阻器上的「电压降」与电源提供的电势升高作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an amplifier configuration whose output approximately equals the input voltage, usually used for buffering

examples.en: The voltage follower kept the output near the input value while driving the load in the simulator.
examples.zh: 在模拟器中，「电压跟随器」在驱动负载的同时使输出接近输入值。

examples.en: We used the voltage follower model to separate the sensor from the loading of the next stage.
examples.zh: 我们用「电压跟随器」模型将传感器与后一级的负载作用隔开。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of output voltage variation to input voltage variation, expressed as a complex ratio for sinusoidal steady state

examples.en: The voltage gain was negative because the output fell when the input rose in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中输入升高时输出下降，所以「电压增益」为负。

examples.en: We compared voltage gain at two frequencies using the amplitude ratio shown in the simulation table.
examples.zh: 我们用模拟表中的振幅比，比较两个频率下的「电压增益」大小。

words.enDefinition: The chosen positive and negative labels that define the sign of a voltage variable.

examples.en: The voltage reference polarity tells us which node potential is subtracted in the worksheet equation.
examples.zh: 「电压参考极性」告诉我们，在练习的方程中要减去哪一个节点的电位。

examples.en: We reversed the voltage reference polarity on paper and obtained the opposite signed value.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上把「电压参考极性」对调，得到了符号相反的数值。

words.enDefinition: An instrument for measuring the potential difference between two points.

examples.en: The voltmeter symbol spans the two marked nodes in the low-voltage circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 低压电路图中的「电压表」符号跨接于两个标记节点之间。

examples.en: We compared the voltmeter reading with the calculated potential difference in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「电压表」读数与课堂练习算出的电位差作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Traffic demand or volume divided by capacity for the matching analysis period

examples.en: We calculated the volume-to-capacity ratio using the two rates in the same units.
examples.zh: 我们使用单位一致的两个流率计算了「流量通行能力比」。

examples.en: The worksheet states which volume definition it uses in the volume-to-capacity ratio.
examples.zh: 习题说明了计算「流量通行能力比」时采用哪种流量定义。

words.enDefinition: the volume of fluid passing a cross-section per unit time

examples.en: We calculated the volumetric flow rate from the volume collected in the container over ten seconds.
examples.zh: 我们根据十秒内流入容器的水的体积计算「体积流量」。

examples.en: In the model, the narrow section carries the same volumetric flow rate at a higher average speed.
examples.zh: 在模型中，窄截面的「体积流量」相同，平均流速较高。

collocations: report a volumetric flow rate in litres per second

words.enDefinition: The water taken up by a concrete specimen relative to its dry mass under stated test conditions.

examples.en: We compared the water absorption of concrete for two specimens that had visibly different surface textures.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个表面质地明显不同的试样的「混凝土吸水率」。

examples.en: The water absorption of concrete appeared as a percentage in the table of sample properties.
examples.zh: 样品性质表用百分比表示「混凝土吸水率」。

collocations: measure the water absorption of concrete
report the water absorption of concrete
compare water absorption of concrete samples

words.enDefinition: The mass of mixing water divided by the mass of cement in a mixture.

examples.en: We read the water-cement ratio beside the mass of cement on the simplified concrete mix sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的混凝土配合比表中，从水泥质量旁边读出了「水灰比」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the water-cement ratio differed between two examples that used the same cement mass.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，水泥质量相同的两道例题中，「水灰比」有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: The mass of mixing water divided by the total mass of cementitious materials.

examples.en: The example listed a water-cementitious materials ratio because the binder included both cement and fly ash.
examples.zh: 由于胶结料同时含有水泥和粉煤灰，例题列出了「水胶比」。

examples.en: We checked which ingredients counted toward the water-cementitious materials ratio in the sample mixture table.
examples.zh: 我们核对样例配合比表中，哪些组分计入「水胶比」的计算。

words.enDefinition: An admixture that reduces the water needed to obtain a given concrete consistency.

examples.en: The chart identified a water-reducing admixture in the mix with lower water demand and similar consistency.
examples.zh: 图表在用水需求较低、稠度相近的配合比中标出了一种「减水剂」。

examples.en: We read the note explaining why a water-reducing admixture appeared in the list of concrete ingredients.
examples.zh: 我们读了说明，了解混凝土组分清单中为什么有「减水剂」。

collocations: a mix with a water-reducing admixture
the purpose of a water-reducing admixture

words.enDefinition: Change in water surface elevation per horizontal distance along the flow

examples.en: We traced the upper line to read the water-surface slope in this profile.
examples.zh: 在这幅纵断面图中，我们沿上方的线读出「水面坡度」。

examples.en: The water-surface slope differs from the bed slope where the modeled depth changes.
examples.zh: 在模型水深变化的位置，「水面坡度」与渠底坡度不同。

words.enDefinition: Interior truss element connecting chord members through the joints

examples.en: The diagonal web member connects the upper and lower chords in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的斜「桁架腹杆」连接上、下弦杆。

examples.en: We traced the vertical web member between the two marked joints of the truss.
examples.zh: 我们沿着两个标记节点之间的竖直「桁架腹杆」观察其位置。

words.enDefinition: Barrier across an open channel over which water is allowed to pass

examples.en: Water passes over the weir shown in the classroom side view.
examples.zh: 水流越过课堂侧视图中所示的「堰」。

examples.en: We marked both water levels around the weir on the paper model.
examples.zh: 我们在纸面模型上标出了「堰」上、下游的两个水位。

words.enDefinition: Top edge or surface of a weir over which flow passes

examples.en: The weir crest is the top edge of the barrier in this sketch.
examples.zh: 「堰顶」是这张草图中挡水构件的顶边。

examples.en: We marked the water surface and the weir crest as separate elevations.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了水面和「堰顶」各自的高程。

words.enDefinition: Steel wires welded at their intersections to form reinforcement for concrete.

examples.en: The sample of welded wire reinforcement showed a regular grid with small welds at each intersection.
examples.zh: 「焊接钢丝网」样品呈规则网格，每个交点有小焊点。

examples.en: We found welded wire reinforcement listed in the slab detail beside a simple drawing of the grid.
examples.zh: 我们在板详图中看到「焊接钢丝网」的标注，旁边有一幅网格简图。

collocations: a sheet of welded wire reinforcement
the intersections of welded wire reinforcement

words.enDefinition: Soil containing an appropriately distributed range of particle sizes

examples.en: The broad spread of sizes helps explain the choice of well-graded soil in the exercise.
examples.zh: 粒径分布较广，有助于解释习题为何将其认定为「级配良好的土」。

examples.en: The well-graded soil in the worksheet contains both coarse grains and smaller particles.
examples.zh: 习题中的「级配良好的土」同时包含粗颗粒和较小颗粒。

collocations: particle sizes in a well-graded soil

words.enDefinition: A modelling assumption that composition is uniform throughout a selected volume at each instant.

examples.en: The well-mixed assumption gives the vessel contents one sugar fraction at each simulated time.
examples.zh: 「充分混合假设」使模拟中容器内物料在每个时刻都用一个糖质量分数表示。

examples.en: We used the well-mixed assumption to relate the outlet composition to the contents in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们利用「充分混合假设」把出口物流组成与容器内物料组成对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A way to express a component fraction using the total mass including moisture as the denominator.

examples.en: The wet basis uses the full mass of the sample, including water, in the denominator.
examples.zh: 「湿基」采用包含水分的样品总质量作为分母。

examples.en: We read the moisture result on a wet basis before comparing it with another label.
examples.zh: 我们先按「湿基」读取含水量，再将结果与另一个标签比较。

collocations: moisture content on a wet basis

words.enDefinition: The mass per unit volume of concrete measured while it is fresh.

examples.en: The table gave the wet density of concrete for each mixture before the samples hardened.
examples.zh: 表格给出了各配合比试样硬化前的「新拌混凝土密度」。

examples.en: We checked the units beside wet density of concrete because the worksheet listed both mass and volume.
examples.zh: 习题同时列出质量和体积，因此我们核对了「新拌混凝土密度」旁的单位。

collocations: measure the wet density of concrete
report the wet density of concrete
compare values of the wet density of concrete

words.enDefinition: Length along a channel cross section where liquid touches solid boundaries

examples.en: We traced the bottom and both wet sides to find the wetted perimeter.
examples.zh: 我们沿渠底和两侧浸水部分量取「湿周」。

examples.en: The wetted perimeter increases as the sample's sloping sides become more submerged.
examples.zh: 当模型的斜坡侧面浸入更多时，「湿周」增加。

words.enDefinition: The terminal connected to the movable contact of a potentiometer.

examples.en: The wiper terminal is represented by the arrow touching the resistor symbol in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中接触电阻器符号的箭头表示「滑动端子」。

examples.en: We read the potential of the wiper terminal for the midpoint setting shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们读取课堂所示中点设定下「滑动端子」的电位。

words.enDefinition: The direction in which the main wood fibers run in a piece or layer.

examples.en: The teacher asked us to mark the wood grain direction on each layer in the panel sketch.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在板材草图的每一层上标出「木纹方向」。

examples.en: We matched the arrows for wood grain direction with the lines visible on the sample surface.
examples.zh: 我们把表示「木纹方向」的箭头与试样表面可见的纹线对应起来。

collocations: a change in wood grain direction

words.enDefinition: Rule equating net work on the modeled system to its kinetic energy change

examples.en: We used the work-energy principle to predict the cart's speed after a steady pull.
examples.zh: 我们用「动能定理」预测持续拉动后小车的速率。

examples.en: The work-energy principle connects the work done in turning the disk with its kinetic energy change.
examples.zh: 「动能定理」将转动圆盘所做的功与其动能变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Toothed wheel that meshes with a screwlike worm in a transmission

examples.en: The worm wheel turns when the screwlike worm moves against its teeth.
examples.zh: 螺杆状蜗杆与齿啮合时，会带动「蜗轮」转动。

examples.en: We labeled the worm wheel separately from the worm in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在图中分别标出了「蜗轮」和蜗杆。

words.enDefinition: A distinct point on a stress-strain curve where appreciable plastic deformation begins.

examples.en: The tutor marked the yield point where the strain began rising without much additional stress.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在应力几乎未再增加而应变开始明显增大处标出了「屈服点」。

examples.en: Our plots showed a clear yield point in one specimen but a gradual transition in the other.
examples.zh: 测试图显示，一个试样有明显的「屈服点」，另一个试样则逐渐过渡。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of axial stress to axial strain in the linear elastic range.

examples.en: We found Young's modulus from the slope of the straight part of the stress-strain plot.
examples.zh: 我们用应力–应变图上直线段的斜率求出「杨氏模量」。

examples.en: A higher Young's modulus meant less axial strain under the same stress in our classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，应力相同时，「杨氏模量」越高，轴向应变越小。

collocations: a material with a high Young's modulus

words.enDefinition: a diode designed to operate in controlled reverse breakdown with a relatively stable voltage

examples.en: The simulated Zener diode maintained nearly the same reverse voltage over the chosen range of current.
examples.zh: 在所选电流范围内，模拟的「齐纳二极管」两端的反向电压几乎不变。

examples.en: We located the breakdown region of the Zener diode on the supplied current versus voltage graph.
examples.zh: 我们在给出的电流电压图中找出了「齐纳二极管」的击穿区域。

words.enDefinition: Adjusting an instrument so that its indication matches the zero reference condition.

examples.en: The page listed zero adjustment as a separate item before the recorded classroom measurement comparisons.
examples.zh: 页面把「零点调整」单独列在课堂测量对照记录之前。

examples.en: We discussed zero adjustment after the diagram showed an instrument with a nonzero reading at rest.
examples.zh: 图中仪器在零输入状态下读数不为零，于是我们讨论了「零点调整」。

collocations: the result of a zero adjustment

words.enDefinition: A change in an instrument's zero indication over time with its reference input held at zero.

examples.en: The chart showed zero drift because the indicated baseline moved while the reference stayed at zero.
examples.zh: 图中的指示基线发生移动，而参考输入始终为零，显示出「零点漂移」。

examples.en: We checked for zero drift by comparing the original and final baseline entries on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较习题中最初和最后的基线记录，以查看有无「零点漂移」。

collocations: account for zero drift in the results

words.enDefinition: Truss member with zero axial force for the load case considered

examples.en: We identified a zero-force member by examining the directions of the forces at its joint.
examples.zh: 我们观察该节点的受力方向，识别出一根「零杆」。

examples.en: The same member may cease to be a zero-force member under another load case.
examples.zh: 在另一个载荷工况下，同一杆件可能不再是「零杆」。

collocations: zero-force member under a specified load

words.enDefinition: A nonzero instrument indication when the measured input has a reference value of zero.

examples.en: The display showed a small zero offset while the reference input was still set to zero.
examples.zh: 参考输入仍为零时，显示器给出了一个小的「零点偏移」。

examples.en: We marked the zero offset in the practice table before comparing the two classroom instruments.
examples.zh: 比较两台课堂仪器之前，我们在练习表中标出了「零点偏移」。

words.enDefinition: the principle that systems separately in thermal equilibrium with a third system are in thermal equilibrium with each other

examples.en: The zeroth law of thermodynamics explains why the same thermometer can compare temperatures in separate baths.
examples.zh: 「热力学第零定律」解释了为何可以用同一支温度计比较不同浴液的温度。

examples.en: We used the zeroth law of thermodynamics to reason from two equal equilibrium thermometer readings.
examples.zh: 根据两次达到平衡后的相同温度计读数，我们用「热力学第零定律」作出推断。

collocations: state the zeroth law of thermodynamics
apply the zeroth law of thermodynamics
explain temperature using the zeroth law of thermodynamics
